name: Lutka
text: An all day Belgian blonde. Perfect match for a road trip with BrrKaaa. You can never get enough of her!

name: Plavo (Belgian Blond Style)
text: Aromas of biscuit and apple are followed by aroma of anise. This classic Belgian style was the first of this kind brewed in Serbia. Still 7 years after is one of the most loved ones.

name: Amber Abbey
text: BELGIJSKO MANASTIRSKO PIVOKao što mu ime govori, pivo vodi poreklo iz Belgije, a prvi su ga proizvodil opati malih belgijskih manastira početkom XV veka. Proizvodeneo isključivo od najkvalitetnijeg uvoznog ječma, snažno i aromatično, boje ćilibara sa povišenim procentom alkohola – do 7%.

name: Freyja
text: Frejine suze su sinonim za zlato. Ova je boginja moćna, ali dok plače pokazuje svoju blagost. Popijte Frejine suze, duša vam se pozlatila. Skål!

name: Equinox
text: Cream Ale sa kompleksnim aromatičnim notama Eukanot i Amarillo hmelja.Eukanot hmelj pruža svežinu limete i mandarine. Puna čaša citrusnih nota samo za Vas.

name: Mount Hood
text: Second of many beers we will brew influenced by our USA trip from Portland to Yakima Valley back in September. After Multnomah Falls, another symbol of a great Oregon nature is in front of you - magnificient Mount Hood! Drinkable as a spring water, this cream ale is just a blessing for all ya thirsty craft beer lovers. Cheers in that name!

name: Jolly
text: Cream Ale with Cascade hops used only in whirlpool.

name: Perfectly Imperfect
text: Brainstormed in Serbia and Nerherlands, brewed in Serbia, to be enjoyed worldwide. The best beer in Serbia by Ratebeer.

name: Serbian Barrels Series No.4 - Saison Aged In Wine Barrels
text: No.4 in Serbian Barrels Series is the same Saison base as in No.2 & No.3 but this time without aging on fruits and with a combonof white & red wine barrels. Only Serbian barrels, of course!

name: Serbian Barrels Series No.3 - Saison Mixed Berries
text: Number 3 in our Serbian Barrels Series. Again the same Saison like No.2 and in Serbian red wine barrels. But this time, aged on a mixed berries combo - raspberries, blackberries, black currant & jostaberry. Cheers brothers & sisters!

name: Serbian Barrels Series No.2 - Saison On Cherries
text: No2 from our unique Serbian Barrels Series is here! First of three Saisons - aged on cherries in Serbian wine barrels. Pinot Noir, Cabernet Sauvignon & Prokupac barrels were his home for more than a year! Series continues...

name: Crusty the Spring Saison
text: Spring saison brewed by Dogma & Crow as a first collaboration at this brewery. Saison with German, Slovenian and Czech hops with addition of fresh organic cucumber.

name: Blueberry Saison
text: When Belgrade and Rome meets! Saison with blueberry, black & white pepper and that speacial yeast!

name: Berry Berry Extraordinary Sorbet
text: Collab with amazing Beer Bastards!Sour base with heaps of blueberries and raspberries(200g/l) for a nice deep red color, lactose for that creamy texture and a touch of lemon zest, because why not. Gently dry hopped with Citra and Lemondrop.

name: The Emperor
text: The Emperor is an Imperial Sour Grape Ale. And it is special one as we have used autohtonic Serbian grape variety - Tamjanika! A bit of sourness and a lot of wine character!

name: Namba Wan
text: A light golden yellow ale with fresh ginger and orange zest.Perfect pair with delicacies made by Wok Republic.Special for Wok Republic.

name: Wanna Be Lee?
text: Our unique ginger ale, an all day drink.

name: Kottbusser Class 2015
text: Kottbusser je zaboravljeni istorijski stil koji je bio popularan davnih 1500-ih godina a ukinut je zakonom o cistoci piva. Skuvali smo ga sa kolegama iz Crow i Tron pivare koji su prva piva skuvali iste godine kao i mi - 2015. Kombinacija ječmenog i pšeničnog slada uz dodatke ovsa, meda, melase a sve to u ale fermentaciji.

name: UNCLE MIKE - Pre-Prohibition Lager
text: Američki lager

name: Honey Sensor
text: Robotizovana pčela ti donosi miris i ukus livadskog meda, ovsenih pahuljica i herbalnih nota, koji se bore sa nekoliko vrsti hmelja za dominaciju! JOIN THE ROBOLUTION! A robotic bee brings you the smell and taste of meadow honey, oatmeal, herbal notes that fight with several types of hops for dominance!

name: Meta Hoptopod
text: Here comes a younger brother of our bestseller Hoptopod! Straight from the Metaverse! In collaboration with our friends from Barth Haas we brewed the same recipe, but without hop pellets. Instead we used "advanced hop products" - Flex for bittering, Incognito in whirpool and Spectrum to enhance hop aroma during fermetation and maturation. Take a sip, open a can and enter the Metaverse!

name: Mikkeller Vista
text: Vista, IPA style, directed by one of the world most progressive and best brewers and in our execution. Strong character, full and oily body, with crisp and biscuit hues. Fruity aromas with a grapefruit aftertaste and a wellbalanced bitterness that is a dominant characteristic of this style.

name: Thor
text: Ako je Thor snažan kao i njegov čekić Mjolnir, onda je ovo pivo snažno koliko i hmelj u njemu. Pustite da vas udari grom! Skål!

name: DRINK 'N' ROLL
text: New "sport inspired" beer in our team! This time we merged energy with creative & funny duo behind the most popular basketball podcast in Serbia - "6.75 Range".  West Coast IPA hopped with Nectaron, Citra & HBC 1019. Perfect one for perfect basketball action like pick 'n' roll!

name: Stolen Pine Tree DDH
text: Stolen Pine Tree je novo rođendansko pivo koje smo vam već nagovestili. U pitanju je Double Dry Hop IPA koja osvaja svojim aromama. Ananas, bor i citrusne arome komešaju se pri svakom gutljaju pod direktnom komandom Mozaik hmelja i pridodatih sladova. Oslikano zlatnom bojom koja oplemenjuje doživljaj, ovo pivo će vas uvući u kosmičku pustolovinu istraživanja novih svetova. Pijemo ga premijerno tokom rođendana, a i nakon toga kao standard.

name: NAKA TUKA TE TOĐA
text: This West Coast IPA is a special brew for "Hop Growers of America Competition" which will be held at Brau Beviale 2018. Combination of four "public" hops varieties - Chinook, Centenial, Amarillo and Cascade brings you floral, citrusy and a little bit of spicy notes. NAKA-TUKA-TE-TODJA drums rumbles in your head while you drink this hoppy elixir!

name: Tropical IPA
text: Pravi predstavnik American IPA. Prva šarža skuvana 2013. rekreiran krajem 2018. Dry hopped with Columbus, Centennial, Simcoe, Enigma.

name: Joker
text: Eksplozija tropskih, cvetnih I citrusnih aroma uz laganu pitkoću I prisutnu gorčinu do koje smo došli kombinacijom 4 vrste hmelja u ime stila koji je pokrenuo craft revoluciju.An explosion of tropical, floral and citrus aromas with easy drinkability and a hint of bitterness that we achieved by combining 4 types of hops in the name of the style that started the craft revolution.

name: Gundam Rage
text: Get ready for hoppy rage - GUNDAM RAGENaš novi robot, japanski Gundam donosi ti zahmeljene besne ukuse, po stilu american ipa 6,5% alc

name: Single Hop Centennial
text: Pure centennial hop beer.

name: Caiman
text: American IPA brewed with Mosaic, Citra, Amarillo and Rakau hops.

name: 8th AB / Slide Ride
text: One of two "music" collabs for our 8th Anniversary. With our blues brothers from a band Slide Ride!

name: Hoptopod
text: Hoptopod is a real hoppy monster which was brought up in our fermenter for five weeks. We fed him with finest aromatic hops from Yakima valley. Feel free to get to know him and to experience his hopsonality!

name: Heartbeet
text: Heartbeet, IPA sa cveklom.

name: JESUS
text: He is the first and the last, alpha and omega the king of all IPAs...he is the one that is...he is JESUS IPA.Perfect balance between malts and hops.Medium body and medium bitterness .So complex flavor and aroma that you need three glasses to be sure what it's all about:P...Welcome to paradise

name: Penal IPA
text: Odlikuju ga izrazite citrusne i tropske hmeljne note i u ukusu i u mirisu. Iskorišćen je pun potencijal ‘Mosaic’ sorte hmelja koji mu daje poseban karakter.

name: Sansho
text: Sansho, aromatični IPA, sa dodatkom istoimenog bibera, koji ima aromu nalik na bor i mentu.

name: 7th AB #3 West Coast IPA
text: 3rd from 7. Our brothers from Poland, Tank Busters helped us to create this old school but modern IPA. Cheers!

name: Western Nostalgia
text: Ne zovimo to povratkom,West coast IPA nikada nije ni otišla!U počecima američke craft revolucije, 70-ih, rodila se West coast IPA. Spoj klasične IPA recepture i hmelja sa pacifičkog severozapada stvorio je moderan, prepoznatljiv profil – West coast IPA.Naše novo pivo, Western nostalgia,je naša posveta legendi ,sećanje je na old school, ali sa prepoznatljivim 3bir potpisom. Bistro, aromatično, gorko i snažno pivo.Pridružite nam se i (ponovo) otkrijte čari West coast IPA. Uživajte u njenoj legendi. Jer neke stvari nikada ne izlaze iz mode.Krenite sa nama, od istoka ka zapadu!

name: Flying Dogma Galaxy IPA
text: Flying Dogma Galaxy IPA is the first collaboration between two breweries between Serbia and USA! Crispy, fruity and a little bit spicy American style IPA, ideal for this spring days!

name: Single Hop Citra
text: Autocratic attack on the heat. Bring the citrus freshness in each warm day and more importantly relax a heated situation with the freshness of the Citra hop.

name: Funk You
text: Pivo skuvano u saradnji sa Funk and Soul Pub. Snazno i bez kompromisa.

name: Belgrade IPA
text: This is the first beer we brewed in our new brewery in Belgrade. In addition to the name it carries, we are particularly proud of it's balance. By combining Amarillo, Cascade and Centennial hops, we have achieved a floral-fruity aroma of a harmonious character that fits perfectly with a light caramel-biscuit body. Thanks to the long aging period, alcohol notes are skillfully softened.

name: Trimix
text: West coast IPA.Wolf,Citra, Chinook

name: Coaster Roller
text: There are IPAs and there are West Coast IPAs. Coaster Roller is a definitive example of a West Coast IPA. Light-bodied, golden colored, and heavily hopped with five quintessential American hops (cascade, centennial, chinook, citra, and mosaic), all hailing from the Pacific Northwest of the American west coast, Coaster Roller exhibits the characteristic clean flavors and aromas of bright citrus and pungent pine which have made this style famous. Fruit orchards meet evergreen forests, and like a winding rolling ride down the Pacific Coast Highway with the windows open and the breeze in your face, this beer hits you with a refreshing burst of hops and grips your palette with a long and satisfying finish that you'll never want to end. A true classic. Relax, take a deep breath, sip back, and let it roll…

name: Hopzilla
text: Hopzilla je robotizovana godzila koja svojim plamenom rasteruje sve pokušaje koji pivo ne žele da bude od 100% premium sirovina.U pitanju je india pale ale sa malty I caramel aromama, vise vrsta hmelja, i mirisom koji krije plamen u koj te čeka u vidu 6,3% aklohola.Hopzilla is a robotic godzilla whose flame disperses all attempts of those who do not want beer to be out of 100% premium ingridients.It is an india pale ale with malty and caramel aromas, several types of hops, and a scent that hides the flame in which 6.3% of alcohol is waiting for you.

name: IPA
text: Za prave sladokusce sa istančanim ukusom pripremili smo Inat IPA. IPA ili Indian Pale Ale kao vrsta piva ima interesantnu istoriju što se lako oseti u njegovom ukusu i aromi. Nastalo je iz potrebe da se očuva svežina piva koju su britanci slali svojim vojnicima u Indiju, te su u pivo dodavali velike količine hmelja. Upravo njegova izražena aromatičnost je ono što ga izdvaja od drugih vrsta ejlova. Inat IPA je napravljena od 5 vrsta egzotičnog hmelja koje smo slili u savrseno usklađen i aromatičan Pale Ale. Inat IPA će vas oduševiti kako potpunosću, tako i postojanošću svojih aroma! Naša IPA sadrži 5,8% alkohola i služi se na 7-12 stepeni Celzijusa. Za ljubitelje jakih aroma i nesvakidašnjih osećaja, Inat IPA je pravi izbor.

name: Balkan Brass
text: Crisp and refreshing West Coast IPA, 5.8% ABV with clean taste, slight malt aroma and medium body. Moderate amount of bitterness, complimented with oily hoppy flavour and aroma of elderflower and berry fruit.

name: Loco About Coco
text: Our black NEIPA with huge dose of toasted coconuts and a touch of lactose, gently dry hopped with Mosaic and Centennial. A real delicacy.

name: Midnight Black IPA
text: Black IPA brewed with Simcoe and Mosaic hops.

name: Quasar
text: Quasar is a black hole. Quasar is also first Black IPA in our portfolio. We've found a perfect balance between roastines, hoppines and drinkability. 3rd beer in our "100% draft" series. Enjoy aromas of Chinook, Cascade and Mosaic!

name: Ayahuasca Jungle Ale
text: Ayahuasca is a special plant. Ayahuasca Jungle ale is special IPA brewed & loaded with aromatic hops, juniper and orange peel. Funky, funky, funky!

name: Azacca
text: Pink Brut IPA. Hops: Azacca, Citra, Galaxy

name: 5th Anniversary Beer #3 - Cold IPA
text: 5 BEERS FOR 5 YEARS! #3 in our 5th Anniversary Beer edition - new & trendy beer style in the world of craft beer. An juicy & tasty IPA fermented with lager yeast on ale temperatures. And we gave it a bit of rice for silky mouthfeel. Enjoy it now and wait for another batch as we will brew it again...And again.

name: Calculator Cold IPA / Belgrade Edition
text: We're proudly present 1st collaboration brew between Serbian & Chinese Brewery! Thanks to our friends from Jing A & 8x8 Brewing Project as they invited us to be part of this worldwide collaboration. In Belgrade & Shenzhen - back to back collab with similar recipe! Long live collaboration brews!

name: Super Can Fest Special Brew / Cold IPA
text: One of two special Super Can Fest brews - we've done it again after 5th Anniversary brew last year - Cold IPA here it is!

name: Mala Antanta
text: Double cold ipa collab with Pivovar Zichovec

name: Cold As Ice
text: A paradox of warmth and chill, her icy grace a thing of skill.We really love this style so we decided to make another beer in Cold IPA series.This time we used more rice in the mix to lighten the color and body even more and we did DDH with generous amounts of Citra, Ekuanot and Strata for a nice mix of citrusy, tropical and a bit piney feel. There is also a nice lingering bitterness that invites for another sip.

name: Pablo
text: Refreshing and hoppy, a remedy from many travels, inspired by a true story of a soldier Pablo. Done in cooperation with the first craft beer pub Samo Pivo.

name: Two Devils
text: Two devils je British IPA tip piva. Bakarne je boje, srednje bogatog tela kojim dominiraju sladne arome biskvita, orašastih plodova i lagane karamelne note, kao i ukus hleba. Pivo je bogato zahmeljeno, sa svojom prepoznatljivom gorčinom pri prvom gutljaju, a zatim se dešava ekspozija ukusa citrusa, tropskog voća i cvetnih aroma koji potiču od najplemenitijih sorti hmelja.

name: Hypersleep
text: Introducing Hyper Sleep, the first-ever collaboration between Robocraft Brewery and Christiania Bryghus from the free-spirited haven of Christiania, Copenhagen. This Fruited IPA, with 6.5% alcohol, transports you into a realm of relaxation and exploration, much like the deep sleep of space travelers in suspended animation.Infused with the tropical sweetness of pineapple, Hyper Sleep is both refreshing and bold. Its futuristic label, depicting a figure in cryo-sleep, is a nod to the interstellar journeys we dream of taking. Every sip is like waking up in a new world, where the crispness of the IPA and the juiciness of the fruit combine to create a cosmic experience for your taste buds.Predstavljamo vam Hyper Sleep, prvo pivo nastalo u saradnji između Robocraft Brewery-a i Christiania Bryghus-a iz slobodarskog okruženja Christianije. Ova Fruited IPA sa 6,5% alkohola vodi vas u svet opuštanja i istraživanja, baš kao duboki san svemirskih putnika u stanju hibernacije.Obogaćen tropskom slatkoćom ananasa, Hyper Sleep je osvežavajući i smeo. Njegov futuristički dizajn, koji prikazuje osobu u kriogenom snu, oslanja se na ideju međuplanetarnih putovanja o kojima sanjamo. Svaki gutljaj je poput buđenja u novom svetu, gde se hrskavost IPA i sočnost voća stapaju u kosmičko iskustvo za vaša čula.

name: Maliina
text: Raspberry India Pale Ale sa liofilizovanom malinom."Probajte odmah u potpisu"Maliina

name: Epidemic Is (not) Over / Lemon & Oat IPA
text: Epidemic is (not) over. For real! This new collaboration brew with our brother Cane from "Pi Brewery" brings you tartness & freshness of lemon with the body of an IPA.

name: Juice IPA
text: Mutno, aromatično pivo, izuzetnih mirisnih nota stiže na pivsku scenu u svom punom sjaju. Njegova boja koja je poput pomorandžine kore učiniće da na trenutak zaboravite da je u pitanju pivo dok vas ne iznenadi njegova prijatna gorčina i topli dodir alkohola uz blagi ukus aroma tropskog voća. Blend od 3 kvasca kao i kod Citrozaik IPA, podiže igru na novi nivo!

name: Fantomsko Skloniste
text: Triple dry hop

name: Ne, Ne, Ne! Da, Da, Da!
text: "Ne, ne, ne" in Greek means the same as "Da, da, da" in Serbian. And cause of that we names this first ever collab with our friends from Greece - P.I.G.S. And the main thing is that both things in English mean "Yes, yes, yes"!

name: DrIPAc
text: Double IPA with Amarillo & Vic Secret

name: Korsar
text: From distant India, over the oceans in the KORSAR ship arrives IPA with the scent of tropical fruits. With carefully selected 5 types of specialty malts of German and Belgian origin and wonderfully American Amarillo and Mosaics, this beer will rock your boat.

name: Stalker
text: Love at first sip? A rush of passion? Sudden obsession? A wave of pungent aromas and exquisite flavors washes over you: Stalker has arrived.  One sip and you’re gripped. A beer that is intense in every way, Stalker is the dense embodiment of the Double IPA style:  hop-heavy, full-bodied, complex, luscious, and robust all at once. Lush tropical, citrus, and spice notes rise from this deep orange ale. Bold flavors of ripe orange, lime zest, papaya, and mint from the copious amounts of hops mingle with the toasted caramel notes of fiery-kilned grains and dance across the tongue, then are swept away in a crisp bitterness and the slight tingle of alcohol that reminds you this is one beautiful beast of a beer. A delicious, enthralling aftertaste lingers and won’t let go. Drink it all in – and don’t look back.

name: To the Moon & Back
text: Wishin’ And hoppin’ of moon walking with You. Not to be consumed alone as there is a danger of an emotional outburst. Stand by with a hug or kiss. Once you go DIPA is hard to go back.

name: Babalao
text: Naša prva Dupla IPA vam donosi jaku gorčinu sa notama nežne slatkoće, koja sa 8% alkohola i divljim aromama Manga, Grejpa i Breskve čini novogodišnje praznike duplo srećnijim.

name: Honey I'm Drunk
text: DIPA with honey.Sa dodatkom meda iz lokalnog pčelinjaka, koji se tu našao kako bi podigao procenat alkohola i da pivu kompleksniji ukus. Preovlađuju prijatne hmeljne note kako u ukusu tako i u mirisu

name: Kubrick's HAL
text: Kubrick's HALLeganda holivudske kinematografije, Stenli Kjubrik 1968 nam je predstavio u kultnom sci-fi ostvarenju 2001: Odiseja u svemiru, koncept robota veštačke inteligencije HAL 9000 koji se okreće protiv svojih tvoraca. Mi prepoznajemo sličnu metaforu u našoj borbi sa industrijom koja kao HAL prati svaki korak potrošača pokušavajući da ga "ukroti" svojom snagom. Mi pravimo premium, kvalitetno pivo se prirodnim sastojcima, po izvornim receptima tvoraca ovog napitka pre nego što je industrija uzela primat!Kubrick's HAl je imperial double india pale ale, spremna za borbu sa arsenalom hmeljeva i jakim procentom alkohola od 8%. HAL is watching! The legend of Hollywood, Stanley Kubrick had presented us in 1968 the famous sci-fi film 2001: A Space Odyssey, which introduced us with a concept of the HAL 9000 artificial intelligence robot that turns against its creators. We recognize a similar metaphor in our struggle with the industry which, like HAL, follows every step of consumer, trying to "tame" him with its mass media strength. We make premium quality beer with natural ingredients, using original recipes of the beer creators, long before the industry took over!Kubrick's HAl is an imperial double india pale ale, ready to fight with arsenal of hops and a strong alcohol percentage of 8%. HAL is watching!

name: Plutonium Pineapple
text: Plutonium Pineapple Milkshake Double IPA is the second beer with a radioactive name and taste! We’ve just changed previous Orange juice with much more summerish Pineapple juice!

name: Plutonium
text: Plutonium Orange Milkshake Double IPA is a beer with a radioactive name. But also it has radioactive taste! Brewed in collab with our Russian friends (Brighton Brew) this tasty and juicy beer is full of orange flavour, citrusy hops and lactose. Smooth, silky and a little bit astrigent, Plutonium will make your senses radioactive!

name: Jinx Returns
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Jinx se vratila iz digitalnog haosa sa još više energije, još više hmelja i još manje strpljenja za dosadna piva.Ova Double New England IPA od 8,5% alkohola krije eksploziju sočnih tropskih aroma, citrusnih nota i svilenkasto punog tela koje vešto maskira svoju snagu. Mutna, opasno pitka i prepuna karaktera, Jinx Returns je stvorena za sve koji vole da pomeraju granice i izazivaju sistem.Kada se haos vrati, preostaje samo jedno - pridruži mu se.Jinx has returned from digital chaos with more energy, more hops, and even less patience for ordinary beer.This 8.5% Double New England IPA delivers an explosion of juicy tropical fruit aromas, bright citrus notes, and a silky smooth body that cleverly hides its strength. Hazy, dangerously drinkable, and packed with character, Jinx Returns is brewed for those who push boundaries and challenge the system.When chaos returns, there's only one thing left to do - join it.

name: Snow Crasher
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy

name: CRYO POP TRIO
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: CRYO POP TRIOcollab with FEHER NYUL

name: Mechanoid
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy

name: Dance Me To the Beach
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Dance me to the palms, sands and juicy lands.Let's get lost in the promise of the hoppy future.DDH double NEIPA with Sabro, El Dorado and Cryo Pop.Silky smooth with notes of coconut, strawberry, apricot and a juicy finish.

name: E-75 Road Rage
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy

name: Honey Bunny
text: Carrot cake juicy milkshake turmeric new england IPA.

name: Lyrium
text: Lyrium je naš sledeći vojnik u Milkshake IPA pohodu koji uz pomoć Sabro hmelja, vanila štapića ostavlja popriličan utisak u svakom smislu.

name: Fruit Fiction
text: Milkshake IPA skrojena od 2 vrste pšeničnog i 2 vrste ječmenog slada. Ovaj igrač iako na prvi pogled nežne prirode nosi u sebi snagu od 6% alkohola. Mosaic i Galaxy hmelj daju mu čvrstinu, ali za ukus se u potpunosti pobrinula jagoda, tačnije šumska jagoda. One su glavne i odgovorne za kremastu finu strukturu i nijansu piva. Vanila štapići uskaču u priču, lagano se poigravajući sa vašim čulima. Na kraju, Milkshake IPA ne bi bila to što jeste bez laktoze koja čini ceo doživljaj slađim.

name: Vanilla Ice Cream
text: Vanilla ice cream Boom! Pivo i sladoled? U želji da napravimo bombastičnu milkshake ipu, napravili smo kolaboraciju sa brendom Nancys ice cream kome je sladoled od vanile zaštitni znak. Vintage devojka Nancy, njihov logo, doživeo je je vizuelnu robotizaciju u sudaru sa našim brendom, naravno ?. Vanilla ice cream, je milkshake ipa od 7% alc sa laktozom, više vrsta hmeljeva koji se bore sa prirodnom vanilom za prevlast u ukusu! Vanilla ice cream, is a milkshake ipa with 7% abv with lactozis,and several types of hops who fight for domination in taste.

name: 7th AB #2 NEIPA
text: 2nd among 7. A juicy & tasty NEIPA with our Swiss brothers from Hoppy People. C'mon!

name: Klaudije
text: Imperatorske mi reči, imam problem i tražim pomoć naroda. Ja, koji sam sedam puta pravio najbolje pivo, imam problem da predstavim osmo! Ne zato što je sledeće u nizu, već zato što sadrži čitavu Galaksiju mentalnih tokova i finih osećanja!Ja, koji sam gradio Mozaik svog života od sedam jednakih delova, imam čast da predstavim osmi! Meni, koji se nesebično nudim ne smeta to što u kaleidoskopu mojih fino gaziranih nota nećete naći mir, već mi je drago da iz haosa izvučete delić zadovoljštine vaših nadraženih čula!To vam garantujem ja, gospodar nove mutne Ipe ministarske, ja, Klaudije!Usudite se da se popnete na moje mesto!

name: Dezerter
text: Svaki dan je borba. Zato nađi vreme stići, uteći i na sjajnom mestu popiti dobro pivo! Pusti da te kremast ukus i osećaj gorskih trava i borove šume odvedu daleko. Sklopite mir. Sa sobom.

name: Mango Gun IPA
text: Mango Gun je drugo kucno pivo Gunners paba.NE IPA sa Citra i Mosaic hmeljevima i dodatkom kase Manga.Ziveli!

name: Strongboi
text: STRONGBOI – A perfectly defined organism built from all three muscle types. His skeletal base is made of barley, oat, and spelt. Cardiac type contains five aromatic hops; Centennial, Equinox, Mosaic, Citra, and Columbus. all of them set in a Whirlpool of dance play. The Juice Machine yeast additionally strengthens muscle fibers with tropical and citrus hops flavor, making a Strongboi, beer of rich taste, pleasant appearance, and well-balanced bitterness. Try Strongboi workout and burn the Carbohydrates now.

name: Firstborn
text: TALUS, STRATA, GALAXY

name: 8th AB - Beer Rate Hunter
text: One of two 8th Anniversary beers brewed for our friends from around the world. This one is dedicated to our brother Max! He adores beer and yes - he's always on a hunt for beer rates!

name: 7th AB #7 NEIPA
text: 7th of 7. From South Korea to Belgrade! Gorilla Brewing & Dogma Brewery are bringing you this NEIPA with 7 hops for 7 years!

name: Monkey
text: Jedno sjajno, ipak mutno, sočno pivo puno svežeg hmelja u kojem ćete umesto gorčine osetiti eksploziju ukusa mandarine, kokosa, manga i drugog tropskog voća.

name: 10 Years - Pomona Neipa DDH
text: Pomona je novi moderni hibdridnikvasac. U fermentaciji Pomonadaje sočni profil breskve, citrusAi tropskOG voća i pojačavakarakteristike vrhunskih hmeljevaNectaron, Talus i eksperimentalnoghmelja HBC1019

name: Hop Valley Werewolf
text: When full moon comes, hop valley worker becomes Hop Valley Werewolf! This juicy beer produced with HBC472 & Styrian Wolf from hop field of our brother Luka Rojnik is dedicated to all hop valley workers! Cheers to ya all & thank u!

name: 6th Anniversary No.6 - Talus NEIPA
text: The newest hop superstar, by many adored Talus gives the most of identity to this anniversary NEIPA for our 6th birthday.

name: Break Point
text: Thiolized Ne IPA.Tropical juice,when yeast unbound thiols and let them free.....have to try this batch.Cascade, Citra, Sabro,El Dorado really shine through

name: New Zealand Crasher
text: Napravili smo izmenu u standardnoj recepturi Crashera i u Dry Hopu se poigrali sa Novozelandskim hmeljevima "Wai-iti" i "Nectaron". Ziveli!

name: Nectaron
text: ?NEW BEERR ALERT ?Novajlija sa 5 vrsta hmelja i 4 vrste slada . Ovde smo prvi put koristili hmelj koji nam dolazi sa novozelandskog tla: Nektaron, prepun intezivnih citrusnih i voćnih aroma ananasa, grejpa, marakuje i breskve u sinergiji sa kvascem Tropikal Paradise. ?

name: Galaxy Defender
text: U galaksiji kojoj dominira industrija, Defender se se pojavljuje kao odgovor na izazove pivopija koji su potrazi sa vrhunskim kvalitetom. Galaxy defender je New England India pale ale, double dry hopped, citrusno i oatmeal pivo sa 6,3% alc

name: HAZY TRAIN
text: Hop forward beer with strong and pleasant bitterness.Medium to light body with wide spectar of aromas from sabro, citra and mosaic.Hazy appearance with rich foamy head on top and silky mouthfeel.

name: Hazy Rocket
text: Hazy Rocket is Dogma's first NE IPA brewed in our brewery. Here is everything about orange and tropical flavors after every sip!

name: Cosmic Crow
text: Nova serija New England Ipe sa hmeljevima Bru 1 i Strata.Aroma i ukus grejpa, marakuje i guave

name: Huddle
text: Huddle is an important thing in American Football as after that action starts! Second of many beers in our "American Football inspired" collaboration with our friends from "99 Jardi" podcast. Easy & summerish, this Session NEIPA is ideal for a start of new NFL season.

name: Big Hazy
text: Dry hopped with Mosaic, Galaxy, Ekuanot, Simcoe and Cryo Pop at a rate of 16g/L.Nice fruity, candy and a bit of danky aromas are what we smelled.

name: Back 2 Back - Belgrade Edition
text: New collab! And the special one again. Same recipe brewed in 2 cities - Belgrade & Prague! This Session NEIPA brings you all  spring can bring us. Easy, sunny yellow & refresh! Hops of the new world with combo of South African one - African Queen & Australian Galaxy. Živeli!

name: Arhipelag
text: Svetla NEIPA osvežavajućih nota havasjkih ostrva i zavodljive zove. Boje žutog safira i laganog tela, poput idealne letnje avanture.

name: Night In Havana
text: Beer that makes you happy, gives you positive energy and brings back that Caribbean vibe. New England IPA with 6,6% ABV and with aromas of lime and papaya.

name: Serbian Haze
text: Hazy IPA packed with Nectaron and Strata and some magic.Done with our friend Niels from Christiania Bryghus.

name: High Five NEIPA
text: Citra, Crush, Motueka, Idaho 7, El Dorado.

name: Tigro Negro
text: This is our second take on a "style" that we call Black NEIPA. Catch it if you can.Made with seven malts and huge amount of oat and wheat flakes it has silky creamy body and a luscious taste.It is DDH with Sladek, Mandarina Bavaria, Idaho 7 and Sabro for a complex aroma and flavor.We'll let you be the judge of this unique brew.

name: Disko
text: Drink with caution! Possible occurrence of euphoria and unrestrained happiness. When your cells start to jiggle, surrender to the rhythm.

name: Mr. Nelson
text: Pilsner slad & Novozelandski "Nelson Sauvin" hmelj u kombinaciji za našu novu "SMASH" Ipu.

name: Aussie Joker
text: Rešili smo da se poigramo sa hmeljevima i standardnoj sladnoj bazi našeg Jokera koga dodamo Nelson Sauvin i Enigma hmeljeve. Kao i uvek na hmelju nismo štedeli stoga se u svakom litru piva nalazi 11g ove predivne biljke. Živeli!

name: ZUMA - MOUNTAIN IPA
text: Zuma is a special dog. And he's a best friend of his owner, Ivan, the founder and author of the best known alternative music radio show in this part of Europe - Pop Depression. Zuma & Ivan like mountains so we created this Mountain IPA with Zappa, Galaxy & Southern Passion hops. Cheers for Zuma & Ivan!
Gentleman's Choice!

name: Mumbai
text: IPA

name: Snake
text: Darkish ipa, smooth taste, not bitter

name: SuperNova
text: Basket full of fruits whose flavors explode and spill over when you approach. A harmonious complex that only an IPA can offer. Be ready to fly away, on a bed of melons, mangoes and tangerines! The first and the best IPA in Serbia by Ratebeer.

name: Single Hop Mandarina
text: The third special from our famous single hop series. Enjoy the authentic taste of Mandarina Bavaria hop.

name: Magnum 357
text: single hop IPA veoma snažnog tela, izuzetne punoće ukusa u kojem preovlađuje ukus karamele savršeno izbalansiran karakterističnom i neočekivanom aromom hmelja Magnum, zaokružen dobro poznatom gorčinom koju ovaj hmelj donosi. Neobično osvežavajuća aroma hmelja sa suptilnim naznakama začina, borovih iglica i višnje u kombinaciji sa slatkom karamelom zagolicaće vaša nepca i pokrenuti sva vaša čula u otkrivanju dubine i kompleksnosti ovog piva. Sve zajedno predstavlja do sada najinteresantnije i najsmelije IPA pivo na našem tržištu.

name: Akira
text: AKIRA - Red IPA rich in tropical fruit and mango aromas.  Tropical wave goes towards well liked American Hops, giving it a sweet and bitter sensation. Refreshing and light, Akira leaves a strong impression instantly with its taste and appearance.

name: Džesika
text: This is one of few house beers of Ministarstvo Beer Bar in Niš (Serbia), available only there and in some rare occasions elsewhere.

name: Pevac
text: Red IPA brewed with Columbus, Citra and Nelson Sauvin.

name: Red Machine
text: Combination of 5 type of malt with Mozaic, Cascade, Amarillo,Centeniel & Columbus

name: Hacker
text: Hacker je developer kome je dosadilo da radi za velike korporacije koje upravljaju našim životima, a misija mu je dekodira industrijski matrix u pivarstvu kojim nas bombarduju  masovni mediji.Hcker Red India pale ale je pivo koje ima odmerenu dozu zahmeljenosti, gorčine i aroma koji daju odlican after taste.Hacker is a developer who is tired of working for the big corporations that run our lives, and his mission is to decode the industrial matrix in brewing that we are bombarded with by the mass media.Hcker Red India pale ale is a beer that has a measured dose of hoppy experience, bitterness and aroma that give an excellent after taste.

name: Born To Rye
text: Our second beer from "100 % draft" series which is going only into kegs. Born To Rye is our version of Rye IPA with 15% of rye malt. Spicy & delicate from both rye and complexity of hop aromas of Amarillo and Simcoe.

name: Hop'Oponopono
text: A dual-hop session IPA with dank and citrusy flavor profile, surprisingly full-bodied for this style of beer. Drinkable, enjoyable with a nice hoppy aroma. ABV 4.5% IBU 40 EBC 9 EXT 11%

name: Don't Shoot the Messenger
text: Times are hard, so we wanted to make them a bit easier with this light bodied hazy session IPA. Super drinkable & citrusy!

name: S.M.A.S.H. HBC 586
text: New episode in our S.M.A.S.H. Session IPA series brings you one of our favourite new hops - HBC 586. After first sip last year at CBC, thru new beers at Brau Beviale in November, here it comes to this part of the Europe for the first time. What a hop!

name: S.M.A.S.H. HBC 1019
text: On 8th Anniversary we're continuing or S.M.A.S.H. series and we're introducing a true hop superstar - ladies & gents, here is HBC 1019!

name: Štrand 3
text: Novosadski eksperiment kraft pivara, Štrand 3 otvara vrata nostalgiji za toplijim danima. Ova šarmantna Session NEIPA obiluje sa isključivo Mosaic hmeljom i jednim netipičnim povrćem - cveklom. Cvekla je glavna i odgovorna za neverovatnu boju i postojano telo ovog piva, dok se citrusne arome prožimaju sa svakim vašim udahom.

name: S.M.A.S.H. Eclipse
text: New episode in our S.M.A.S.H series! We bring you one our favourite Australian hop variety - ECLIPSE. Enjoy every sip!

name: S.M.A.S.H. Simcoe
text: Another one in our Single Malt And Single Hop series! The one and only - SIMCOE!

name: Borka
text: A special for Majstor za Pivo in Sarajevo. Pine freshness of the Balkans as unique as our region.

name: Hopacabana
text: Hopacabana, naš zlatni talas svežine provozaće te kroz nezaboravnu tropsku avanturu bogatu mandarinom, limetom i grejpom. Zavodljiva nežnost, lakoća i bogatsvo aroma povešće te na Hopacabana avanturu iznova i iznova.

name: Less Than an Hour
text: Who knows what can you do for less than an hour? But we're sure that we can have our friends from Podgorica here in Belgrade or fly over to them in the same time. They flew here and we had this super tasty Session IPA refined with Nelson Sauvin, Nectaron and a bit of Citra.

name: Show Your Independence
text: Old school session IPA with all American hop varietes. Super drinkable, a bit dank and real sessionable IPA.

name: S.M.A.S.H. Citra
text: Another one in our SMASH Session IPA. And you all know this hop - it's Citra ladies & gents!

name: S.M.A.S.H. Strata
text: One more from our Single Malt And Single Hop series. Ladies & Gents, meet Strata hops!

name: SMASH Cascade
text: Third beer in our Single Malt And Single Hop series! SMASH Cascade brings you al the characteristics of one of the most popular hops in craft brewing. Sessionable, easy to drink with mix of citrusy and floral aromas from this famous hop!

name: 7th AB #4 Micro IPA
text: 4th of 7. Mikkeller is in da Dogma's house! Micro but super tasty. Perfect for runing with MRC Belgrade Crew!

name: S.M.A.S.H. Chinook
text: First from S.M.A.S.H. series where Dogma will present distinct hop aromas from hops which they use for all their beers. First is Chinook, dual purpose hop which is world-famous Yakima valey superstar. Citrus on aroma, grapefruit & spicy on flavour. Dry & drinkable. Only 4.7 abv.

name: S.M.A.S.H. Sabro
text: Sabro is a new hop superstar! Cause of that, we took it as a main actor in a new episode of Single Malt and Single Hop series. Beer which we releasing on our 4th birthday is super sessionable and perfect for a birthday party! Instead of a cake we're enjoying in subtile Sabro notes of coconut & tropical fruits. Clean and crispy summerish brew!

name: SMALL TALK, Big Brew Micro IPA
text: Serbian part of Dogma Brewery & Hop Hooligans "back to back" collaboration. Low abv, but still medium body with juicy & hoppy profile from Columbus, Comet & Idaho 7 combo!

name: Mugunghwa
text: Mugunghwa, robot lutka iz Korejanske pop kulture koje je našla mesto i u čuvenom serijalu Squid game, inspirisala nas je da napravimo pivo spremno na igru eliminacije sa industrijom. Red light...green light...YOU ARE ELIMINATED! U pitanju je session ipa, odmerene gaziranosti, punog tela i mirisa sa blažim procentom alkohola od 4,8%.

name: S.M.A.S.H. Mosaic
text: Second in our "S.M.A.S.H. Session IPA" series, this beer brings you aroma and flavour of one of our favourite hops - Mosaic! Explosion of tropical aromas comes on a plate of 100% pilsner malt body, clear and crispy as one beer can be.

name: S.M.A.S.H. Mandarina Bavaria
text: Mandarina Bavaria is the most popular German new hop variety. Here it is in our SMASH Session IPA series! Prost!

name: S.M.A.S.H. Galaxy
text: S.M.A.S.H. series continues! Now we travel thru Galaxy to Australian hop fields...

name: Hugo Session IPA
text: Citrus, tropical fruit, pine, and stone fruit with a crisp, refreshing finish. Light-bodied, balanced bitterness, and pronounced hop aroma.

name: 6th Anniversary No.1 - Triple Hoptopod
text: Triple Hoptopod babies! Our bestseller last year was Double, now it's Triple IPA.

name: Slovenski Kollab
text: Dosta hmelja, slada i ruske duše je uloženo u ovaj IPA specijalitet. Pred Vama je Slovenski Kollab pripremljen sa istinski ruskim zanosom. Kolaboracija sa Slovenskom pivarom Hopsbrew. Živeli!

name: Have a Nice Trip
text: Welcome to Serbia and Have a Nice Trip.Beer made with our deLux friends from Totenhopfen Brauhaus.Everything about this beer was a trip for all of us and we can tell you it was an awesome one.From the recipe creation to the label and our trip to misty and mysterious Kosmaj mountain.Double mashed and dry hopped with Mosaic, Enigma and Idaho7.

name: Doctor Triple
text: When new generation of Kors Brewmasters dedicate beer to one and only Mr Yuri that need to be nothing less than Triple Ipa. Columbus, Mosaic, El Dorado, Sabro, Cascade,Bru-1 & Idaho-7

name: SACK
text: SACK! That's always painfull thing for every quarteback. And this Triple IPA brewed in honor of American football, with our friends from Podcast "99 Jardi" will sack you!

name: Nowhere In the World
text: Special beer for special friends! It's  named like this as you definitely can not drink it Nowhere In The World. Except in France as this is an exclusive brew for V and B. Full body, super juicy & potent. Run to V and B stores!

name: Albino
text: Albino is a WIPA. Why? Well, because we believe in hops, but also we like to get into new fields. Now, we're in fields of wheat which gave us an "hybrid" IPA, perfectly balanced with fruity aromas of American and Slovenian hopse, hints of tangerine and orange peel flavour.

name: 6th Anniversary No.4 - Zappa White IPA
text: Zappa hops & white IPA malts. Great combo!

name: Svetlo
text: Hazy golden color with quickly disappearing head and some lacing. Aroma is malty with some floral hops and hint of yeast. Taste is sweet with malt and hops. Its very tasty and balanced beer.

name: Linden
text: Another birthday collaboration with our friends from Pelicon. Our view on this fabulous beer style with a twist of adding the Linden tea before kegging and bottling. So god damn gentle beer!

name: Cigla Crveno
text: Red lager made for Cigla Bar

name: Orthodox Celts Red
text: Copper colored beer, moderately strong body, moderate biterness and a mild caramel aroma. Made in collaboration with Orthodox Celts, Serbian rock bend .

name: Annette
text: Annette je Nemačka škola tamnog piva. Klasićan shwartzbier u našem izvođenju. Bazni Pale Ale slad umiksovali smo sa još 5 vrsta specijalnih sladova i svemu tome dodali prženi ražani hleb. Lager kvasac je tu za uživanje u čistom sladnom ukusu piva. Živeli!

name: Zaječarsko Crno
text: Autentičan ukus i aroma Zaječarskog Crnog su postignuti kombinacijom četiri vrste slada: svetlog, specijalnog, karamelnog i crnog (prženog).

name: Callista & Ariana
text: We brew this beer with a help of our friends from Barth Haas. First ever use of Lupomax hop pellets in Serbia for a beer which celebrates culture & identity of Oktoberfest! Prost!

name: On the Road To Munich
text: Munich is the city we like cause of those silky & tasty beers. This beer is our dedication to this unique & legendary beer place on Planet Earth!

name: Wish & Goal Stadium Lager
text: We like football. We adore beer. Those facts brought us to this great collab with legendary football comentators Viško & Gojko, authors of "Wish & Goal" podcast. Easy Helles inspired by next EURO in Germany. Enjoy it before, during or after stadium!

name: Shatzi (Šaci)
text: Serbian version of the classic German lager.

name: Cyber Punk
text: Cyber punk je kiborg poslat iz budućnosti da spreči dominaciju indistrijskog piva koje se udaljilo od izvornog kvaltetnog lagera štedeći na sirovinama (manje ječmenog slada, forsiranje kukurzne krupice, pregaziran proizvod da sve to zamagli)Cyber punk je kraft lager sa više vrsta visoko kvalitnenog slada, što čini telo piva jakim ali pitkim, u kome se uživa natenane da bi se osetila punoća ukusa koja pravi razliku.Cyber ​​punk is a cyborg sent from the future to prevent the dominance of industrial beer that has moved away from the original quality lager by saving on raw materials (less barley malt, forcing corn, overcarbonated product to cover it all).Cyber ​​punk is a craft lager with several types of high quality malt, which makes the body of the beer strong but refreshing, which is enjoyed slowely to feel the fullness of taste that makes the difference.

name: Brate!
text: Brate! is the beer produced by two brother breweries Dogma & Lambrate. Sessionable, clean and hoppy lager ideal for summer days!

name: Hoppy Sparrow
text: Classic lager beer Dry Hoped with Mandarina Bavaria hops

name: Lokalac Na Internetu
text: Here comes lokalac (local guy) who surfes around worldwide web which parts are our national .rs & .срб internet domains. With our friends from RNIDS, Registry of National Internet Domains of Serbia, we've brewed this West Coast Pilsner, beer style which is in these days super popular among crafters all around the world. Clean & crispy, with Slovenian Styrian Wolf, American Bru-1 and New Zealand Moteuka hops, this ultra drinkable pilsner brings you tropical aromas of citrus, pineapple & vanilla. And yes, we're bringing you sunny days a bit earlier - enjoy it and surf!

name: Kalfa (Калфа)
text: Special dark beer for real beer lovers, intensely hoppy, unfiltered beer.

name: Gvint 5
text: Made from 5 varieties of hops and 5 varieties of  malt. Aromatic and hoppy, but still lager - crisp and refreshing.

name: Vertigo
text: An eccentric German pilsen, whose mandarine and honey notes will  make you see things from a new angle.

name: Hamato Yoshi
text: Hamato Yoshi is Dry Lager made by 50% malt and 50% rice. Unpasteurized but filtrated which makes him extremely drinkable. Also this is beer with apsolutly lowest calories that we ever make.

name: IPPON
text: IPPON is produced in honor of great sport of judo! By buying a can, we're all suport Judo Club "Rakovica".

name: 8th AB - El Niño De Tijuana
text: One of two 8th Anniversary beers dedicated to our friends around the world. This one is for a true craft beer legend, one and only Mario Beltran - El Niño De Tijuana!

name: 6th Anniversary No.3 - Mexican Lager
text: Hombre che pasa!? We've made it easy for this sunshine days. Take a sombrero and smash this crisp & clean festive lager!

name: Podrigez
text: Rezultat kolaboracije sa pivarom Manguliner, nas zajednički prvenac -  Podrigez - Meksicki lagerOvaj stil u pivarstvu je veoma popularan u svetu, pa smo i mi odlucili da napravimo našu verziju, a opisali bi ga kao jako svetlo pivo, niske gorčine, i nešto nižeg postotka alkohola(4,5%), veoma osvežavajućeg koji u sebi sadrži, pored uobičajnih sastojaka, i corn flakes.

name: Sri Lankan
text: Spiced lager

name: Pan Beran
text: Aroma: a fresh malt character with hints of herbal hop.Taste: a pure malt flavour with notes of gentle herbal hops and hints of freshly cut grass. Medium-bodied with moderate creaminess and a light, creamy texture.

name: Vrana
text: Prvi u nizu novog serijala lager piva Vrana.Euro pale lager, najzastupjeniji svetli lager u Evropi.Cist, pitak, osvetavajuc.Prijatan ukus jecmenog slada, i nezna aroma Perle hmelja.Ziveli!

name: Docker Lager
text: ČETIRI VRSTE SLADA, DVE VRSTE HMELJA, DUŽI ROK ODLEŽAVANJA NA NISKIM TEMPERATURAMA I NEOGRANIČENA KOLIČINA LJUBAVI DONELI SU SAVRŠENO BALANSIRAN LAGER PUNOG SLADNOG UKUSA I PRIJATNE GORČINE.  ENGFOUR TYPES OF MALT, TWO TYPES OF HOPS, A LONGER PERIOD OF AGING AT LOW TEMPERATURES AND AN UNLIMITED AMOUNT OF LOVE HAVE BROUGHT A PERFECTLY BALANCED LAGER FULL OF MALT FLAVOR AND PLEASANT BITTERNESS.

name: Megdan
text: Novo kucno pivo Gunners Pub-a, nemacki tip lagera.

name: BIK
text: Collab w Bip

name: Cigla Svetlo Lager
text: Czech Lager

name: Manguliner
text: Lokalno pivo. Sremska Mitrovica

name: Salto Lager
text: Salto Lager unites classic European brewing tradition with the progressive ideas of the craft beer scene. Taking the best from both worlds and carefully selecting ingredients helps us produce an exceptional lager beer. Salto Lager is as refreshing as regular lagers, but it has a more aromatic, nuanced taste. Our brewery is all about attention to detail, making our beer unique and great tasting. Salto is making lager exciting again.

name: Svetlo
text: Lager that is somewhere between the Bavarian (heles) and Czech (pilsner), with just enough barley malt and hops so that the beer has moderate aroma and bitterness.

name: Jelen Nefiltrirano Pivo
text: JELEN NEFILTRIRANO is a pasteurized lager beer with 5,2% alcohol and 12% of beer extract. This beer did not go through the filtration process, so its natural ingredients are present for a longer time and give it a visible cloudiness.Richer taste, real beer freshness and a shorter expiration date are the thing that distinguish it from other filtered lager beers.

name: Zaječarsko Ekstra
text: Зајечарско Екстра Филтрирано је светло, непастеризовано/хладно филтрирано пиво направљено на основу рецептуре Зајечарског светлог. Захваљујући посебној врсти хмеља пиво има благи хербални укус добро избалансиран са оригиналном горчином, што га чини невероватно питким и лаганим.Зајечарско Екстра Филтрирано је пиво врхунског квалитета чија је одлика хладна филтрација која чува оригиналну арому хмеља. Ново паковање са симболом Ртња - најпознатије планине источне Србије јединствене по својој нетакнутој природи, додатно истиче свежину зајечарског бисера.

name: Valjevsko Pivo
text: Pours a clear yellow golden topped with a rather small white head. Aroma of very sweet grains. Taste is bitter but heavy on the metallic feel. Valjevsko Beer is prepared from the best raw materials, according to a traditional recipe. Pleasant bitterness, fine aroma, full taste, drinkability and refreshing effect provide a superb beer consumption experience. During the decades of production, light "Valjevsko pivo" has retained a unique taste and quality that true lovers of the golden drink can appreciate. It is one of the most famous beer brands in our country (Serbia).

name: Jelen Pivo
text: Market leader, Jelen Pivo launched its successful foray into foreign markets. Is present primarily in the markets of neighboring countries: Bosnia and Herzegovina (also a market leader), Macedonia, Croatia and Austria, Switzerland, Greece and Italy.

1722 Mittelfruh Lager je napravljen u čast svih koji su stvarali najlepše vrste piva u Pančevu i širom Balkana, od 1722. godine do sada. U to ime ŽIVELI!Nakon tri stotine godina stvaranja piva u Pančevu, Dilemma Brewery nastavlja prekinutu tradiciju. Naš lager je nemačkog tipa, zahmeljen plemenitom sortom hmelja Halertauer Mittelfruh, nazvan po regiji gde se vekovima uzgaja. Čist ukus, umerene slatkoće sa izraženim notama ječmenog slada – veoma pitko.

name: Dama/Lady - Vienna Lager
text: Dogma Tap Room is the only place where you can find it draft. For our friends from Kafeterija bars we've brewed this first of four in their card editions beers.

name: Braggot On Steroids
text: Kad med susretne slad u ravnomernim količinama nastane Braggot on steroids. 20% meda i 20% slada doneli su "laganih" 11% ALK

name: Braggot
text: Sa 15-30% medovine ili čistog meda u mešavini sladovanih žitarica čine ovaj stari skandinavski stil piva vrlo kompleksnog ukusa. Braggot je ejl u kome je vekovima uživala vikinška kultura. Prirodan šumski med čija aroma dominira, oživljava ukus stare Skandinavije. Akcenat na hmelju u ovom slučaju izostaje, kao što to ovaj stil piva i predviđa.Veoma kompleksno - a pitko.

name: Jelen Cool
text: First Serbian alcohol-free beer!For those who want to on any occasion, anytime and anywhere, enjoy a unique and well-known taste Jelen Pivo, Apatinska brewery has prepared a surprise - soft Jelen Cool!Jelen Cool light beer, made to a special recipe by Apatinska Brewery! Well-known name, & can be consumed anytime and anywhere! Cool Jelen will be available to beer lovers and dynamic range of containers - reusable bottle 0.5l, 0.33 non-refundable bottles can 0.5l. From now on, Jelen offers you a choice in all situations that involve limited alcohol. Chilled to 5 degrees Jelen Cool is the perfect refreshment for the upcoming hot summer days and nights.

name: 1st AMONG OTHERS
text: 1st non alcoholic beer at Serbian craft beer scene. And it's 1st among others we will brew. NA but still with a bit of body & pleasant hop aroma from Galaxy, Mosaic & Mandarina Bavaria.

name: CITRATONIC
text: American Pale Ale with a light body, dry hopped like IPA. Its name says it all, explosion of citrus flavor and aroma with a little bit of bitterness, easy going as tonic.

name: Troll
text: Porodica 3Bir bogatija je za novog člana: Troll – American pale ale predstavnik je sinteze neodoljivih komponenata.  Prvi element dolazi sa dalekog kontinenta okupanog suncem, prožet  paletom razdraganih boja – australijski hmelj Galaxy pokretač je i osovina ovog šarmantnog napitka. Izuzetna aroma citrusa, breskve i strastvenih voćnih mirisa galaxy hmelja osvojiće vas na prvom susretu i omađijaće sva vaša čula. Za drugi element organizovali smo ekspediciju po šumama, gorama i pećinama Skandinavije u potrazi za mitskim bićima -  Trolovima.  Rezultat avanture je opsesivna i zavodnička spoljašnost  uzburkana eksplozijom juice machine kvasca. Troll  Pale Ale – mlad, opsesivni zavodnik koji svakom novom rundom kontinuirano šarmira.

name: Laika
text: Special brew for Sputnik bar in Kragujevac.

name: Apache
text: Izrazito zahmeljeni pale ale, sa dodatkom ovsenih pahuljica i korijandera.Dry hop: Galaxy i Mosaic

name: Grizzly
text: Hops in your veins, lime and pineapple in the mouth. With pale, caramel, wheat and a pinch of rye malt we created this mighty beast that will overwhelm you. Hopped with Simcoe and Amarillo hops, it’s a perfect beer for enjoyment.

name: Mašinovođa
text: Light body with medium bitterness from nugget hops.Flavored with mosaic and simcoe hops.Enjoy

name: Ministarsko
text: Mildly bitter, rich citrus aroma.

name: The Boyz Are Back In Town
text: DDH Pale ale on somewhere between east and west coast. Hopped at the start and the end of fermentation with Simcoe, El Dorado and Enigma.

name: Salto Pale Ale
text: Dry hopped like IPA, drinkable as APA. Loads of hops, hint of caramel in background. That is the the secret to this all-seasons classic.

name: Cura Pale Ale
text: Special release brewed for Loft coffee & lounge bar, Novi Sad.

name: Gunners Pub APA
text: Gunners Pub (Braće Jugovića 2a) u saradnji sa Crow Brewery (Vranovo) je napravio Gunners Pub pivo.Stil: American Pale Ale (APA)Alc: 5.3%

name: Beogradski Fantom
text: Beogradski Fantom - DDH APA, exclusively made for Belgrade Beer Fest 2022

name: Gecko
text: American Pale ale from Serbian Crow brewery. Nice aromatic taste and pleasant bitterness. Mosaic and Equinox hops, as per description. Good beer!

name: Kick Off
text: It's time to KICK OFF new NFL season. 3rd of many collaborations inspired by American Football brewed with our friends from the best regional NFL podcast - 99 JARDI. Easy drinkable, perfect for every match. Kick it off!

name: BAD HORSIE
text: SIMPLE REFRESHING LIGHT AND TASTY

name: Maharadža
text: Mosaic

name: Akrobata
text: Our little acrobat is full of tricks and stunts and is always ready to entertain a curious mind.The idea behind this beer is to always change something in the recipe.This time we changed the ratio of hops and we increased the dry hop ratio a bit.Dry hopped with:55,5% Citra33,3% Enigma11,1% Loral0,1% Magic

name: Mozaik
text: A walk by the pine trees in your mouth, mango and caramel, enjoy the spicy finish.

name: Wild Orange
text: Opasno zahmeljen, mutan i zavodljiv, bučan i mio. Bez pravila. Buntovnik!

name: Easy Rider
text: Zahmeljeno pivo citrusne arome lagano za celodnevnu “vožnju”

name: BrrKaaa
text: Road trip with the smell of lemon, orange and a wind in your hair! A beer that made people smile in over 25 countries. The one and only Mr B!

name: Svetionik Pale Ale
text: Svetionik is easy drinking pale ale created with influences of American and German brewing school. Light body and properly hoppy beer with bitternes, whirlpool and dry hop additions. Ideal Beer for every day in a year!

name: Navigator
text: American-style pale ale

name: Temper
text: Temper: (n), a particular state of mind or feelings; a habit of mind; (v), to bring to a proper, suitable, or desirable state by or as by blending. Temper is just that - a beer that might just be habit-forming, blended meticulously for beer connoisseurs of each and every kind into an irresistibly drinkable beer. A beer for anytime, any state of mind, and every taste. Your everyday beer that’s not just your everyday beer. Borrowing from both the English and American pale ale brewing traditions, Temper pulls together the best elements of both heritages to make a beer that is part old-school, part new-school, but uniquely its own. Fine toasted notes of pale and lightly caramelized malts echo the rich tradition of English pale ales, giving this ale a honey-like, tawny hue and rounded body, while a healthy dose of bright American and Serbian hops bursting with citrus and floral zest, bolstered with notes of cedar and herbs announce that this beer is a beer of today. And one that’s here to stay. Smooth, savory, enticing, mellow, refreshing; finely tempered.

name: Neon Planet
text: Synthwave muzika, francuski haus i italo disco nas inspirišu, 80-te i čitav taj vajb kreativnosti, ludih boja i futurističkih momenata. Neon planet je pale ale koji te lagano uvodi u svet naših ale stilova. Pivo za opuštanje u bilo kom periodu godine, sa laganih 4,2% alc. Synthwave music, french house and italo disco inspire us, 80s a all that vibe of creativity, vivid colors and futuristic elements. Neon planet is a pale ale which introduces a slow entry to the world of our ale styles. A berr to chill abd relax with, all yerar round, with and light abv of 4,2%.

name: Bruce
text: Our new beer for our friends Samo_pivo for their 10th Birthday anniversary. Australian Pale Ale with Nelson Sauvin, Motueka & Galaxy hops.

name: Docker Ale
text: 100% Pilsner slada fermentisanog sa Ale kvascem i bez dry hopa. Bistro,pitko i balansirano. Idealno resenje za "lagerase" ili pivopije kojima su ale piva za sada strana.

name: Kobajagi
text: Special brew for Samo pivo! bar

name: Maćedo
text: Inspired by the Domaćica music scene, maćedo is an ale styled brew highlighting ingredients from region, blending Serbian bacon flavor with dried orange zest from Croatian island of Vis, infused with a hint of sea salt from Piran, Slovenia.

name: Miss Quince
text: Easy drinking pale ale brewed with quince which was added at the end of the boil and in whirlpool. Special beer when we speak about (special) fruit addition.

name: Mangolorian
text: Mangolorian Novi robot se probija kroz pustinju koja je za sobom ostovila masovna proizvodnja industrijskog piva i donosi ti milkshake osveženje u vidu punog ukusa manga, citrusa i tropskih hmeljeva!Our new robot makes its way through the desert left behind by the mass production of industrial beer and brings you milkshake refreshment in the form of a full taste of mango, citrus and tropical hops!

name: Mr. Moose
text: DDH New England Pale Ale sa Sabro i Citra hmeljevima.Aroma I ukus vinogradarske breskve, kokosa i mandarine.Ziveli!

name: 1019 IS NOW DOLCITA
text: We're just saying that this juicy pale ale is a younger brother of our 1019 NEIPA. What do you think? True or false?

name: Lazy & Hazy
text: New England style pale ale designed with chill in mind. Just relax, enjoy and forget about the world.Light grain bill, light in color, with hints of citrus and lychee and abv of just 4,3% it is a beer for every day.Just look at that color.

name: Kaleidoskop
text: DDH pale ale heavily dry hopped with Citra, Galaxy and Vic Secret. Supported with Centennial and Sabro and fermented with experimental yeast from Lallemand.

name: Susegado
text: We present to you "Susegado" derived from lifestyle associated with indian state of goa which depicts there laid back, relaxed & carefree attitude towards life and there 'art of contentment'. With our first beer we wanted to bring somthing new to beer lovers but keeping it true to feeling of susegad. Our Susegado is a New England extra pale ale with 4.5% alc. This hazy little sipper consists of rich malt bill of 5 different malts to give it smooth velvety mouthfeel which supports heavy dose of magnum, simco & Centennial. Expect ever so slight bitterness at the same time bright citrusy flavours (think lemon peel, grapefruit), pine & subtle dank fruityness, which gives way to subtle aromas of peach & orange.

name: Futurisma
text: Futurisma je retro-futuristički način razmisljanja o pivu, svakim gtljajem se pitate da li ste probali nešto slično.U pitanju je hazy new england american pale ale, izrazito žute boje, extra zahmeljenosti i jakih citrnusnih nota, manga , blagog procenta alkohola, što je čini izuzetno pitkom. Kvalitetan kvasac I tehnologija njegove upotrebe joj daje mogućnost da telo piva bude mutno a izrazito svetlo sa kremastom penom. Futurisma is a retro-futuristic way of thinking about beer, with every sip you wonder if you have tried something similar.It is hazy new england american pale ale, distinctly yellow in color, extra hoppy and strong citrus notes, mango, a mild percentage of alcohol, which makes it extremely drinkable. Quality yeast and the technology of its use give it the opportunity to keep the body of the beer cloudy and extremely light with creamy foam.

name: Hobbiton
text: U srcu zelenih brežuljaka leži selo Hobbiton, dom bezbrižnih Hobita, ljubitelja dobrog piva, smeha i priča. Inspirisani njihovim svetom, donosimo vam Hobbiton, pivo koje nosi duh radosti i uživanja , sunce Novog Zelanda u  čaši!Upoznajte našu najnoviju čaroliju, lagani dodir slada koji se igra sa eksplozijom aroma Nelson Sauvin hmelja. Ovaj dragulj sa Novog Zelanda donosi neodoljive note sočnog ogrozda, elegantnog belog vina i egzotičnog tropskog voća, uz prefinjene nijanse slatke marakuje i sveže zgnječenog grožđa, baš sve što krasi i vino Sauvignon Blanc!

name: Kole Pale Ale
text: Kole pale ale karakteriše dominantan ukus breskve uz osvežavajuću gorčinu koja potiče od hmelja Magnum.

name: This Dog Goes To Heaven
text: This dog definitely went to heaven. Two years ago a sad, wounded and neglected dog entered the Dogma Tap Room. Our colleagues took him to the veterinarian and few weeks after, a new dog was reborn - SIMA was the name of this healthy, crazy and above all beloved host of Dogma Tap Room. A few weeks ago we found him behind the brewery. Only the rainy night knows the story of his end. In a memory of our SIMA, we brewed this pale ale with a strong message, cause every pet goes to heaven. We're sure!

name: Shinigami - Appuru APA
text: Japanski duhovi, shinigamiji, koji su zaduženi za selekciju onih koji prelaze s ovog na drugi svet, inspiracija su nam za našu appuru apu. Oni prate svakog pojedinca, njihov život, odluke. Naš robotizovani Shinigami, u japanskoj pop kulturi mnogo voli da jede vrhunske jabuke, stoga je savršen za pale ale sa jabukom od 5% alc.Japanese ghost, the shinigami, whos purpose is to select those who cross between worlds, inspired us to brew a craft apple apa. They watch over every individual, their life decisions. Our robotized shinigami, in japanese pop culture is a big fan of apples. Therefore, he is a perfect avatar for our apa of 5% abv, mixed with japenese apples and mint.

name: TRKAČ
text: Six years after we started this run with our friends from BURT - Belgrade Urban Running Team, here comes again "the fastest recovery drink for them! Hop combo of Cascade, Columbus and Mandarina Bavaria gives this beer subtle fruity aroma. Perfect after easy jogging or long marathon. Run, enjoy & recover yourself!

name: Blagoejl
text: Blagoejl is a unique brew for a unique person. Our brother for whom evil people will say that he is a part of Dogma Tap Room inventory just got a special brew from us - for his 40th birthday!   Crazy drinkable Pale Ale just as he wanted it to be - super comercial! :D Long live Blagoje!

name: Student
text: Stired on the surface, light and unfiltrated undernaeth; just like the young mind. The smell of elder motivates like the semester completed with high grades. Energetic pale ale with a ambitious taste

name: Kašper Rye Pale Ale
text: Pale Ale brewed for the bar Cašper in Budva Montenegro

name: Retro Sickness
text: Blast from the past! Miks hmeljeva, citrusa i dunje vodi te na retro put synth-a i povratak u budućnost! Lagani ABV od 5% za svačiji ukus! JOIN THE ROBOLUTION!

name: Dramatičnjak Herbal Ale
text: Sa našim drugarima iz Meli Plants i narodnim travarom Momčilom Antonijevićem napravili smo pravu dramu! U lagani ejl dodali smo tinkturu matičnjaka i djumbira i dobili ovo sjajno prolećno pivo.

name: Silk Road
text: Born in the East, brewed in the West. Enriched by the delicate perfume of lychee, spiked with a hint of black pepper. The perfect complement to exotic Asian flavours. A private label of Istok restaurant in Belgrade.

name: Trkač Session Ale
text: He’s running. He likes to party. He has laser eyes. He’s eating kilometeres every day. He’s member of a Belgrade Urban Runing Team. He’s a Runner!

name: Multnomah Falls / Pacific Northwest Pilsner
text: First of many beers dedicated to our Hop Harvest Tour 2025! On the road from Portland to Yakima Valley, there are Multnomah Falls - place where nature shows you raw power & beauty. We were enchanted by meditational power of this falls which have story of 400.000 years. And we needed to brew beer in that name! Pacific Northwest hops combo brings enligntment in a glass!

name: 7th AB #1 American Pilsner
text: 1st among 7. Collab with our brothers & sister from Gvint Brewery. Celebration can start!

name: Švejk
text: Another brew with special dedication to Czech brewing school. Brewed as a surprise for a visit of a Czech Minister of Agriculture with 100% Saaz. Czech delegation said that we did great job. Our hearts are warm!

name: Ernest
text: Czech style pilsner lagerPredstavljamo vam gospodina „ERNESTA“, zaštitno lice našeg novog kraft lagera u stilu Czech pilsner lager!ERNEST Bošnjak je prvi jugoslovenski reditelj, snimatelj, producent i jedan od osnivača naše kinematografije!Veliki Somborac koji je poznat po otvorenosti ka novim idejama, poduhvatima, a mi ćemo pretpostaviti i ukusima!Vizionar i naša velika inspiracija kada je motivacija u pitanju!

name: Šlager
text: Nemačko lager pivo sa šmekom. Kombinacija nemačke doslednosti i pitkog Perle hmelja daje notu zavodljivosti. Pitak, veseo, razigran, šarmantan! Pravi šlager! Zavešće vas i stalno ćete mu se vraćati!

name: Wartburg Pils
text: Blizak rođak Šlagera, Wartburg je lagani nemački pilsner koji će vas osvežiti i okrepiti u momentu. Suptilne note piva, probudiće vaše čulo ukusa i pripremiti za sve ono što Vam sledi u toku dana.

name: German Pilsner
text: Light, not filtered, not pasteurized beer. Bitter, smooth, typical representative of the best-selling beer in the world.

name: New Pils On the Block
text: Everyboy speaks about "back to basics" trend.  This is our answer. Our first traditional style lager. With a twist. Clean and crispy, with noble, floral and slightly fruity hop aroma. At the end, semi dry to sweet mouthfeel. New Pils On The Block - pils with a twist!

name: Blessed By Ignorance
text: Yes, we're Blessed by Ignorance! With our brother & sister from Totenhopfen Brauhaus we've brought the light to our brewing temple of Dogma. Imperial one! Saphir, Perle and Tettnanger hops are bringing floral & honey touch to this seriously strong Pilsner. Are you Blessed by Ignorance?

name: Ciaone!
text: "Ciaone" is not the same as "Ciao". This Pilsner is not the same as other Pilsners. This one is Italian Pilsner we've brewed with our friends from Nama Brewing.

name: Tony
text: Italian Style Pilsner

name: Sir John Benedict
text: Ovo pivo je u svemu izbalansirano. Skuvano da traje. Zahmeljeno je tako da upotpuni i ojača hmeljnu notu jednog čistog i pitkog Pilsnera. Dodali smo mu dry hop sa Citrom, ali smo uspeli da zadržimo i hmeljnu aromatiku fantastične Calliste, koju smo dobili iz samog procesa kuvanja. Spoj citrusnih i cvetnih nota ova dva hmelja, pokazao se kao odličan potez.

name: R'N'R Star
text: Nefiltrirani nepasterizovani Pilsner napravljen po zajedničkoj recepturi sa Gunners Pubom.

name: Čika Alberto
text: Čika Alberto is the first installment of the "Čika" beer series, presenting traditional beer styles. Čika Alberto is dedicated to our dear friend Alberto Taddeo who is most "at fault" that Crow Brewery even exists. Cheers!

name: Jagodinsko Pivo
text: An European Pale Lager with a rich history dating back to 1852. It is known for its finely balanced bitterness and rich foam, offering a clean and refreshing taste with a 4.8% ABV. The beer pours a hazy medium gold with a white head and has an aroma of grainy lager malt with hints of caramel and grassy hops. The flavor profile includes grainy lager malt, light caramel, and corn sweetness, making it a satisfying choice for beer enthusiasts.

name: Harry Porter And the Kidney Stone
Olga
text: Our special made for Brazil, the best beer of Serbia by Ratebeer. Strong but smooth, just like a real woman.

name: 10 Years - Baltic Porter
text: Po BJCP klasifikaciji opisuje se kao:tradicionalno pivo iz država koje imajuizlaz ka Baltičkom moru. Nezvaničnostil koji smo napravili zove se ImperialPorter. Glavna karakteristika ovogpiva je izraženi sladni aromatskiprofil, dobijen kombinacijom sedamsladova. Specijalni sladovi doprinoseukusu karamele, oraha, suvog voća,tamni sladovi daju note čokolade ikafe. Ovaj stil fermentiše isključivo saLager kvascem. U tank za odležavanjepiva potopili smo hrastov čips, kojije prethodno obogaćen domaćimviskijem koji je pre 6 godina dobijendestilacijom našeg crnog piva. Kakobismo dobili razvijeni aromatski buke,pivo je odležavalo 7 meseci zajedno sahrastovinom.

name: Dockers Hook
text: Winter is perfect time for a dark beer. Robust Porter, beer style originating from industrial docks we twicked with cold brew addition of hand roasted artisanal Columbia coffee. Distinctive "roasty" aroma with a pleasant coffee & nuts flavour fulfills medium body of this winter brew. We've joined brewing forces with our friends from East Side Brewery and brought you beer for the upcoming festive days!

name: Docker's Hook Brasil
text: At our docks we now have Brasil coffee beans which we've added to our traditional winterish brew - Docker's Hook Robust Coffee Porter.

name: Porterccino
text: In the name of all Port workers we make a tribute with one classic easy drinkable Porter with Columbian espresso coffe and cocoa.

name: Docker's Hook Guatemala
text: Second year in a row, we brought ourselves to docks and produced traditional Robust Porter with an addition of coffee. We've used artisanal coffee from a local roastery. Now we boosted aroma & flavour with Guatemala beans. It's a coffee porter time!

name: Uteha
text: This honey porter is our collaboration brew with creative Zagovor brewery from Russia.

name: Olga On Cardamom
text: A special beer created for Brazil, the best beer of Serbia by Ratebeer.

name: Coco Viking
text: Coco Viking je #RyePorter, crno nefiltrirano i nepasterizovano pivo, jedino koje može da utoli žeđ neustrašivih Vikinga za bitkom kad iz okova snega i leda pođu u tropske krajeve. Arome kokosa i čokolade učinkovito razgaljuju njihove nemilosrdne duše.Ukratko, egzotika koja je zavela Vikinge! SKÅL!

name: Dr Jekyll
text: EBC 152

name: JaffaMania
text: Awarded beer, brewed with Jaffa cakes.

name: Porter
text: English type of beer, once a favorite beverage of the workers at the river docks. The sweet aroma and the roasted flavor, come from the special kinds of malt as well as its dark brown, almost completely black and hypnotic appearance. Take a bite of the finest dark chocolate with coffee or just drink our Porter to feel the same.

name: Pastrami Wanna Be
text: Our first smoked beer among all those 170+ we brewed! And we launching it as an add on to our Pastrami sandwich. Try both and enjoy if you admire smoke!

name: Hollow Pumpkin
text: Hollow Pumpkin is a liquid pie with addition of baked pumpkin, clove and cinnamon. Or it's a beer? Try it and tell us!

name: Loki
text: Loki je Amber Ale, srce od hmelja u telu od slada. Ovo slatkorečivo i ubedljivo crveno pivo obuće vam leteće cipele za haranje nebom i dozvoliti vam da na kratko budete neko drugi.Ako spletkarite s Lokijem, čeka vas zabava bez premca. SKÅL!

name: Bad Copy
text: When Bad Copy rhymes became a beer, this is the result. Bitterness that puts a smile on your face, fat rhymes and beats that flow through your body and foam and taste that stay to linger. Dirt is missing but beer can not be dirty that is why is red. Cheers!

name: Red Ale
text: Prvo somborsko zanatsko pivo namenjeno ljubiteljima piva koji se prvi put susreću sa kraft pivom. Odlikuje ga blaga karamelna nota od prženog slada koja mu isto vreme daje I tamniju, crvenu boju. Umerene je gorčine I laganog tela.

name: Bandiera Rossa
text: A red flag rises and a revolution begins. And at RazBeerBriga, the craft beer revolution begins locally. The first new-age craft beer to be brewed using only exclusively Serbian grown hops, and generously malted, Bandiera Rossa unfurls a brilliant crimson as it pours, the product of slow-roasted, caramelized grains, while savory aromas of orange peel, flowers, and pine rise in the background from the combination of Cascade, Centennial, and Chinook hops. A rich, yet balanced beer, Bandiera Rossa is crafted to evoke and celebrate the spirited interplay of malt and hops. Hints of biscuit sweetness are punctuated with bright floral and citrus bursts. Earthy, piney resin runs up against a dry, toasty finish. What results is a highly quaffable, yet sophisticated sipping beer, made from the passionate labor of us here at RazBeerBriga’s craft brewery. Raise your red flag and join us in a cheer!

name: Donegan's Irish Red
text: This beer is a tribute. Tribute to our friend & beer lover. This beer is a tribute to an Irishman. From his hometown of Portlaoise in Irish Midlands till Begrade when we met him, he was delivering positivity, proudness & unique humor. All the aspects of true Irish. We're bringing you true Irish Red Ale. Light in hops and low ABV but rich & smooth in mouthfeel  with caramel & biscuit silkiness. Great beer for a session with your fellow Irishman. Available as a Nitro & regular draft. Believe us - as our dear Donegan likes to say, you will also shout - "Oi, hit me with one for the road!"  Sláinte!

name: Filozof
text: Objedinjuje aromu karamele i gustu penu u životnu filozofiju koju treba okusiti. Prijemčiva intelektu dovoljno snažnom da se nosi sa zdravom dozom gorčine koja je prožima.

name: Crven Ban (Црвен Бан)
text: First red ale

name: The Age of Lamb
text: Another collab! And this one is inspired by Bavarian meeting with our friend Daniel from Garage Beer Co. & his love with food. And not some food - with Serbian lamb. He enjoyed food, we all together enjoyed brewing. This is a new start. This is The Age Of Lamb!

name: Tamno
text: Slightly higher percentage of alcohol and more extract than Gvint classic lager. More intense taste, with coffee and chocolate aroma.

name: Jelen Fresh Limun & Nana (Lemon & Mint)
text: It is summer version of radler style beer with Lemon, but with added flavor of mint (Nana tea). It is very refreshing, and you wont be disapointed

name: Jelen Fresh Grejp
text: The distinctive taste of Jelen Pivo in combination with refreshing grapefruit and reduced alcohol content of 2% is an excellent choice for those who love the taste of beer and non-beer types, but they are certainly looking for the ideal refreshment and new tastes that brings enjoyment.This unique beer on the domestic market is available in returnable glass bottles of 0.5 l non-returnable glass bottles of 0,33 l and 0,5 l cans. Jelen Fresh Grapefruit is a beer for every occasion and all seasons, great thirst quencher and is a choice that will satisfy the need to indulge in a unique and entirely new taste of beer that starts the party.

name: Jelen Fresh Limun
text: Characterized by reduced bitterness, low percentage of alcohol by only 2%, and a light, refreshing notes of fresh lemon juice.At any time, an unforgettable night out or afternoon having fun with friends, Jelen Fresh lemon is the right choice for refreshment that brings an overwhelming flavor of beer with lemon.

name: Leskovačko Dimljeno
text: Prvih nekoliko gutljaja ovog piva će vas verovatno iznenaditi svojom aromom. Radi se o premium lager pivu koje karakteriše dimljeni slad. Posebnim načinom proizvodnje pivo dobija različite nivoe punog i intenzivnog, dimljenog ukusa. Ovo pivo savršeno ide uz sve vrste mesa, pogotovo roštilja i pečenja gde otvara nove dimenzije i stvara balans ukusa.

name: Apricot Berliner Weisse
text: Berliner Weisse with apricot added  in secondary fermentation.

name: Raspberry Attack
text: Malina napada sva čula u prisustvu od čak 20% čistog voća u pivu.

name: 6th Anniversary No.2 - Apricot & Tarragon Sour
text: B*BOP Fermentory is in da Dogma house! :) We've combined apricot & tarragon in this super delicious sour. Hell yeah!

name: Velvet Whisper
text: Collab with BIERlab.Let the fruity whispers guide you trougha tapestry of velvety dreams and etherealflavors.Fruited sour with loads of rhubarb and strawberry and a gentle amount of lactose.

name: Lime Vs Kiwi
text: U 1000l piva dodali smo 220 kg kiwija i 20 kg limete. Medjutim, limeta je doslovce nokautilara kiwi koji je pobegao iz ove borbe i doziveo nokaut u prvoj rundi. Rezultat je pitko kiselo, citrusno i ekstremno osvezavajuce pivo sa laganih 4.4%.

name: Pasji Trn (Облепиха)
text: Pasji Trn poznat još i kao Vučji Trn i "Облепиха" poznat je Širom sveta kao jedna od najzdravijih biljaka na svetu. Ovoga puta ovaj izvor vitamina završio je u našem pivu. Živeli!

name: Shasta Fay
text: Fruited sour with loads of watermelon, pineapple and lime juice.

name: 3birCuz Apricot Sour
text: U pitanju je Smoothie Sour u koji je dodato 350 kg kaše od kajsija pravo iz voćnjaka @beercuz.ns pivare sa obronka Fruške gore. Beercuz pivara, pored toga što je obezbedila sirovine, takođe je umešala prste u samo kuvanje ovog kiselkastog i osvećavajućeg piva.

name: 8th AB - Crate Digger
text: One of two "music" collabs for our 8th Anniversary. This one was created with and dedicated to a Serbian hip hop legend - Timbe. Beside his great rap flow, he is a great DJ and true crate digger!

name: Nuh Badda Mi
text: Special made for 10th birthday of Samo Pivo.Sour made with pineapple and ginger.

name: Thursday Morning Sour
text: Thursday Morning Sour - Crvena ribizla i grejp isprepleteni su u nestašnom plesu koji hipnotiše sva čula. Kiselkaste teksture sa naznakom sladunjavosti, Thursday Morning Sour razoružava.

name: 5th Anniversary Beer #2 - Black Currant & Lime Sour
text: 5 BEERS FOR 5 YEARS! #2 in our 5th Anniversary Beer edition - summerish & fruity. Local black currants boosted with a bit of lime juice. Low ABV with high drinkability.

name: Apricot Ginger & Mint Sour
text: New sour in our crew! After "older sister" Raspberry Mint, here comes a combination of apricot puree, ginger juice and macerated mojito mint! Prepare for summer & enjoy!

name: Dirty Old Snake
text: Inspired by Snakebite & black, drink combined of beer, cider and black currant. Imperial & fruited sour with addition of apple & black currant. Strong & nasty like a dirty old snake!

name: Peachwise
text: Šta se dešava kada se u prostoriji sastanu ljubitelji piva? Ukratko: PeachwisePeachwise je Sour nastao u kolaboraciji dve novosadske kraft pivare: Beerokrate i 3bir. Sour stil nije bez razloga prvi letnji izbor mnogih od nas. Sa sobom nosi prepoznatljive kiselkaste finese i osveženje za kojim žudimo. Peachwise ukusom preovladava slasna breskva koje, da vam pravo kažemo, ima u izobilju. Posmatrajte to ovako: ako vam se prvi zalogaj breskve čini kao neodoljiv doživljaj, Peachwise će vam pričiniti nezaboravno iskustvo.

name: Pinman / Nitro & Mint Edition
text: We changed it a bit. Added mint for the freshness & nitro in fermentor for smoothness. Super refreshing!

name: Friday Morning Sour
text: Šta kazete za pivo sa trešnjom? Trešnja je specifično voće jer se uglavnom konzumirama sirova, retko se od nje prave neke poslastice, dzemovi, kolači i zato nam je bila izazov, ali i rizik .Za još bogatiji ukus i boju dodali smo divlju borovnicu  i dobili pivo sa 5,6% alkohola. Proverite da li se rizik isplatio

name: The Empress
text: After we've created The Emperor few years ago, now its time to presentes The Empress! Be ready for Her Greatness! ????

name: Cherry Kiss
text: Sok domaćih ceđenih višanja pomešali smo sa ukiseljenom sladovinom i sve to začinili ekstratom prirodnog destilovanog badema. Ova kiselo slatka kombinacija u tečnom stanju odaje počast čuvenoj kombinaciji sladoleda od višnje i Italijanskog Amareta.

name: Bring the Sunshine Babe
text: We need sun in this cold & grey times. O yes, we need it! Can we get it thru this sour fruited with Passion fruit, Papaya and Guava? O yeah! Bring the sunshine babe!

name: 7th AB #6 Cherry Mojito Sour
