text: 6th of 7. Our brother Lee joined forces with us to brew this cocktail in a glass. Cheers!

name: 8th AB - Boja Nara
text: One of two brewery collabs for our 8th Anniversary. Boja nara is in Serbian "colour of pomegranate" and it's a a name dedicated of a legendary movie of Armenian director Sergej Parajanov.

name: Mango Ginger & Mint Sour
text: Our fruited & mint sour family got new member. After success of Apricot, here comes Mango! Perfect liquid mixture for hot summer days!

name: Sombor Sour
text: Raspberry sourSombor grad najviše voli svoje letnje dane! Tim povodom napravili smo za vas „Sombor Sour“ pivo od najsočnijih i najlepših malina! Svojim osvežavajućim, pitkim i voćnim notama razbudiće vas i po najtoplijem letnjem danu! A celu priču najbolje predstavlja jedan od čuvenih Somborskih murala, koji smo odabrali i za dizajn ovog piva! Mural čuvenog linnch-a, rađen 2017 za termimalfestival!

name: Raspberry Mint Sour
text: Freshness in a glass. Simple as that.

name: PINMAN
text: PINMAN is a superhero. He will brake the walls and bring us fresh jungle waves of PINapple and MANgo in this easy drinking sour.

name: Dream Machina
text: Dream Machina Ludi fermentor je jedva čekao da izbaci naš prvi sour, dry hopped, kombinaciju ribizle, limuna i borovnice, punog tela i nezaboravnog ukusa!The crazy tank couldn't wait to produce our first sour 5% alc, dry hopped, a combination of currant, lemon and blueberry, full bodied and unforgettable taste!

name: Inversion
text: A collaboration brew with Bakunin from Russia with love.

name: 7th AB #5 Lime & Ginger Berliner Weisse
text: 5th of 7. Lambrate is here again babies! Light, fruity & zesty!

name: Soul Sista
text: Soul Sista is the sour sister of our Miss Quince! Refreshing and fruity, this berliner weisse was boosted with addition of quince, lime & lemongrass.

name: Gargojl
text: Traditional German Gose with raspberries made specially for Samo Pivo pub.

name: Lime Vs Cucumber
text: Nastavljamo sa kombinacijama Lime-a ali ovoga puta sa predivnim i pitkim krastavcem koji će dolazak lepog vremena učiniti još divnijim.

name: Citrus Bastard
text: Sta se desi kada se pomesaju stvari koje su na prvi pogled neocekivan spoj? Gose Bastard #2 je kiselo slano pivo uz dodatak soka od limuna, grejpa, pomorandze i mente.

name: Super Can Fest Special Brew / Pear & Coriander Gose
text: One of two special brews for our Super Can Fest 2022 - and our second collaboration brew with White Dog Brewery brother!

name: Just A Berry Gose
text: Last year we brew it with our Lambrate brothers. This year we brew it by ourselves and we have updated it! Beside black currant, jostaberry and ginger, we have added blackberry. Still salty and sour, still full of flavour and balanced!

name: 6th Anniversary No.5 - Blackberry & Lime Gose
text: It needs to be sour & salty. But it's also fruited! With pleasent combo of blackberry puree & lime juice & peel.

name: Bloody Rosemary
text: She arrives from the cherry orchard with rosemary in her hair. Her name is Bloody Rosemary!

name: Carnival
text: A special with pineapple and red peppercorn brewed for Brazil.

name: Danube Fruit Stew
text: Da li postoji savršeno letnje pivo?Sa Danube Fruit Stew u rukama odgovor je: Da! Malina i crna ribizla glavni su akteri čarobnog napitka nastalog u saradnji pivare 3bir i Nova Runda. Smoothie sour perfektno uglađenih manira i raskošnih ukusa. Senzacija prirodnog domaćeg voća, slada, hmelja i galantnog tropskog ukusa vanile rajski su vrt za svačije nepce. Bogato fruktozom, vitaminima i organskim kiselinama, šarmantne interakcije sa sopstvom svakog pojedinca, napitak koji podjednako osvaja i dame i džentlmene.Danube Fruit Stew, osvežavajući Smoothie sour pravi je izbor za krepkost duha i tela.

name: Wild Crow Cheesecake
text: Čiz kejk pivo?Zašto da ne :D

name: Wednesday Morning Sour
text: WEDNESDAY MORNING SOUR će Vas iznenaditi svojim prijatnim kiselkastim tonovima i krepkošću.Nar i šipurak su glavni odgovorni za preovlađujuće voćne note u ovom pivu.

name: Tomato Gose
text: Collab with Samo Pivo and TT Eatery.Spicy, salty and delicious.

name: Tomato Bastard
text: Sta se desi kada se pomesaju stvari koje su na prvi pogled neocekivan spoj? Gose Bastard #1 je kiselo slano pivo uz dodatak soka od paradajza, bibera i tobasco sosa.

name: Bloody Marriage - Tomato, Pepper & Basil
text: Dogma Brewery & Beer Sheep have a long lasting relationship. It's a bussines, but first is friendship. With this exclusive brew this relationship becomes "Bloody Marriage" when we celebrate Beer Sheep's 3rd Birthday.  Tomato, pepper & basil with lot of salt for juicy & veggie gose!

name: Drunk Grandpa
text: Limun, Djumbir i med u kombinaciji sa 7% alkohola pretvoriće i obične prilike u specijalne i za pamćenje.

name: You Happy, Me Happy
text: A real gastro special Belgian tripel with several species, our birthday beer.

name: Alien
text: An interesting mix of a pale ale with tea from the Rtanj mountains of Serbia, which adds a discrete herbal tang as an aftertaste. This beer is another collaboration projects between the Serbian Crow brewery from Vranovo and the German Lenny's Artisanal Ales.

name: Melisa
text: Zen master. Melissa, the secret ingredient carefully gathered from the slopes of Kosmaj. Unusual, slightly reddish pale ale.  It is time to relax.

name: Rufaro
text: Taste of well being with your every sip. Herbal beer with one of the oldest and most amazing plants.

name: Black Rider
text: It’s dark. Pitch-black. Impenetrable. But do not fear – this darkness is on your side. It’s the Black Rider. No grim figure here, this is a hearty stout, robust in body, strong in character, yet silky smooth in its arrival, like a proud, swarthy knight striding forward on a full-blooded ebony stallion. And this no ordinary dark beer, but an ale that is the culmination of seven different layers of malt melding into one substantial, opulent, yet balanced brew. Rich aromas of roasted coffee, chocolate, and just a glint of toasted sugars entice the nose, leading on to a surge of dark, decadent flavors. A subtle backdrop of caramel emerges and spicy and woodsy notes from noble German and Serbian hops give way to a dry, satisfying finish that will leave you wanting another quaff. So go ahead, take the reins, swig back, and ride out into the Black Rider’s night.

name: Black Magic
text: Espresso stout brewed at Crow Brewery specially for Ministarstvo Beer Bar.

name: Gort
text: Inspiraciju za ovog robota smo dobili iz pionirskog sci fi podhvata 50-tih godina 20. Veka "The Day the Earth Stood Still" . Tema koja se provlači u filmu, gde vanzemaljci dolaze na zemlju da donesu čovečanstvu know how koji će unaprediti civilizaciju i ksenofobična reakcija Zemljana na novo i nepoznato, poslužila nam je kao metafora ne samo za našu borbu protiv industrije, već i neslogu i tragikomično medjusobno rivalstvo zanatskih pivara. Gort je za nas personifikacija promene edukuvanih pivopija, koji se pridružuju roboluciji šireći neuništivu istinu o kvalitetu! Gort je stout, vrhunsko tamno pivo sa 6% alc, jakim i konkretnim telom, kafenim, čokoladnim i notama kokosa koji mu daju jedinstven karakter.

name: Serbian Barrels Series No.6 - Imperial Prune Stout
text: Serbia is famous for plums. Plums mainly go to Sljivovica brandy, but here we go with this No. 6 in Serbian Barrels Series. We've combined an Imperial stout with prunes added in whirlpool & and barrels. Near a year this beauty was sleepin' in Serbian Vinjak barrels. On a prune pillow.

name: Raspberry Vs Coconut
text: Borba maline i kokosa koji je ekstraktovan u belom rumu može da počne.

name: BonBon
text: Cherish your inner child. Thick and sticky stout with a loads of homemade caramel. A real delicacy for the dessert lovers.

name: Dry Irish Stout Nitro Edition
text: Part of a great project "Restore Our Earth" developed by our friends from The Garden Brewery & Beer 52. One of 16 collabs. Brewed in Belgrade. Dark & Roasty. Smooth & Dry. And NITRO on tap and in a can!

name: Ice Cream Stout
text: Milk stout sa 8 vrsta slada i dodatkom štapića vanile.

name: Crna Krava
text: Note kafe i čokolade u aromi, pun i mlečan ukus u ustima.Šest specijalnih sladova i dodatak prženog ječma i laktoze. Upoznajte našu Crnu Kravu, koja predstavlja klasičan ostrvski stout, oplemenjen mlečnim ukusom!

name: Nightmare
text: Rich chocolate, roasted malt, and marshmallow sweetness with hints of hazelnut, graham cracker, and vanilla. Smooth, creamy mouthfeel and a decadent, dessert-like finish.

name: Salto Stout
text: Expect a burst of subtle milk chocolate, hazelnut and coffee flavours which melt away into a smooth and long lasting aftertaste. The rich, flavoursome body evokes memories of luxurious desserts - the kind that always left you wanting another spoonful.

name: Pixie Dust
text: All day oatmeal stout sprinkled with a bit of pixie dust.Destination Neverland.Oatmeal stout with cinnamon and vanilla.Label change from 2023.

name: Cassius
text: Deep vanilla, cinnamon and dark chocolate. Cassius, floats like a butterfly stings like a bee.

name: Odžačar
text: Crno pivo dobijeno korišćenjem 5 vrsta prženih ječmenih sladova od kojih, pored izrazito crne boje, dobija i bogatu aromu kafe, čokolade i karamele.

name: Chocolate Habanero Spicy Stout
text: Great new collab with Zlobex, producer of hot paprika & hit sauces. We combined full body stout with tincture of chocolate habanero. Be brave. Try it!

name: Extra Stout
text: Extra Stout, but looking more like a german Schwartzbier

name: Cossack's Whip
text: Cossaks were well known for their power & strenght. Whip was one of the most respectfull weapons. Cause of that we've named this powerful RIS. Full body with addition of cocoa nibs with spicy aroma of cardamom. Mixture of strenght & complexity!

name: Wild Dogs
text: Mudrost, fizicka spremnost, mirisne note i ukusi tropskog voca, istrajnost, umesnost, jaka zahmeljenost, fokus, mentalna stabilnost, tradicija - osobenosti Wild Dogs american wheat. 3bir kao ponositi sponzor uspesnog lokalnog tima americkog fudbala Wild Dogs vam donosi psenicni napitak u koji su sa ljubavlju polozeni svi potrebni sastojci za postizanje izvanrednih rezultata koji se sire i van zelenog okvira od 120 jardi. 3bir - Wild Dogs - Touchdown.

name: Sunshine
text: American Wheat brewed with Cascade and Citra hops.

name: Wheat Me Up
text: You get the gray skies outta my way... My beats per minute will never be the same.Wheat beer that carries a spirit of the carefree time. It s summer, so let's cool in the pool. Brewed with coriander and orange peel.…

name: Summer Ale
text: Summer in a glass! Low in alcohol, high in drinkability. Light body with aromas of coriander, lemon zest which we've added in whirpool + pineapple boost from added juice at the end of fermentation. We celebrate summer!

name: Kriegerbot
text: Ovog puta vam donosimo Hefeweizen sa 5,5% alc, punog tela i boje. Surovo precizan, kriegerbot ima zadatak da u ruinama "pivske ponude" koja je ostavila iza sebe industrija, prezentuje doktrinu pšeničnog piva od 100% prirodnih sirovina, pšeničnog i ječmenog slada bez aditiva i pasterizacije. This time we bring you a Hefeweizen with 5.5% alc, full body and color. Cruelly precise, the kriegerbot has the task of presenting the doctrine of wheat beer from 100% natural raw materials, wheat and barley malt without additives and pasteurization, in the ruins of the "beer offer" left behind by the industry.

name: Pšenično
text: Soft, creamy flavor and a pale color, a mild banana and cloves flavor.

name: Raspberry Hefeweizen
text: We like raspberry. Also we like Hefeweizen. Two lovely aromas found their place in this beer. Traditional hefeweizen with it's aromas of clove and banana upgraded with raspberry pure. We've searched for balance between sugars and acidity. Have we founded it?

name: Zaječarsko Pšenično
text: PŠENIČNO SVETLO MUTNO PALTERIZOVANO PIVO. alk 5.0 % vol

name: La Banana
text: LaBanana je pivo koje smo napravili u saradnji sa ekipom iz Kulturni Centar LAB.Od Velvet Underground, preko Bada Spensera do Danija Alveša na utakmici protiv Viljareala, banana je po pravilu bila simbol otpora, slobode i kreativnosti.LaBanana je pšenično pivo sa jakim i voćnim karakterom (mereno u procentima - 7,3% Alc.) Veselo i drugačije, LaBanana je letnje pivo koje se ispija polako i u društvu, party-pivo po svom karakteru i efektu na okolinu.

name: Dunk Wit
text: Dunk Wit je pšenično pivo nešto lakšeg temperamenta, sa 4,75% alkohola i dodatkom semenki korijandera. Ovo pivo, zaplesaće po vašem nepcu ostavljajući citrusne tragove, jer ga krase sveže pomorandže i daju mu odvažnost u svom nastupu.Ali, Dunk Wit nije inovativan samo na osnovu toga. Postoji jedan sastojak koji ga zaista čini neponovljivo dovitljivim, a to je litvanski kvasac. Nastao u 19. veku, od strane porodice koja se generacijama bavila pivarstvom, ovaj kvasac se istakao na svojevrstan način, našao reči hvale širom sveta i došao do naše pivare.

name: Dogma In Da Streets - OH NO BARBARA
text: 2nd beer in our proudly created "Dogma In Da Streets" series is dedicated to our friend Barbara, famous street artist well known for her gentle but strong painting style. Label ilustration is at this moment been transfered to the walls of Dogma Brewery. And yes! It's a gentle, silky and super tasty Wit upgraded by huge whirlpool addition of a fresh lime & lime peel.

name: Dogma In Da Streets - Dechko Tzar
text: On 8th Anniversary we're continuing our "Dogma In Da Streets" series with an easy & summerish wit and great artwork of street art masters Braća Burazeri, creators of Dechko Tzar. Respect!

name: Salto Wit
text: A wave of freshness inspired by Belgian-style wheat beers with a bold Salto twist. Salto Wit brings bright and citrusy aromas to the front, while skillfully balanced sweet notes underline soft and creamy mouthfeel. Organic wheat, Curaçao orange zest and coriander give this unfiltered, unpasteurized beer its basic character, and added herbs are accentuating its freshness.

name: Death In Watermelon
text: It's a summer brew. Serbian watermelon, lime and a little bit of salt are bringing layers of summer flavours!

name: Mrzljak
text: Very deep copper to brown clear color, white almost creamy head with fine retention. First aroma is herbal and spicy from the noble German hops used, followed with a sweeter malty and finally fruity aroma contributed by the ale yeast. Taste is initially bready, but the gentle yet rich bitterness kicks in right away. The finish is clean, smooth and crispy which is achieved with the lagering of his beer as required for the style. This being the sticke version of the altbier (more hops, more malt) makes it very enjoyable for both malty and hoppy beer lovers.

name: Pivo Svetog Martina
text: Ovaj pivski specijalitet skuhali su u kolaboraciji naš majstor pivar Božo Kostanjčar i Matt Hollingsworth. Izraženih je slatkih, voćnih okusa i ugodne, kompleksne arome koja potječe od bogate mješavine slada. Ovo specifično ječmeno vino stvoreno je za uživanje i polagano ispijanje, poput pivskog cognaca.

name: Zeko je reko - Belgian blonde ale
text: Zeko je reko je Belgian blond ale koji pomaže u skupljanju hrabrosti za činjenje prave stvari! Etiketa dočarava maksimirsku šumu i sudionike poznatog vica o zeki koji je skupio hrabrost i reagirao na guranje preko reda drugih životinja - tek nakon pola gajbe piva. "Kaj, 'ko je rek'o?! Zeko je rek'o!"Zeko također kaže da se 30 centi po svakoj prodanoj boci i litri točenog piva donira udruzi za zaštitu životinja Šapica.

name: Blonde Ale
text: Full bodied, refreshing, slightly hazy, refermented belgian blonde

name: Lost Vicar
text: Collaboration project with Omnivar (Ljubljana) and Old Street brewery (London)Caramel and toffifee-like flavour with notes of raisins and honey. Special abbey yeast gave authenthic spicy touch. Be careful, with 9.7% alcohol it is dangerously drinkable, perfect for desserts.Suitable for aging so grab some bottles, store and forget them. You won't regret when you finally open them after some time!

name: Strossmayer
text: Strossmayer je jako, kompleksno, slatkasto, tamno pivo. U okusu se isprepliću note suhih smokava, grožđica, šljiva te suptilna nota banane.

name: Trippin' Tripel
text: Limited Edition available in 0,33 and 0,75 bottle format. Top fermented Belgian style ale with deep golden colour. Unpasturized, unfiltered, bottle conditioned. Fermented with selected Belgian Abbaye yeast. Maturation in bottles and kegs for 4 months before release.

name: DragonFish Tripel
text: A long-standing friendship resulted with first collaboration between HumanFish.Brewery and Zmajska pivovara. Classical slovenian hops Styrian Golding and Bobek have completed a base made from belgium pils, vienna and wheat malts.

name: Monarch
text: Long live the brew!Hops: Olicana, Godiva, Ernest

name: Mari's Bitter
text: Malty body, light bitternes and dry finish characterise this traditional english ale. This ale was brewed with premium Maris Otter malt from British islands and hopped with Celeia and Bobek hops.

name: Barba ENGLEZ
text: Sweet, mild ester, drinkable English style ale... Half way from ESB to NEBA. Wasn't made to suit specific style, but to represent English ale in our beer lineup.

name: American Blonde
text: Fresh light amber coloured. Dryhopped with Citra, Mosaic & Columbus.Tangerine & Melon aroma.

name: 5th Element ABA
text: Prva u liniji specijalnih piva je American Blond Ale, spravljeno u stilu piva koje karakterizira vrlo visoka pitkost s intenzivnom voćnom aromom specijalnih američkih hmeljeva sorti CENTENNIAL, CASCADE i CHINOOK. Zbog upotrebe posebne vrste kvasca gornjeg vrenja (ALE kvasac) simbolizira ga element VATRA

name: Lito
text: Summer beer

name: Kumsko Blonde Ale
text: Easy drinking and well balanced ale with moderate grainy malt aroma. Subtle hop aroma with pleasant bitterness

name: Bracera
text: This light and refreshing beer Bracera will take you sailing on the calm sea of gentle aromas.

name: Cvrkut
text: HÖPPY BLONDE

name: Cincilator
text: Čak 4 slada i 4 hmelja korišteno je u našoj prvoj kreaciji! Uživajte u svakom gutljaju! Pivili! 4 malt and 4 hops were used in creation of our first beer. Enjoy every sip! Cheers!

name: Organic Blonde
text: Nefiltrirano pivo proizvedeno od ekoloških sastojaka, na tradicionalan način, bez konzervansa.

name: No Man's Land
text: No Man's Land is a story about the origin of the Neretva valley. It is also our first beer. We started from scratch. American Blond Ale - No Man's Land is a summer, refreshing, balanced and light beer without pronounced hop aromas and bitterness. Very simple!

U finalnoj utakmici košarkaškog prvenstva bivše države 09.04.1983. Šibenka je pobijedila Bosnu rezultatom 83:82 i postala prvak ex Jugoslavije. Nažalost, političkom odlukom dan poslije, utakmica je poništena, a ponosni Šibenčani su odbili odigrati novu utakmicu u Novom Sadu. Bosna je proglaše a prvakom na papiru, ali u šibenskim srcima zauvik ostaje - Šibenka prvak!

name: Purger
text: Light and refreshing blond ale hopped with Aurora and Bobek hops. Cheers!

name: Plavuša
text: Plavuša je blonde ale s okusom slobode stvaranja prvog zadrugarskog piva.Dominant flavours are citrus and elderberry, medium bodied,  with some grain and freshly baked bread notes.

name: Walter White
text: Walter White is our entry level craft beer. Very drinkable and smooth. We used european hops: styrian goldings and mandarina bavaria.

name: Mila
text: To taste our beer is to wake your senses, Bourne with the fresh crisp water from our river Cetina, embodied with the gentle flavours of the finest hops. Our beer MILA has a combination of 4 different strains of top quality barley and is infused with 4 different types of the finest hops brought together to delight your palette.Refresh yourself during hot summer days with ours Golden Ale, which leaves a rich citrus taste after each sip.

name: Swanky Blond Ale
text: Special brew for Swanky Monkey bar.

name: Jedna s Mora
text: Nefiltrirano, nepasterizirano domaće ale pivo bez konzervansa, umjetnih bojila i bilo kakvih drugih dodataka, s prirodnim jestivim talogom kvasca, refermentirano u boci. Napravljeno od kombinacije 3 vrste najkvalitetnijih engleskih i njemačkih sladova i 3 vrste najatraktivnijih američkih hmeljeva. Ovaj osvježavajući blond ale idealan je odabir za svaki dan!Poželjno čuvati na hladnom i tamnom mjestu u uspravnom položaju.

name: Optimist Golding Ale
text: Top-fermented blonde ale. Unpasteurized, unfiltered, bottle-fermented (bottle conditioned).Top-fermented beer in Golden Ale style brewed with barley malt, a small amount of wheat malt, yeast and a mix of Slovenian hops, one of which is the Styrian Golding. Rich golden colour and intentionally opaque, it presents itself with a fine and persistent foam. You can identify herbal and citrus features, mildly spiced and fruity flavours due to the esters intentionally evoked by our brewmaster. Refreshing, easily drinkable and well balanced thanks to its dryness and final bitterness (which prompts you to try some more). An OPTIMIST is a boat intended for use by children learning to sail: light and breezy wherever the wind takes you. Unfiltered and bottle-conditioned it comes with a natural yeast sediment.

name: Waitapu
text: Waitapu is a poetic need for breaking the boundaries, to explore the unexplored, a message about visible and invisible walls. Waitapu is the imaginary line where sky and sea meet and the travel towards it. Our Blonde ale try available from 6/7/2019 across the Croatia

name: Merkat
text: PIVO: Osvježavajući svijetli ale, čistog i punog okusa, blage sladne arome i ugodne hmeljne gorčine.LIK: MERKATI su najniži u hijerarhiji posade Zeppelina koje svi udaraju nogom i ignoriraju, ali oni su toliko dobra ekipa i uživaju u poslu koji rade bez obzira na tretman koji dobivaju. Nitko ih ne kontrolira, oni jednostavno vole to što rade i guštaju. Pojedinci su blesavi jer se povremeno nagutaju Natrijevog hidroksida, lužine za pranje pivovare...MENU: Zbog svoje pitkosti MERKAT će odgovarati uz sve vrste jela, pivo koje utaži žeđ i traži još! Fino će se stopiti sa laganom hranom, a ublažiti jaku hranu blagim sladnim notama i završiti svježinom.

name: ŠČ - Mrletovo pivo
text: Lepi dečki skuhali su Mrletovo pivo - ŠČ!

name: Goodara BLONDE
text: Dobar osjećaj u tekućem obliku! Robna marka koja to nije ;) #Ribafish

name: Session Ale
text: A light ‘bridging’ beer. A non-offensive, easy, entry ale for first time craft beer lovers who are used to mainstream lager. Designed with summer, the heat and refreshment in mind this is a very well balanced, crisp, fresh beer that leaves you wanting to take another sip right away. It pours effervescent and clear forming a solid, white head. Aromas of fresh hay, lemon are subtle with a back note of maize. Taste is balanced and thirst quenching; not too hoppy, not too malty. The slight body here coats the pallet nicely, without lingering, which is the key to its sessionability.

name: Punica
text: Punica is Croatian for his mother in law... the name of the beer is mother in law... soft, smooth, suiting, gentle like any other mother in law!!!

name: Slawoner
text: Poured a full yellow murky body with a small white head with good retention. Crackery/grainy aroma, with very vague, light fruity/hoppy notes, but very vague. Taste... earthy, slightly beety

name: Doppelbock #6
text: Strong & dark German bock beer. Originally made by Munich monks this is bready, chewy, fruity and great with food

name: Božićno Pivo
text: A strong dark lager, with an intensive taste and aroma which comes from the rich mixture of malt prepared especially for these occasions. Božićno pivo (Christmas beer) is available in December.

name: Grička Vještica
text: Strong dark lager, with a gentle ruby red colour. A light, aromatic taste, with a rich fine sweetness and a pleasant aroma. We brew Grička vještica (Grič witch) throughout the year.

name: Bock Bock
text: Marking the Oktoberfest period with a strong German lager

name: Strojar
text: Strojar je prvo pivo u seriji od pet piva koja pričaju Medvedgrad priču povodom 30. obljetnice. Jaki tamni lager, bogatih, kompleksnih okusa karamele i suhog voća, lagane gorčine, izrazito pitko.

name: La Dolce Vita
text: A tasty Märzenbock with Mosaic, brewed in collaboration with Munich Brew Mafia.

name: Zimsko
text: Zimsko is our wintery beer. This year we brewed bock, a strong, dark brown pour with our special take - snowflakes sprayed by a dragon "Pozojček Zimsky" Three types of malt, three hops - Mandarina bavaria, Hallertau blanc & Styrian wolf.

name: PureBrett: Lavender
text: Different worts (With rye and wheat in the brain bill) fermented only on Brettanomyces Claussenii. Fresh lavender dominates the aroma over the brett funk and acidity evident already on the nose. Tastes fruity sour, moderately strong sourness. Tannins from the lavender enhance the body and bring about some bitterness in the finish

name: Mina
text: Mine [maina] is our fourth beer, beer dedicated to brave miners of Međimurje county. Minne was as well a German goddess of love and fertility. Cheers!

name: Pulski Grand Ale
text: Nefiltrirano, nepasterizirano domaće ale pivo bez konzervansa, umjetnih bojila i bilo kakvih drugih dodataka, s prirodnim jestivim talogom kvasca, refermentirano u boci. Ovo ale pivo napravljeno je od 4 vrste pomno odabranih najfinijih njemačkih sladova i plemenitog hmelja. Poželjno čuvati na hladnom i tamnom mjestu, u uspravnom položaju.

name: Pacific Common
text: A Californian common transformed by pacific rim hops. This crisp & clean throwback beer starts out with a soft, caramel-like sweetness then quickly transitions to a floral & piney note quickly finishing bitter and dry. At 4.2% ABV, its nice and approachable for all beer drinkers new and old.

Godine 1066, na Božić, u ispravi moćnog hrvatskoh kralja Petra Krešimira IV. prvi put se spominje Šibenik, najstariji samorodni hrvatski grad na Jadranu.--------------On Christmas day in 1066 in a document signed by king Petar Krešimir IV, name Šibenik was first mentioned. Its the only city on the Adriatic that was founded by Croats.

name: Apple Cider Dry
text: Aromatic, fresh and light cider. On the nose it is fresh and fruity, with aromas of citrus and fermented green apple. In the mouth dry, with beautiful structure and taste of fermented green apple. Playful acidity brings persistent and long aertaste

name: Apple And Ginger Cider
text: Fresh, citrusy and seductive cider. The scent is fresh with pronounced notes of ginger, apple and citrus. Semi-dry to sweet taste, drinkable structure and fruit spices. Ideal cider for solo consumption or combination with cocktails.

name: Apple & Elderflower
text: Aromatic, fresh and flowery cider. On the nose it is fresh with the notes of the fermented apples and elderflower. In the mouth is semi dry, beautiful structure is followed by taste of the fermented apple and elderflowers. Playful acidity brings persistent and long aftertaste.

name: Red Apple Cider
text: Aromatic, light and delicate cider. On the nose it is fruity with hints of fermented overripe red apples, notes of stone fruit, like apricot, and some vanilla notes. On the pallet it is dry, well balanced, with beautiful structure and medium carbonation. Hints of red apple and vanilla notes. Playful acidity brings persistent and long afertaste.

name: Small Batch Series: 13 Hoppy Dark Ale
text: Easy going, bitter and hoppy dark ale. Fruity and biscuity cappuccino with Comet, Sabro and Nugget hops.

name: Peach, Nectarine & Camomille Bière de Garde
text: Stillwater (USA) Collab: 5.5%We love Stillwater's neverending desire to create and experiment so we teamed up to make this and kickstart our new series of mixed fermentation beers. This is soft and gently sour with a slight nuttiness. The Lalbrew Farmhouse adds a much-loved funk and resting on fresh ripe Peaches, Nectarines & foraged Croatian Camomile gives a gentle, fruity complexity.

name: Farmhouse Pale Ale
text: Spicy yeast esters mix with gentle stone fruit and berry aromas. Showcasing Callista hops from the German Hop Research Center in HüllThe Garden Brewery asked 16 of its favourite global breweries to work with us to create exclusive collab beers for Restore Our Earth, a charity project we initiated with Beer52, the world’s biggest beer club. In the Summer of 2022 1.5 millions cans will be distributed globally.The Garden Brewery and Beer52 have committed to donate at least €30,000 to charities with proven high impact deliverables in Marine Conservation, Forest Conservation, Reimagining Carbon, Education & Behavior, Food & Agriculture and building Climate Resistant Communities

name: Hoppy Saison
text: Great collaboration with Zao Gnom for great summer beer - saison. We used belgian yeast which produced spicy and fruit flavours, wheat and pils malt for drinkability, Citra, Chinook and Mosaic for hop aroma - all combined together to make great beer! Cheers! #malažuta

name: Gnomeberry
text: Raspberry saison dryhopped with Citra And Amarillo. Very balanced dry and fruity beer.

name: No Bummer Summer
text: No Bummer Summer is a first saison in our new series "Four Seasons Saison". Year 2020 is a year of challenges and changes so we want to think optimistic through all the bad things going on. For all people who think that this summer is ruined and bummer this is a beer that says opposite - No Bummer Summer. Think positive and enjoy this refreshing summer beer.Dry hopped with New Zealand hop Motueka. Citrusy, fruity, bubblegum, some clove and lots of grapefruit. Absolute delicious!Let no bummer summer begins!

name: Freezy Dizzy
text: Freezy Dizzy is a 3rd saison in "Four season's saison" series that represents winter.We try to expand limits that define tradional saison beers, as we push hops to crazy amounts, recreate body and texture and let yeast do it's job at un-ordinary conditions!Aroma is a complex spectar: at first you have funky, bubblegum and raspberries-like with lot of tropical and fruity aromas from hops (Nelson Sauvin and Pacific Jade). Body in enhanced with oats that gave silky texture, and than at the end, you got lots of spicy aromas, grapes and wine-like flavour, black pepper and herbal notes. We could say it's like NEIPA combined with saison - hoppy, silky and funky.This is why we brew!

name: Sober October?
text: Do you really wanna be sober in October?This beer is a 2nd saison in our "Four season's saison" series that represents autumn. We add huge amount of blueberries and raspberries in our sour saison.What an amazing violet color! Saison yeast gave wine and raspberry-like aroma, mixed with blueberries and raspberries and really nice tartness  makes a really cool blend. We are happy to say it has very nice fruity, spicy and wine-like taste perfect for a beautiful time of year - autumn!After reading this, do you really wanna be sober in October?

name: Rozita
text: Raspberry saison. Very balanced dry and fruity beer.

name: Leggero
text: Another summer, another hoppy saison!We really love this style of beer, we could say maybe the best summmer hoppy choice.Dry hopped with Citra and Nelson Sauvin, this saison have aromas of lemon zest, spicy, peppery and estery bubblegum-ish, yet super refreshing taste. With dry aftertaste, you will crave for next cold sip on hot summer day.Originaly an Italian word, 'Leggero' means lighty and easy going, or as Croats would say - Laganini.

name: Make Saison Not War
text: Made in collaboration with Tapir homebrewery. A very drinkable saison made with grains of paradise to accentuate its spicy aromas. From every bottle sold we donate 3kn to aid the victims of war in Ukraine.

name: Saison 2.0
text: The first of our annual spring series, this take on a classic dry & estery farmhouse saison combines the traditional with the exotic. Pink peppercorns, cardamon, coriander seeds and orange peel marry perfectly with a high ester profile from our classic house saison yeast.

name: Zeko Je Reko - Saison
text: Zarada od humanitarnog piva Zeko je reko namijenjena je zaštiti ugroženih životinjskih vrsta u Hrvatskoj, a ove godine jedna kuna od svake prodane boce odlazi u Indigo udrugu za dobrobit i zaštitu životinja.

name: Festbier #3
text: Fill a stein and head to the fest! Infinitely drinkable lager with toasted malts flavours

name: Take Your Mango And Go Kveik Yourself
text: Although it looks like it, this is not a fruit juice. This unusually fine beer is a fantastic combination of ripe tropical fruits from the southern regions and bold and unpredictable Kveik yeast from the cold north. What would it look like if the Vikings went to the tropics to harvest mangoes? Lots of mango! And add a whole bunch of different hops? Try tasting this unusual combination through sips of this aromatic beer full of hops Talus, Sabro Cryo and Idaho 7.New birthday beer from Varionica.

name: Fruit Expo: Paw Paw
text: Our #FruitExpoSeries went a step further, and this time we made a fruit beer with paw-paw, exotic fruit which produced tropical and mango-like flavors with a slightly sourish and creamy texture!

name: Mr. Pink Monster
text: Raspberry ale with cider yeast

name: Crna Višnja
text: Black Cherry Fruit Beer

name: Gluten Free IPA
text: A Gluten-Free flavour-packed classic. Eureka hops give a piney resinous base from which the softer hops (Lemondrop...) shine alongside our unique yeast.

name: Gluten Free Helles
text: Full bodied and well rounded, lemondrop hops add a touch of citrus & spice. Clean, crisp, and refreshing.

name: Landbier #5
text: Full bodied golden lager. Gluten-free

name: Dark Lager
text: Gluten free dark lager

name: Gardia Lager
text: Very light, refreshing beer with original lager flavor. Great aftertaste.Pasteurized & filtered.

name: Frankopansko Gvirček
kind: Historical Beer - Gruit / Ancient Herbed Ale

name: How To Pick A Pickle In A Pickle Jar
text: Craft beer shouldn’t be just another beverage. We imagine it as a way of life, practically a subculture that connects people, tells stories and lifts our mood in every occasion. Especially when you find yourself in a pub, some bar or in a restaurant.Without question, people who work there make that thing special, thou, beer too. Guys who love beers, love to talk and know a lot about beer. Women and men who know your next beer before you even take your favorite spot at the bar. Our friends 'Tap Bullies' - Matija Juršić and Sandi Marinković - are those kind of bartenders!In these difficult times we've collaborated with this beer to support all the people in the industry and give them a recognition they deserve. Cheers to them all!

name: Jawbreaker
text: You sense the fear risingas you sneak behind your preyA claw rips through the boneat the moment you've been seenBut the jaw has already been gonebefore they could hear him scream

name: Brew Alone
text: Our quarantine sessions. Covid-19 virus locked us down, but it didn't slow us. As a reminder of that bitter period, we made a West Coast IPA!!

name: The Raven
text: West Coast IPA with killer NZ combo: NECTARON & RIWAKA

name: Hop Expedition: Yakima #4 Neomexicanus IPA
text: Yakima #4 is an IPA brewed with Sabro Dynaboost and HBC 1019 Cryo hops.

name: Hop Selection in Action
text: Hops: Citra, Mosaic, Cryo-Simcoe

name: The West, the Coast, and the IPA
text: Like the legendary gunslinger trilogy, a true West Coast IPA that doesn't mess around - very dry, bitter, and hop-forward. Simcoe, Mosaic, and Krush hops draw their pistols at high noon.

name: Green Machine
text: In the hop-filled fields, a tale unfolds, Where greed and need clash, as the story goes. A green machine, relentless and blind, Seeks profits vast, but leaves a trail behind.IPA brewed with YCH 605 Trial Blend and Ekuanot.

name: Time To Travel
text: American IPA focused on oats. It has creamy mouthfeel, and 7,3% ABV which is perfectly hidden behind Amarillo and Citra combo.

name: Andy Wood
text: West Coast IpaMosaic Cryo + Nectaron + Abstax King Louie XIII for extra diesel dank.

name: Hoppy Brewday 2022
text: Happy 8th birthday APA!! For this occasion, we brewed a juicy IPA with Lemondrop, Citra & Mosaic hops..

name: Yul Brynner
text: Classic Ipa like Yul Brynner.DDH with Strata, Enigma, Columbus Cryo and Nectaron AbstraxNew yeast in this batch, Lallemand AURORA.

name: Clint Westwood
text: West Coast Ipa with The wildest bunch of hops we ever used in one batch.Cascade in Mash, full hot side with Columbus, Simcoe, Whirlpool with Mosaic, Idaho7, and more Columbus.The first dry hop with Simcoe Cryo and Columbus Cryo. Second dry hop with Amarillo and Nelson Sauvin.

name: It's Time For IPA
text: It is time for IPA! Is it? Yes, it is!There is no mystery that we love IPAs, from american IPAs, DIPAs and TRIPAs to NEIPAs and fruited ones.When you sit in a bar or in a pub or just at home, and you wonder if now is the time for some hoppy IPA, then don't think twice or overthink - grab one! Because it's time for IPA!We put fair amount of hops in this one, so expect citrusy and tropical aroma and flavour thanks to Cashmere, Citra and Sabro hops.It is something between american IPA and NEIPA, trending style of IPA called mountain style IPA!This is why we brew!

name: The Cougar
text: "American Hoppy Tale" series batch number 4.Mountain Ipa, clash between West Coast and East Coast Ipa. This is fermented with WHC Pineapple Passion Kveik hybrid yeast. DDH with Superdelic, NZ Cascade, and Citra Cryo.#Cheers!

name: The Grizzly
text: From "American Hoppy Tale" series one more West Coast Ipa. DDH with two different lots of NZ FreeStyle Nelson Sauvin. D15M and D22M plus Citra Cryo.#cheers!

name: This Is How We Roll
text: Crafted by five adventurous pals who stumbled upon Yakima's hop fields, while trippin' across Oregon and Washington! This beer is as bold as a buffalo, and as smooth as a road trip playlist.The beer is brewed with HBC 1019, HBC 638, and Simcoe hops.

name: No Name IPA
text: A bandit with No Name, but with plenty of character and a West Coast attitude, is already one foot in the grave. We should let him enjoy a proper pint before he's face-down in the dust

name: Amazing Hazying
text: Haziness, lots of wheat and oats became new trend in some american IPAs, not just NEIPA styles. Amazing Hazying is our first IPA that follows „hazy trend“ and we made it with Azzaca and BRU-1 hops. Fifty percent of oats and wheat gave supersilky flavour empowered with pineapple, stonefruit, citrusy and tropical fruit aroma. With ABV 6% it is easy drinkable, great for the upcoming end of summer. Be ready for our new hazy beers that will come soon!Amazed?

name: Joaquin
text: Back to old school!Juaquin Murrieta, also called Robin Hood of the West, was a mexican outlaw, thirsty for revenge.Our 'Bandido' is a true west coast IPA - hoppy, bitter with citrusy, piney and resinous flavours. Brewed with Citra, Centennial, Columbus, Chinook and Apollo!Enjoy!

name: Tuco’s Revenge
text: The ugly bandit is back, and this time he's packing Nelson Sauvin hops from New Zealand's hop frontier. At 6.1% ABV and 80 IBUs, this New Zealand IPA delivers a cold and hoppy revenge.

name: Hike My Beer
text: For all current and future hikers. Hike your own hike, but don't forget to bring this IPA with you.It will always show you the right way!Rich, smooth and really tasty with big bright citrusy and piney flavor, rounded with tropical notes. Sultana and Citra complemented each other perfectly.Be creative, take a picture with 'Hike My Beer' somewhere in forest, hill or mountain, or any hike routes and make us proud and happy.#This is why we brew!

name: Reality Check
text: Back to reality!hops: Citra, Centennial, YCH303

name: HOPPYFORNIA 2026 Edition
text: HOPPYFORNIA, West Coast Republic Ipa!2026 EditionDDH with EGGERS SPECIAL and NECTARONWEST COAST, BEST COAST!!!

name: Psilomancer
text: A Psilomancer is a wizzard with hallucination power to convert grains into mystic liquid that controls your ability to be yourself.Soft and very drinkable, this american IPA with Mosaic, Citra, Simcoe, Chinook and Nelson Sauvin hops is just perfect for incoming summer vibes. Easy-going with nice hoppy flavor.

name: WRPAR
text: The annual celebration and appreciation of a clean beer glass. Keep it simple - (W)ash, (R)inse, (P)Polish (A)nd (R)epeat!

name: Resolution 2020 - 2nd Run Juicy IPA
text: We're making a rollback to the beginning of 2020. We already released Resolution 2020, but COVID-19 messed up our plans, and we had to restart 2020. New Resolution 2020 is being made, 2nd Run, this time with Galena, Sabro and Cryo Amarillo hops!

name: BOOO!
text: Halloween edition - West coast IPA.Hops: Chinook, Citra, Motueka, Ahhhroma, Sultana

name: Urban Jungle
text: West Coast IPA made with Chinook, Simcoe, Eukanot and Sabro hops.

name: Riffquake
text: Collaboration brew with our friends from Maskeron Brewery. This is old school IPA brewed with modern hops - Luminosa, Meridian, and Strata CXG.

name: Small Batch Series : 83 Kveik American IPA
text: Small Batch 83 is an American IPA brewed with Kveik yeast and Loral, Ekuanot, BRU1, and Krush hops.

name: Perun
text: Perun, supreme thunder god of the ancient Slavs, a purifier and overseer of right and order.Like that, this beer brings power of West and East (Coast IPA). We really like bitter character of West and juiciness of East Coast, hope you'll too.

name: El Vengador Del Infierno
text: Este gladiador cósmico, con un corazón de fuego y una piel más dura que el acero, viene armado con un arma digna de un dios: ¡un tridente de cactus! Sí, has oído bien, un tridente de cactus. No te preocupes, solo tiene una pequeña herida superficial de sus batallas anteriores. Es como un cactus que se ha rascado un poco.

name: Landsky Overload
text: There is an interesting story behind the creation of our more 'mature' version of Landsky.This year, in less than a month, Borefts Beer Festival, will be held. A great traditional festival organized by Brouwerij de Molen, which will also celebrate its 20th anniversary. Big number, congratulations!The theme of the festival is - 'Back&Future'. So, each brewery participating in the festival was asked to modernize one of their iconic beers. Without much hesitation, we decided to lift our session IPA. We kept its distinctiveness, but absolutely everything was raised to a higher level. Proper IPA.Please welcome the overloaded Ms. Landsky.

name: Hazy IPA: Australian New Hop Showcase
Slice of Life
text: Slice of Life is homebrewed short film that pays tribute to '80s sci-fi. Now our black IPA pays tribute to Slice of Life. It's a bit roasty, heavily hopped, and delicious. So kick back, relax, and enjoy your Slice of Life!

name: Black Dawn
text: Dark, strong ale beer with fine bitterness and dominant herbal and citrus aroma from Simcoe and Citra hops. Dark in colour but with light roasted and caramelized aromas. Drafted only!

name: Luck of the Dark
text: Pitch black.Shamrock Lucky.Hops: Chinook, Simcoe, Cryo Simcoe

name: Hoppy Ninja
text: Silent but deadly, this Ninja warrior is equipped with an arsenal of mighty hops - El Dorado, Chinook, Mosaic, Sabro, and Citra.

name: Crni Jack
text: Black India pale ale dominated by notes of roasted malt and American hops.

name: Dark Quasar
text: Another monstrous cataclysmic beer label!If you tried Black Blizzard, White Typhoon and Crimson Tornado, than you know we continued with this monster-like beer series.With Citra, Mosaic and Simcoe in whirlpool and dryhopping, we added Southern Cross SubZero hop Kief for extra hoppy touch..This is why we brew!

name: Black IPA
text: Black Ipa is dark ale beer, unfiltered, unpasteurized, made of three types of malt and three types of hops, balanced flavour with expressed citrus aroma.

name: Shadow Moon
text: Heavily hopped IPA in dark brown body!Bitter, dry, fruity with chocolate notes. Brewed with Simcoe, Sabro and Citra

name: FROSTBITE
text: Brewer's Concoction series FROSTBITE is COLD IPA (brewed with lager yeast), a crisp IPA with rich hop aromas (Citra, Mosaic and Cascade).

name: Springbite
text: Cold IPA dry hopped Motueka, Lemondrop, Idaho#7

name: Knez Beerislav
text: Malts: Pils Vienna, CaraBody, MelanoHops: Superdelic, Kohatu, Simcoe, MosaicYeast: W34/70

name: Cryobite
text: Hops: Strata, Mosaic, Cryo mosaic, HBC586In both taste and aroma dominantly strawberry, followed by berries, pine, orange, kumquat, mild vanilla, mild maltiness and biscuits. Fuller body, dry finish, pleasant bitterness.

name: Fantom 31
text: Fantom 31 pripada stilu Cold IPA, koja izraziti naglasak stavlja na zahmeljenost - gorčinu i voćne note hmelja, uz lakše tijelo, svježinu i pitkost dobivenu upotrebom lager kvasca.

name: Cold IPA #02
text: Where Lager & IPA meet: light, crisp and super refreshing. Generously dry hopped with Citra, Mosaic, Bru-1 & Cryo-Pop hops

name: Cold IPA #4
text: Where lager meets Citra IPA. Intensely hoppy and beautifully refreshing

name: Cold IPA #01
text: Where Lager & IPA meet. Light. Bright. Crisp. Clear. Super Refreshing. Hop-forward. Brewed with Pilsner malt and Lager yeast. Generously dry hopped with Citra, Mosaic & Sabro

name: Rice Cold IPA
text: Super dry, rice IPA allows the stone fruit hop notes to take centre stage. Our first ever Japanese collab with Tokyo's CraftRock

name: West Coast Cold IPA
text: Been playing around with some recipes with White Dog Brewery and we came up with this interesting fusion. Cold IPA meets West Coast IPA - dry, refreshing, dank and all kinds of other tasty stuff.

name: 10 Cold IPA
text: A delicious and very drinkable Cold IPA made with rice and New Zeland hops. Brewed specially for our 10 birthday!

name: Mirna
text: Delicious & refreshing. Juicy notes of Grapefruit, Lime & Melon. Collaboration with Siren

name: Cold IPA
text: Where Lager & IPA meet. Light. Bright. Crisp. Clear. Super Refreshing. Hop-forward. Brewed with Lager yeast. Generously dry hopped with Ekuanot Incognito, Citra and Simcoe hops.The Garden Brewery asked 16 of its favourite global breweries to work with us to create exclusive collab beers for Restore Our Earth, a charity project we initiated with Beer52, the world’s biggest beer club. In the Summer of 2022 1.5 millions cans will be distributed globally.The Garden Brewery and Beer52 have committed to donate at least €30,000 to charities with proven high impact deliverables in Marine Conservation, Forest Conservation, Reimagining Carbon, Education & Behavior, Food & Agriculture and building Climate Resistant Communities.

name: Majstorica #39 Cold IPA
text: Crisp aromas of white peach, pink grapefruit and light florals, with soft, clean malt base and a hint of rice-driven dryness; sharp, refreshing bitterness.

name: Tornado IPA - Istrian Pale Ale
text: Top-fermented IPA-style beer. Unpasteurized, unfiltered, bottle-fermented (bottle conditioned). Istrian reinterpretation (Istrian Pale Ale) of the Indian Pale Ale (British style) brewed with barley malt, a small amount of wheat malt, yeast and a mix of English and American hops which evoke an intense aroma thanks also to the additional amount of hops added in dry hopping. It presents itself in amber colour with abundant as well as creamy and persistent foam. The hoppy flavours varying from exotic fruit to citrus and floral elements are first perceived in the nose persisting throughout the mouth accompanied by a medium body. It resolves in a pleasant bitterness which recalls the flavours of grapefruit. This IPA doesn’t focus only on the hops (East Kent Golding, Chinook and Amarillo) but also on the malt (4 different types of malt). The result is a TORNADO of flavour. Unfiltered and bottle-conditioned it comes with a natural yeast sediment.

name: IPA Gone Wild (Brewer's Concoction)
text: Remember the Barrel 01, 02, 03, 04 aroma? The IPA Gone Wild is aged in wooden barrels and it is blend of all 4 barrels. It is secondary fermented with brettanomyces yeast (Brewer's mix), dry-hopped, with moderate bitterness and plenty of alcohol and floral and fruity aromas with the characteristic acidity that we like in wild beers.

name: Goblet Barbarian
text: Goblet Barbarian is the new Tropical Neipa for the Goblet Beer Store Zagreb and Rijeka.The summer edition for our collaboration is Fruited Neipa with Pineapple and touch with Orange and Mango.Dry hopped with Superdelic and El Dorado Cryo.It was fermented with WHC Mango Madness yeast.

name: Pineapple Punch
text: TROPICAL NEIPANew Hazy with Pineapple Puree and DH with Nectaron + Bru1. Mango Madness WHC yeast.

text: IPA brewed with Sabro and Eclipse hops, and infused with Mango and Coconut.

name: Hazy IPA With Sun-Kissed Dalmatian Lemons
Red Mosquito

name: Citrus IPA
text: Fresh orange, grapefruit and lime with dank American hops. Dark orange in colour with a slight haze and a lingering, tight white head the aroma is strong sweet orange and tropical fruit. A complex citrus taste is followed by a soft and sticky bittersweet finish. Highly carbonated and easy drinking.

name: Party Prophet
text: This was foretold. - double IPA, teenage attitude- 13 candles, 75 IBU's- birthday brew, strong, juicy- your destiny is bitter

name: Cryo Fang
text: West coast double IPA, hops: Columbus, Chinook, Idaho 7 Cryo, Amarillo, Citra, Simcoe.

name: East Coast Double IPA #4
text: Hazy and tropical, with notes of pineapple, melon and citrus.

name: Double Hazy IPA
text: A big, hazy Double IPA with Strata, Citra & Ekuanot hops. Made with our Dublin friends, Whiplash

name: West And Nothing Else
text: West Coast Double Ipa with Nectaron playing the main role, supported by Amarillo and Columbus Cryo.

name: Hazy Double IPA #04
text: Australian Hop Showcase Packed with Galaxy, Enigma, Australian Cascade and Eclipse. Punchy and tropical with notes of Pineapple, Mandarin, Passion Fruit and a gentle background spice

name: Imperial IPA Barba
text: Surely the best Split beer in the World!!! BEST IN CROATIA for 2018 - RateBeer!1st class malts combined with YCH CryoHops and pellets.28g of hops per liter! -Columbus as first wort hop. -Centennial as Whirlpool hop. -Lupulin Simcoe, Lupulin Citra and Cascade in dryhop...

name: Hazy Double IPA
text: Oat laden East Coast Double IPA with a silken mouth feel and sacks of Simcoe and Azacca hops. Aromas of berrys, citrus, pineapple, and apricots.

name: Imperial IPA
text: Topical, juicy and resinous. Our highest dry hop so far; 27g/l of Citra, Mosaic & Nelson Sauvin.

name: Hazy Double IPA #06
text: Smooth and tropical with big aromas of peach, coconut, berries and melon

name: Hazy Double IPA #02
text: Cherry and raspberry notes mingled with papaya, candy and blackcurrant.

name: East Coast Double IPA
text: Tropical and juicy, this East Coast DIPA is packed with a 20g/LTR dry hop of Azacca, Vic Secret & Mosaic. A big tropical fruit nose gives way to big notes of Pineapple & Mango. Robust, balanced and deceptive, with a soft mouthfeel and a subtle residual bitterness.

name: Hazy Double IPA #08
text: Well balanced and clean drinking with strong aromas of Pineapple, Mango & Citrus over an ultra-light malt base. Packed with Mosaic & Bru-1 hops

name: Night Howler
text: A modern west coast double IPA!Brewed with Citra, Chinook and Strata, it gives citrusy aromas with piney and dank notes.Very tasty, flavourfull and drinkable, so rehydrate yourself properly. Unless you want to become a night howler!

name: Piñata Deathmatch
text: Traditional birthday brew!WC IPA with HBC1019, Krush, Simcoe

name: Regoč
text: A mountain of hops and malts, a mountain of a man - a hill giant Regoč and his favorite little faerie Kosjenka will take you on a trip of flavours!

name: Double IPA
text: Huge Pineapple-driven New England IPA with notes of Pine & Mandarin. Smooth & tropical

name: Double Digits
text: Anniversary beer to mark a big milestone - 10 years of Zmajska brewery. Limited Concoction series, ultra hoppy double IPA. Hops: Chinook, Columbus, Azacca, Centennial

name: West Coast Double IPA
text: Dank, resinous and unapologetically bitter; with notes of citrus, tropical and stone fruits

name: East Coast Double IPA #3
text: Tropical notes with sweet tangerine and pine. 26 g/l dry hop intensity.Hops: HBC522, Azacca, Enigma, MagnumMalts: Pale Ale, Wheat, Dextrin, Oat, Golden Naked OatsYeast: Lallemand New England18°

name: West Coast Double IPA
text: Big notes of Melon and Citrus with a long lasting and oily finish.

name: Tapu Pia
text: 'Sacred beer' or Tapu Pia, as Māori people would called it, is a east coast double IPA loaded with New Zealand hops - Nelson Sauvin and The Bruce. Actually, The Bruce is hop blend of four different hops: early Nelson Sauvin, early Motueka, late Pacifica and mid Pacific Jade.Expect citrusy and tropical notes with lots of spicy and peppery aromas and hint of ripe grapes. Brewed with New Zealand hops, this double IPA is very drinkable with 8,2 abv, nice silky body and bitterish finish.

name: Bitter F**K
text: Our session IPA is bitter hugOur west coast IPA is bitter kiss..So we present you the west coast DIPA:Bitter F**K!Simple grain bill consisting mostly of Pils, some Munich and Vienna and a touch of carapils. Sticking to the familiar workhorse of a yeast US-05 for this one, and combining some old school and new school hops in Citra, Cascade, Azacca and HBC472. The resulting beer is an aromatic bomb loaded with the whole citrus spectrum: tangerine dominant, followed by grapefruit, oranges and lemons. Some pineapple and piny notes there as well. Hops are well present in flavor with their fruity notes along side with some simple malt sweetness, but in the finish the (appropriate) 69 IBUs state their presence.

name: Southern Hemisphere Double IPA
text: Ripe Mango, Passionfruit, and Pineapple notes dominate this Australian Hopped DIPA.

name: Hazy Double IPA #05
text: Citra, Sabro, Mosaic, El Dorado and HBC 431. Five of our favourite hops packed into a light, fruity and smooth DIPA base

name: Honey Double IPA Collab
text: Our first local collaboration with the team who started it all here - Medvedgrad. A robust, biscuty, floral Double IPA with the addition of 100% local honey. Pouring a dark honey gold with a creamy thick head, this easy drinking DIPA welcomes you with strong notes of honey, pineapple, and floral bouquet on the nose. The big sticky mouth filling sweetness is cut through by the 75 IBUs given by american Denali and Lemondrop hops. This balanced marriage lends strong notes of biscuit, honey, pineapple, and citrus that will leave you full on a cold winters night.

name: Paradigma No.1
text: n/a

name: Pineapple DIPA
text: Our 200th Brew! A deceptively easy drinking IPA combined with fresh pineapple chunks in the whirlpool and dry hopped with some of the sexiest new and experimental hops money can buy. A heavy hitter for bringing in the summer and our brewhouse's 2nd birthday!

name: 5th Element Imperial IPA
text: LJUBAV / ZRAK - Svaka receptura dobiva svoju istinsku moć tek u trenutku kada joj se doda peti element. Iz zemlje potekao hmelj u zrak ispušta zamamne mirise koje ljubav pivara zarobljava u njegovom pivu.Aroma: Naglašeno smolaste, citrusne, hmeljne arome tipične za američke hmeljne sorte COLUMBUS, CHINOOK, CASCADE i CENTENNIAL. U pozadini hmeljne arome pojavljuje se slatkasta aroma karamela i alkohola izvrsno balansiranih početnom gorčinom. Unatoč povećanom sadržaju alkohola vrlo pitko.Izgled: Mutno, narančaste bakrene boje s postojanom pjenom.Okus: Kao i aroma, bogatog je hmeljnog okusa balansiranog slatkoćom karamela i alkohola.Punoća: Punog tijela profinjene teksture s prikrivenim utjecajem alkohola, blago karbonizirano, okrepljujuće.Uparivanje s hranom: meso i ribe s roštilja, voćni deserti, tvrdi sirevi intenzivnog okusaServiranje: 10 – 12°CČaša: tulip

name: Black Blizzard
text: Double black IPA is a new hoppy beer style that has trending place amongst hopfoward craft breweries around the world. We are excited to bring this trend to Croatia and region because is's powerful stuff, guys!Loaded with a combo of Cashmere, Mosaic, Simcoe and Columbus hops in dry hop, this is a very drinkable beast with citrusy, flowery, bit herbal aromas and piney notes with subtle roasty and nice chocolate background from dark malts. Ends with lasting hoppy taste and fair bitterness, as it should be for double black IPA.Also, a monster on the label is just awesome and cool, just like this hardcore hoppy IPA!This is why we brew!

name: Imperial Milkshake IPA
text: Smoothie style Milkshake IPA loaded with Simcoe, Citra, Azacca and Sabro hops, amped up with a blend of Mango, Mandarin and Papaya.  Topped with generous milk sugar and vanilla.

name: Moxie
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Boldly hopped and with its silky texture, soft body and intense aromas of tangerine, orange, lime, vanilla and just a gentle hint of cinnamon, Moxie is a liquid hop ceremony with a sumptuous holiday twist.

name: Double B
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Double trouble, double badassness, double IPA, double B...Do you feel lucky, punk?Get ready to be kicked from hops! This double trouble IPA gonna provide you tropical citrusy punch with more than 8.2%abv kick.Beware, it's easy drinkable double east coast IPA.   Bit hazy, super juicy and with slight bitterness at the end.

name: Monocchio
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: We continued with series of beer labels with mythical creatures and legends. For those who spent their childhood playing strategy games like 'Heroes of Might and Magic' will surely recognize inspiration for this beer label.Brewed with Mosaic, Citra, Eukanot, Ahhhhroma and Nectarom, burst tropical and citrusy flavours, with some and spicy notes.Monocchio is a one-eyed giant cyclope! Enjoy!

name: Nuff Hop'd
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: A second hazy IPA in our "Triple threesome IPA series" is Double New England IPA."Triple threesome" is a new project that pushes the limits on the hop amount in beer! It is all about hops and silky texture in your mouth. We will present three hazy IPAs, use three varieties of hops per beer and three different yeasts - Triple threesome includes hazy IPA, Double IPA and Triple IPA!NUFF HOP'D is the showcase of African Queen, Rakau and Citra hops!Lalbrew New England yeast gave even more fruity aromas to 'nuff' hoppy profile. Apricot, peaches, tropical, citrusy, overall juicy, silky texture with 'nuff' bitterness.BEER READY for more!

name: Hazy Double IPA
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Big, juicy and bursting with Pineapple & Peach flavours from the Bru-1, Galaxy, Cascade & Citra hops. Made with our Hungarian friends Reketye Brewing Co

name: El Galactico
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: La Fuerza desde la profundidad del Universo está viajando hacia la Tierra. El Galactico Violente aplasta todo en su camino, y nada puede detener su 7,5% ABV y 25 IBU-s!

name: New England Double IPA
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Thick and juicy oat-laden IPA with heavy notes of sweet citrus, Coconut and Pineapple. Crammed with Citra, Citra Spectrum, Azacca, Talus and Sabro hops

name: Hazy Double IPA: Spectrum & Lupomax Showcase
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Huge Tangerine, Citrus & Marmalade punch! Packed with brilliant, fresh hop products from our supplier Barth Haas

kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: 29. po redu rođendansko pivo spada u kategoriju robusnih teškaša: double NEIPA vrlo je jako pivo, sočna bomba tropsko – citrusnih okusa dobivenih od velike količine hmelja i specijalnog kvasca.

name: Sky Creature
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Double Neipa features a big dose of Sub Zero Hop Kief of Motueka and Rakau and classic T90 of Strata and Azacca pallets.#weraiseaglasstoyou!

name: Hazy Double IPA (Eclipse, Vic Secret & Sabro)
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Smooth, Balanced & Juicy. Tropical flavours of Mango, Pineapple & Coconut with a subtle note of Pine. Made with our good friends from Argentina

name: Double KettleBrew
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: A second collab with the Synergy Fitness crowd. This collab is also dedicated to the kettlebell, but this time, the double kettlebell! Double Kettlebrew is a good training partner, which can quickly become a sparring partner if you're not careful.

name: Orange Hoppin Goblin
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: We have rounded up Orange Goblin's 30-year career with this juicy, hazy beast that delivers massive hop flavors, which go well with Goblin's raw guitar riffage! Three decades of pure rock 'n' roll energy!

name: Double IPA
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Smooth, juicy and full-bodied. Waves of citrus, pineapple and stone fruits with hints of mango, peach and pine.

name: Lagano
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy

name: Big Foot
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Smaller cousin of Regoč went to America and all he got was New England legends and myths. DDH Oats, wheat, barley, chinook-citra-simcoe hops.

name: Zero
text: Zero is our first Milkshake Neipa for the new series.Contain lactose of course and wheat, oats for extra fluffy mouth feel.DDH with combo Citra Cryo and Nelson Sauvin plus Abstrax Terpenes Gelato and for the end some Madagascar and Uganda Vanilla beans.

name: Key Lime Pie Milkshake IPA
text: Piquant and aromatic with fresh Lime, Vanilla and loads of Lactose. Based on the US truck stop classic and brewed with our boys from Nicosia.

name: Milkshake IPA (6.2%)
text: Sweet creamy and juicy. Super Milky - With  3 times more lactose than we have ever used! Subtle sweet notes of passion-fruit, mango, strawberry, and vanilla. Fermented out with unique White Labs London Fog yeast WLP066.

name: Pillow Crush
text: DRINK FIRST, PILLOW FIGHT LATER!

name: Pineapple Milkshake IPA
text: Creamy, tropical and sweet with a lingering bitterness. Our Milkshake with fresh pineapple and vanilla.

name: Puzzle Series Juicy IPA - Sabro #1
text: Puzzle Series is a series of smaller batches of beer produced with similar barley combinations but vastly different hops combinations! First in the series is SABRO Juicy IPA

name: Raspberry Milkshake IPA
text: Another twist on our experimental milkshake series. A heavy dose of wheat in this brew backed up by an aggressive hoppy bitterness all brought together by lallemands new NEIPA yeast. In conditioning weve added an outragrous amount of raspberry puree which is rounded out with a touch of vanilla. Tart, Fruity and silky smooth.

name: Imperial Strawberry & Vanilla Milkshake IPA
text: Big, bold, and decadently creamy, this turbocharged Milkshake IPA is brewed with heaps of fresh strawberries and smoothed out with rich vanilla, creating the ultimate liquid dessert.

name: Milkshake IPA (Brussels Beer Project)
text: Soft and full-bodied with citrus aromas and gentle vanilla and stone fruit flavours.The Garden Brewery asked 16 of its favourite global breweries to work with us to create exclusive collab beers for Restore Our Earth, a charity project we initiated with Beer52, the world’s biggest beer club. In the Summer of 2022 1.5 millions cans will be distributed globally.The Garden Brewery and Beer52 have committed to donate at least €30,000 to charities with proven high impact deliverables in Marine Conservation, Forest Conservation, Reimagining Carbon, Education & Behavior, Food & Agriculture and building Climate Resistant Communities.

name: Fresh Hop: 2025 NZ IPA Hop V1 - Riwaka DH
text: This is the First beer in our new Fresh Hop series, where we honor the annual hop harvest in its purest form! 2025 NZ IPA Hop V1 showcases the vibrant character of New Zealand's Riwaka hops, harvested at peak freshness from Freestyle Hops farm!

name: NELSON
text: NELSON is our Bernese mountain dog. Year One for this batch and many more to come.This batch has a special list of Nelson hops.Eggers Nelson, FreeStyle Nelson, Kohia Nelson 2025 crop, and new Fresh Nelson Hop Press Juice.Say Hello To Nelson!!

name: Fresh Hop: 2025 NZ IPA Hop V2 - Harvest Mix DH
text: Our second release, in the Fresh Hop series, captures the essence of New Zealand through freshly harvested Motueka, NZ Cascade, and Riwaka hops direct from Freestyle Hops Farm!

name: Crash Day
text: Crash Day is an annual celebration of faulty logic, wrong choices, and bad decisions. It's a homage to our 2025 New Zealand road trip and friend Krešo, so it's brewed with New Zealand hops that, unlike Krešo, actually know what they're doing.

name: The Grey Pilgrim
text: Crushable IPA loaded with hops from down under - Galaxy, Rakau and Moutere.Easy going, hoppy and tastefull." All we have to do is decide what to do with the IPA that is given to us." The Grey Pilgrim

name: Sunset Bunny Trail
text: A fluffy bunnies are your modern sherpas, and they know the mountain better than you! If you get lost, just follow the white rabbits into the Sunset!

name: Phantasm IPA
text: This Summer beauty is bright & refreshing with a lush, fruit-forward profile. We showcase the amazing way Phantasm (natural grape extract) combines with Hop Unlock yeast to biotransform natural compounds in hops & malts for intense flavour & aroma, while Riwaka & Motueka hops provide zesty citrus & herbal notes.

name: Small Batch Series : 39 Mountain IPA
text: Mountain IPA brewed with Galaxy, HBC 630, Citra, and Mosaic hops.

name: Sunshine Sipper
text: Small Ipa is a Session Ipa, only 4.5 abv DDH with Simcoe, Krush and Columbus Cryo.No oats or wheat in the mash only WHC juicy yeast for some extra flavor.

name: Fantom 34
text: Fantom 34 je Mountain IPA, osvježavajuće mutno pivo bogatog okusa, izvrsnog balansa gorčine i slatkoće, tropsko citrusnih nota i vrlo pitko.

name: Pistol Smoke
text: PISTOL SMOKEMODER IPAThis is another crossover between East Coast and West Coast Ipa. Clean base malt, sharp and hoppy beer with juicy yeast strain.Pistol was fully loaded with classic bullets like SIMCOE and NELSON SAUVIN and then with some more young guns like KRUSH CRYO and PEACHARINE SUB ZERO.#Duel You Can't Miss!!!

name: Fantom 47
text: Mountain IPA mutno zlatne boje, svježih tropskih mirisa i aroma koje mu daju šest vrsta hmeljeva. Umjerenog tijela i lijepo balansirane gorčine i slatkoće.

name: Fantom 40
text: Fantom 40 je Mountain IPA, osvježavajuće mutno pivo bogatog okusa, izvrsnog balansa gorčine i slatkoće, tropsko citrusnih nota i vrlo pitko.

name: Phantasm Orgasm
text: This tiolized IPA was made with a mission to release the maximum fruit flavors from all ingredients and production processes. Tiolized yeast from White Labs was used to release these aromatic compounds from malt, hops: Mosaic Cryo, Citra Cryo, Nectaron, and Saaz, as well as from Phantasm powder obtained from Sauvignon Blanc skins from New Zealand. The result is a fruity orgasm with 6.5% alcohol.

name: Dream Like This Must Die
text: American IpaDDH with BRU 1 + Motueka

name: Fantom IPA 2
text: Novo pivo u našoj eksperimentalnoj seriji je prekrasno zahmeljeni India Pale Ale koji nastavlja tradiciju finih Fantom piva koja su svaki put drugačija. Između šest vrsti hmeljeva koja smo koristili ističu se Ella i Enigma, te stari znanac Vic Secret. Uživajte u ovom finom i pitkom predahu od stvarnosti!

name: Kolaboracija 3
text: Kolaboracija 3 - micro NEIPATreća po redu kolaboracija s Nova Runda Brewery i Zmajska pivovara kuhana je kod nas. Plan je bio napraviti vrlo aromatično pivo koje se pije lagano s obzirom na vrućine koje nam ovih dana vrše pritisak na regiju. Nakon agresivnog sastančenja odabir je pao na micro NEIPA. Dakle, New England IPA s intenzivnim citrusnim aromama hmelja, bogato suho hmeljena, zaokruženog okusa, ali micro - svega 2,7% alkohola! To je onaj "pije se lagano" dio. ?Riwaka, Cryo Citra i Cryo Mosaic zaslužni su za bogatu citrusno aromatiku ovog piva i za sramežljivih 15 jedinica gorčine.

name: Svarog
text: Unatoč dolasku IPA-e u Hrvatsku preko Američke pivske revolucije, ovo pivopredstavlja našu pretpostavku kako je stil morao izgledati na svojem izvoru na putovanjima skroz do daleke Indije.Više alkohola, više probranog hmelja ali i mnogo okusa koje američki stilovi skrivaju - ječam, još ječma, i onda još sasvim malo ječma. Uzdravlje!

name: Novi Val
text: A different taste, a top-notch balance and a wonderful aroma of three exotic New World hops. Let's go back to the eighties and start the New Wave...

name: IPA 52
text: Nefiltrirano, nepasterizirano domaće ale pivo bez konzervansa, umjetnih bojila i bilo kakvih drugih dodataka, s prirodnim jestivim talogom kvasca, refermentirano u boci. Napravljeno od 2 vrste najfinijeg njemačkog slada i 5 vrsta najkvalitetnijeg američkog hmelja, odakle i dolazi naziv IPA 52. Poželjno čuvati na hladnom i tamnom mjestu u uspravnom položaju

name: San Servolo IPA
text: IPA pivo - specijalno ale pivo vareno od najboljih vrsta engleskog slada i hmelja, robustnog tijela i izrazito voćne arome, proizvedeno po uzoru na engleska piva koja su se brodovima prevozila u Indiju, pa su sadržavala veći postotak alkohola i hmelja da bi izdržala taj naporan put. San Servolo IPA, putovanje do Indije u vašoj čaši...

name: Rovinjsko IPA
text: Limited edition by pitko

name: Fireball
text: Seasonal IPA ideal for winter period. Full bodied, malty and hopped with Comet hops.

name: Fantom 46
text: Fantom 46 je IPA prekrasne rubin boje, odlično balansirana uz finu gorčinu i srednje tijelo koje ju čini vrlo pitkom.

name: March On
text: WE HAVE BEEN MARCHING STRONGLY SINCE (MARCH) 2013. AS OUR BIRTHDAY TRIBUTE, THIS YEAR, WE ARE JOINING PINK BOOTS SOCIETY, SUPPORTING WOMEN IN BEER. SO TAKE A MOMENT TO CELEBRATE WITH US WITH AN ALL WOMEN BREWED RED ALE, A PINK BOOTS BLEND. Pink Boots Collaboration Brew Day®. A portion of the proceeds from the sale of this beer goes to the Pink Boots Society.

name: Kaj-Pa
text: Kaj-Pa, new take on rye ipa by #lepidecki Brewery. Magnum, Chinook and Citra from hops, rye and malts. Proper, genuine rye IPA

name: Switch
text: Eksplozija aroma tropskog voća i citrusa u ovom pivu nikoga neće ostaviti ravnodušnim. Idealna kombinacija raži i američkih hmeljeva zaslužna je za ovo gorko ali iznimno aromatično pivo punog tijela. Za prave pivoljupce i one koji žele biti posebni!

name: Hop Volantis
text: Session NEIPA, hops Citra, Mosaic, Strata, Talus.

name: Anchovy Sesh.
text: Session Ipa with the new hop ANCHOVY from Segal Ranch in Yakima, Washington.Anchovy and Citra Cryo combo.

name: Microburst
text: It refreshes with citrus, lime and grapefruit aromas along with the sweet and fruity aromas of tropical fruits and nectarines. Mildly bitter, medium dry finish.

name: Hladovina
text: What could be better for hot summer days then an IPA with low ABV. This Session IPA is hopped with Galena, Mosaic and El Dorado hops which give spicy, juicy and fruity notes.

name: Bitter Hug
text: Malts: pale, wheat malt, flaked oats, carapilsHops: cascade, citra, styrian wolfYeast: verdant IPA

name: Baron De Hopard
text: Malts: Pale Ale, Carabody,  Munich Hops: Cryo Cascade, Citra, Simcoe, MosaicYeast: YF-107Extra: Orange peel, lemon peel

name: Summer Mode
text: Summer time brings summer mode. The best possible outfit to enjoy your cold summer brew is combo of mullet, sandals, comb, glasses and Session IPA!

name: Ringišpil
text: Dođi klizni mi niz grlo!Kad sunce u čelo tuče i osjetis da ti je vruće, s vjetrom laganini u kosi, vrtuljak okusa misli nek ti nosi... uskoči i zavrti svoj RINGIŠPIL!

name: Vibe
text: Hazy (some oat flakes and wheat malt) session IPA fermented using Verdant yeast. Idaho 7, Calista and Styrian Wolf hop additions on Whirlpool and dry hop only to give a gentle bitterness and plenty of flavor and aroma! Caution: This beer is such a summer thirst quencher it's practically impossible to only have 1

name: Small Batch IPA #01
text: Session IPABright and hazy light bodied IPA with hop-forward character. Strong bitterness with a lot of citrus and tropical fruit aroma. ABV 5.5%

name: Jam Session IPA
text: Session India Pale Ale is a style combining massive amounts of hops with a low alcohol percentage. The fruity notes of American hops and their pleasant bitterness will perfectly reward your palate with the taste of summer. Hops: Cascade, Chinook, Citra.

name: Ipanema Session IPA
text: Refreshing session IPA with Talus, Sabro and Riwaka hops.

name: Landsky
text: This session IPA was made in honor of one of the coolest woman in Zagreb's history - the first female ZET conductor Paula Landsky! We want our beer to be just like her - fearless and sophisticated!

name: Vragec
text: Refreshing red beer with an emphasized hoppy character, bitterness of 45 IBU and irresistible fruit flavours Hops used: East Kent Golding, Mandarina Bavaria, Mosaic, Simcoe

name: King's Session IPA
text: King's SIPA (Session IPA) offers an explosion of fruity aromas of orange, mango, and white guava, perfectly complemented by discreet hop notes of pine, resin, and stone fruit. Furthermore, you'll be charmed by the sweet aromas of biscuits and sponge cake, which enrich the experience of this beer delight. Despite its delicate body, there is a noticeable bitterness that adds complexity to the taste, while its dry and tender orange hue makes it visually appealing and a desirable choice.

name: Therapy
text: Very light and refreshing beer that go along equally well on the beach and at a business lunch. Inhale tropical aromas and dismiss all problems.

name: Session IPA
text: Angeluš . Session IPA je suho hmeljeno ale pivo sa Citra, Mosaic i Galaxy hmeljevima.

name: To je vuk!
text: It's a WOLF! To je vuk! Styrian Wolf hop with Citra and Amarillo - something new from #LepiDecki

name: Sretno Dijete
text: Sretno dijete je session IPA koja sretnim čini vas, ali i djecu jer se sa svakim prodanim pivom dio zarade donira nekoj od udruga za zaštitu djece.

name: Fjaka
text: Tropical & Vibrant. Easy drinking IPA with notes of Pineapple & Papaya

name: Grif Session IPA
text: Pivski znalci složit će se da je Session IPA već sama po sebi oksimoron. A kako bismo spojili nespojivo, potreban je i dobar grif. S obzirom na to da nam izazovi nisu strani, upustili smo se u još jednuzahtjevnu pivarsku avanturu tijekom koje smo dobili GRIF SESSION IPA, lagano pivo s malim udjelom alkohola kojeg krase odlike prave IPA-e. Hmeljna gorčina je u skladu s lakšim tijelom za što je zaslužan hmelj Magnum, dok su se za voćnu aromatičnost pobrinuli hmeljevi Mosaic i Amarillo.

name: Micro IPA
text: Balanced, easy-drinking Micro IPA, packed with tropical aromatics of peach and mango. Micro in ABV, but full of hop character and flavour.Hops Columbus, Azacca, Simcoe, GalaxyMalts Vienna, Dextrin, Wheat, Oats, Golden Naked OatsYeast Saturated

name: Micro IPA - German Comet & Lemondrop
text: An experimental low strength IPA. A well-rounded body and robust bitterness belie its alcohol content with notes of citrus, passionfruit and a light grassiness.

name: GLUTENKO
text: Our first ever gluten free beer. One of the few gluten free beers still rocking full hoppy flavor!This Session IPA was dry hopped with Citra and Ekuanot hops. Light, 5% alch, very refreshing.CAUTION! Glutenko was made with malts specially processed to reduce amount of gluten.This beer is NOT brewed in dedicated gluten free facility thus consumers extremely sensitive to gluten are to be advised. Each batch of this beer will be laboratory tested to ensure it is under 20 ppm of gluten before bottling and keging.Before ordering this beer make sure that tap lines have been properly cleaned and glasses don't have residue of previous beer.

name: Micro IPA - Mosaic & Azacca
text: A tropical low ABV IPA. Dank Mosaic hops support the intense juiciness and tropical notes of Azacca.

name: Kveik Session IPA
text: Refreshing hazy session IPA with punchy azacca and simcoe hops.  Brewed with Ebbegarden Kveik yeast for tropical fruit aromas.

name: Tulum
text: Hazy session IPA brewed with Simcoe, Mosaic and Idaho 7 made for BEER52

name: Siesta Session
text: Session IPA with Mosaic and Cascade hops.

name: Session IPA
text: Showcasing Mosaic hops in their Incognito and Spectrum forms. We gave her the already checked recipe for a fruited NEIPA, but made sure that sourness is present to make it extra refreshing. We also used Sultana hops along with Ella, which makes this beer a proper orange juice substitute in the morning (if it wasn't for the 6% ABV)

name: Triple I.P.A
text: An imperial IPA packed with a huge punch of eye watering hops. Its continuously hopped, in small doses, over its 60 minute boil, then a heavily whirlpool addition of west coast American hops. We then continuously dry hopped it every single day during its fermentation. Once our house vermont yeast had finished, we then dry hopped it another 4 times over 2 weeks. Dank citrus, tropical fruit, pine, and floral notes assault the nose while a complex bitterness rounds out the high alcohol making this imperial monster deceptively quaffable.

Početak whiskeya i ovog piva je isti, napravljeni su od istog slada u istoj pivovari, a kasnije su nastavili svatko svojim zvjezdanim putem. Medo Veliki je bogato, zaokruženo i ugodno dugotrajno pivo s whiskey karakterom.

Ovaj amber lager ima 5,3% alkohola i 31 IBU – to je osvježavajući i pitki lager duboke jantarne boje, sladnog okusa i pripitomljene gorčine s laganim citrusnim i karamelnim okusima u pozadini.

Ovaj poseban lager oduševljava bogatim tijelom te moćnim hmeljnim karakterom. Dominira čarolija Sabro hmelja iz kojeg dolaze arome tropskog voća i kokosa.#ostanitedoma i uživajte u ovom pitkom i ukusnom predahu od stvarnosti!

name: First Born Unicorn
text: A first 'born' beer in 2023!We wanted to do a new crazy beer label to open 2023 year. Something funny and crazy, a fluffy beast, raging unicorn in princess outfit, hardcore softporn... For all rockheads, you know where we have found our inspiration for name and label...We really put enough hops to enhance citrusy, floral, herbal and bit spicy aromas.Like true west coast beer, clean, hoppy and bit bitter. With lower alcohol than IPA, it is meant to be drinkable all day and night, just like lager should be.Man, this is a tastefull beer! This is why we brew!

text: A juicy pale with a refreshing citrusy aroma from Citra hops, complemented with the sweet orange and mango aromas from the Amarillo hops. Apricot colored, moderately hazy appearance adds to the juiciness of this beer, but of course it’s the flavor that truly defines it, so we added oats for a fuller body, and a bit of lactose for smoothness and bringing the sweet nectar like taste to the front. The finish is pleasantly refreshing bitterness that just makes you crave for more.

name: Small Batch Series: 52 Juicy Pale Ale
text: Juicy American Pale Ale brewed with an experimental YCH 603 trial blend of hops

name: Small Batch Series : 40 American Pale Ale
text: American Pale Ale brewed with a blend of Chinook, Mosaic, Styrian wolf, and Citra hops

name: Leemoon Pie Oat Cream Pale
text: Hazy Pale loaded with oats for soft, creamy mouthfeel. Double dry hopped with Motueka & Sabro.

name: APA Single Hop: Idaho 7
text: First in the new Single Hop series where we glorify amazing ingredients - The hops. The First hop is popular newcomer Idaho 7 (since 2015 in the market).

text: Special St. Patrick's Day edition of American Pale Ale. The pot of this green and mighty leprechaun is filled with hops instead of gold!!
