name: BARBA Single Hop CITRA
text: 2nd beer in our Single Hop lineup... this time we are using only CITRA hop in our beer. Beer is double hopped compared to Cascade Single Hop.Light body is pronouncing hop flavor and aroma.We believe we have a champ!!! Let us know what you think?!

name: Šibenski Učenjak
text: Collaboration brew between Šibenik students’ club in Zagreb and our brewery. American pale ale best suited for warmer days, and only available in Šibenik.

name: Palisade Pale
text: Single hop pale ale using Palisade hops.Part of our educational series in which you can learn alongside our brewers what different & exciting fresh hops they are using. A single hop pale ale showcasing the American hop Palisade. Grown in the ‘hop belt’ of America’s Northwest by Select Botanicals Group, Palisade is an aroma hop known for its high yield and its unique aroma profile. Described as earthy, floral, and fruity with notes of apricot and grass. The higher myrcene levels found in Palisade are what contribute to the piney, citrus ,and fruity complexities found in its aroma.

name: Akcent
text: DDH APA

name: Kama Citra
text: Pale Ale with 4 malts and 1 hop called Citra. Well balanced

name: Žetva
text: Seasonal Wet Hop beer brewed with fresh Slovenian hops Aurora

name: Simcoe Pale
text: Single hop pale ale using Simcoe hops. Grown in the ‘hop belt’ of America’s Northwest by Select Botanicals Group, Palisade is an aroma hop known for its high yield and its unique aroma profile. Described as Fruity, Earthy, Piney, and Dank with notes of passionfruit and berries. The extremely low Cohumulone levels in Simcoe contribute to the soft, smooth, approachable bitterness found here.

name: American Pale Ale
text: Malts: Pale, Munich, CaraPils, AromeHops: Mosaic, AzaccaYeast: Verdant IPA

name: Valens Pale Ale
text: Samer iz kaming! U iščekivanju smrdljivih martina, komaraca, omare i prašine, Valentinijan d.o.o. je preduhitrio gore navedeno i složio jedno lagano ljetno veselje. Riječ je o Pale ale Valensu! Pivo je lagano, gorkasto i aromatično. Gorčina 37 IBU-a, Abv 4,5%.

name: Adriatic Pale Ale
text: Vamos a la playa?Big, juicy and bursting with flavour. Sessionable sunshine. 13°

name: Kveik Pale Ale
text: A New England style pale hopped with Bru-1, Citra, and El Dorado, and fermented with Ebbegarden Kveik yeast.  Strong tropical notes of guava, pineapple, melon and mango.

text: 1st beer in our Single Hop lineup... this time we are using only CASCADE hop in our beer. Soon to follow up will be Citra or Summit...

name: Šesta Od Sedam
text: Name translates as “Sixth Out Of Seven”

name: Beer Bash 2024
text: This is the third time we've brewed up this magic potion for our annual Beer Bash, but this year, we're doubling down on the fun with a TWO-DAY bender. Unleash your inner Aussie with this New England Pale Ale that has a juicy ticket to the land down under!

name: Spakovo 3
text: Juicy double dry hopped pale ale packed with Galaxy and Vic Secret hops.

name: Galaxy Pale #05
text: Our 5th Single Hop Showcase is the Australian Galaxy: it's all about the passionfruit, pineapple and guava .

name: IBA - Istrian Belgian Ale
text: Limited Edition available in 0,33 and 0,75 bottle format. Top fermented belgian style ale with a deep copper colour, unpasteurized, unfiltered, bottle fermented (bottle conditioned). Fermented with selected belgian abbaye yeast. Maturation for 4 months in the bottles

name: Belgian Pale Ale
text: Naše prvo pivo, pivo sa pričom i pivo sa čak 9 različitih etiketa iz cijeloga svijeta. Naš BPA. We are so proud of this one…

name: ENGLEZ 2018
text: Our new take on ENGLEZ and English style ale. All new brew for 2018, this time more on verge of English Pale Ale and IPA.Crisp, light malty flavor, refreshing, slight esters with hoppy backbone!

name: NEON BLISS
text: FRUITED PALE ALEMANGO and COCONUT plus DH with SABRO

name: Juicy Pale Ale
text: Pomalo Juicy Pale Ale je Milkshake Pale Ale s 5,5% alkohola i 39 IBU. Ovo pivo donosi sočne arome tropskog voća, poput breskve i citrusa, uz dodatak laktoze koja mu daje kremastu teksturu. Blago je mutno, srednje karbonizirano i izrazito pitko, s uravnoteženom gorčinom i suhim završetkom. Inspirirano dalmatinskom filozofijom “pomalo”, idealno je za opuštanje i uživanje u svakodnevnim trenucima.Zgrabi novi Juicy pale ale, zavali se i živi ovaj trenutak POMALO.

name: Ice Cream Pale Ale
text: Soft scoop vanilla ice cream pale ale with tropical and citrus notes.

name: Lupulin Tribe
text: Hoppy Warriors: Come Out and Pla-aay!!Always fun to brew a beer with my brother's TAP BULIES, Sandi i Matija.This is a crushable, easy-drinking, super juicy hazy pale with the new hop HBC 1019 and Citra Cryo.

name: Fantom Motive NE Pale Ale
text: Tajanstveni, fantomski pivar Medvedgrada kuha različite pivske stilove, a svako pivo je novo i uvijek drugačije recepture. Ovog je puta skuhao New England Pale Ale u kolaboraciji s Motive Beer Company, koju predvodi sjajni irski majstor pivar Simon O'Keeffe! Kako i doliči ovom pivskom stilu, prevladava okus tropskog voća i juicy karakter, a pivo je osvježavajuće i lagano pa klizi niz grlo i po najvećim vrućinama.

name: Beer Bash 2025
text: 2025 Birthday Bash beer. New England Pale Ale brewed with Cascade, Cryo Athanum, NZ Cascade, Motueka, Galaxy Spectrum, and Cryo Loral.

name: F5
text: Special brew made for our friends WebCamp Zagreb - IT conference focused on web technologies which is being held annually in Zagreb.

name: Beer Hunter
text: For all you 'beer brothers and sisters' who love  divine liquid called 'a beer' and everything that goes with it. We share your commitment and passion.Please, enjoy this new england pale ale made with super big hops combo - Amarillo, Citra, HBC 630, Idaho 7, Mosaic, Sabro, and Talus. It doesn't feel like your usual 5,2% beer, for sure. And yet, refreshing and drinkable!This is why we brew!

name: First SIP
text: Take the first SIP- soft, hazy, slightly emotional- hops before speeches- small SIP for you, giant SIP for us

name: Beer Not Bombs
text: They asked for help, we answer it. We dedicate this beer to Ukraine's association 'Dobro Dobrim' to help them in this rough time. Every war is a bad thing, Lot of suffering and losses. Beer not bombs is our message to all, as we should spread love, kindness and respect, not hate and horror. Beer instead bombs!We will help them with 10% from each sale and hope that our little support will mean something. This is why we brew!Absolute drinkability, hazy, silky and very smooth and tasty.Cheers!

name: Superdelic Tide
text: Hops: SuperDelic, Citra, Idaho 7

name: Mighty Gorgon
text: We continued with series of beer labels with mythical creatures and legends. For those who spent their childhood playing strategy games like 'Heroes of Might and Magic' will surely recognize inspiration for this beer label.Unlike in the game, the sturdy gorgons won't attack you with their acidic breath. It'll only fill your mouth with burst tropical flavours. Brewed and dryhopped with huge amount of Krush, Eukanot and Citra, it's more to hoppy side!

name: Alles Neu
text: Collaboration brew with our dear friends from Vienna, Austria - Bräuhaus Ten.Fifty. New England Pale ale brewed with New Zealand hops - Nelson Sauvin, Wakatu, Motueka, Riwaka, and NZ Cascade.

name: Hazy Maze
text: You don't wanna find your way out!

name: Slumberland
text: Chinook, Citra & Mosaic hops.

name: Don Lupulo
text: Malts: Pils, Wheat, Munich, Carabody, Cara30Hops: Cryo Cascade, Kohatu, Krush, SabroYeast: Verdant IPA

name: Small Batch Series : 47 NE Pale Ale
text: New England Pale Ale brewed for our friends - Viking pub located in Sarajevo! It's brewed with Nectaron and Pacific Sunrise hops.

name: New England Pale Ale - Galaxy and Citra
text: Waves of passionfruit, peach and melon aromas overlay a oat laden malt base.  A New England Pale Ale that lets Galaxy and Citra hops shine!

name: New England Pale Ale #04 - Citra Showcase
text: Citra hops done 3-ways: T90 pellets, Lupomax and Cryo Big hitting Melon, Grapefruit and stone fruit aromas shine

name: Full Tilt
text: New England Pale Ale brewed with Galaxy, Citra, Mosaic and Pacific Sunrise hops.

name: Lotus
text: Juicy Pale Ale. Colab brew between Zmajska pivovara and Reset Brewery, double dry hopped with Citra, Centennial and Lotus.

name: Small Batch Series: 79 Pomona Ekuanot Juicy Pale Ale
text: Small Batch 79 is a Juicy Pale Ale brewed with Cryo Ekuanot hops and Pomona yeast.

name: SLOOP
text: Collaboration with King's caffe.Hops: HBC586, Equinox

name: Hoplander
text: When Highlander brews a hoppy stew he immediately becomes the Hoplander! This New England Pale Ale is a joint effort with our colleagues from Bosnia and Herzegovina - Gorštak brewery. Rich and juicy Pale Ale hopped with Galaxy, Sabro, Mosaic and Chinook hops.

name: New England Pale Ale #08
text: Light, smooth and juicy Antipodean Pale with the very freshest Vics Secret and Eclipse hops

name: Hazy 13
text: 13th Anniversary Colaboration with Glam bar Dubrovnik. Brewed with Mosaic cryo and dry hopped with Talus and Sabro.

name: Veridian Hailstorm
text: We released another banger from monstrous cataclysmic beer label series!Black Blizzard, White Typhoon, Crimson Tornado, Dark Quasar and now - Veridian Hailstorm!Brewed with Azacca, Idaho7, Citra and Simcoe hops, it gives citrusy and tropical flavours.Beware, it is very hoppy! Smooth with bitterish finish, it crushable like monster on a label!

name: Crimson Tornado
text: A new monster on a beer label! After Black Blizzard and White Typhoon, it's time for Crimson Tornado!We brewed New England pale ale, but thanks to huge amount of hops you will experince IPA, really.Tropical aroma with pineapples, stone fruits, some dankness and herbal notes and citrusy background.Yes Nectaron, BRU-1, Lotus and Ekuanot hops combing power!

name: Chick Fight
text: We continue to brew hazy pale ales cause they are highly drinkable with lower alcohol, but still with tones of hops for very hoppy kick.Do you remember our double NEIPA 'Beerserker Rage' and berserker barbarian on its label?We also continue with beer label series inspired with creatures and mythology. Thunderbird and Phoenix, two chicks fighting for eternal glory!Will the raging Phoenix win because his resurrection ability or will the Thunderbird use his thunderbolts to crush flaming chick?Very hazy pale ale with tropical and citrus aroma from Mosaic, Citra, Idaho7 and Sabro hops.We could say it's hazy IPA how much hops we put in it, so expect hoppy kick.

name: Hoppykumulus
text: This is a collaboration beer between Bura Brew and Hotch Potch. If you were wondering what clouds taste like, you are about to find out: we joined forces with Bura Brew and tamed some clouds to serve you in glass. When you order our cloudy ale, don't be surprised with the smell of gummy bears and a hint of pear in flavor. Taming of clouds was a long process. They were so bitter at first that we have to give them a whole load of yellow gummy bears for the balance. As well for some unknown reason, they responded well when we gave them pears. Gummy bears and pears. And it was all yellow, and so is this ale.

name: New England Pale Ale #10
text: Smooth & juicy crusher with Pineapple, Passion Fruit & citrus aromas

text: New Citra & Mosaic Lupomax hop product showcase. Heavy notes of citrus, mango and melon

text: Peach, Mandarin and Coconut aromas. Packed with Sabro, Simcoe and HBC 431 hops

name: Fantom 35
text: Fantom 35 mutno je pivo puno hmelja i predivnih aroma, tropskih nota i lagane, balansirane gorčine koja mu daje svježinu i pitkost.

text: Smooth and tropical. Easy-drinking Pale packed with notes of Pineapple, Lime, Blueberry & Mandarin

text: Malt: Pale, Munich, wheat, carapilsHops: Styrian Wolf, HBC586, HBC630Yeast: Verdant IPA

text: Ripe tropical fruits and zesty citrus aromas combine with Pineapple, Mango & Grapefruit flavours in this smooth and creamy Pale. Made with our Croatian friends from Makarska

text: Heavily hopped with HBC431, El Dorado, Talus & Citra. Big stone fruit, citrus, Coconut and Pineapple aromas

text: New Zealand Pale Ale brewed with Citra, Motueka, Mosaic, and Peachtarine hops.

name: Small Batch 86: Freestyle Manilita
text: New Zealand Pale Ale brewed with Citra, Motueka, Mosaic, and Manilita hops.

name: Sir William's Ale
text: Not really a classic representative of the pale ale style. Characterized by strong hoppiness of Simcoe, Chinook, Citra, Cryo Citra and Nectaron hops. The aroma and taste flow from tropical fruit and citrus to pine and resin. Medium - bodied, moderate bitterness with a medium dry finish. Brewed as an hommage to the iconic place of Ljubljana's craft culture - Sir William's pub.

name: Pale Ale Dry Hopped
text: A special, dry hopped edition to celebrate 10 years since the release of our Pale ale.

name: Small Batch Series: 38 DDH Pale Kveik
text: Pale Kveik brewed with Riwaka, Pacific Sunrise, Galaxy, Citra, Mosaic

name: Badger
text: On draft best in a bar in Split on a hot spring/summer night

name: Ale With Rosemary
text: Adriatic Ale  is a pale ale beer with rosemary.Rosemary in Latin means sea dew. This beer brings the refreshment of the sea breeze on a hot summer day and the true taste of the Adriatic. Adriatic Ale offers refreshing and harmonious flavors of citrus, along with the gentle, aromatic bitterness of rosemary. Served at the right temperature of 8 to 10 degrees Celsius, it will go perfectly with a light Mediterranean meal. Rosemary is also a symbol of loyalty, so we are sure that you will always be loyal to this beer.

name: 2 DOGMA COLD APA
text: DDH cold APA, made with rice for extra crispiness.

name: Xtra Pale Ale
text: A dank pale with flavours of tangerine and citrus, a heavy malt base and a combination of AY4 American Ale and WLP 095 Burlington Ale yeasts.

name: Mandarina Bavaria Pale
text: Single Hop Series. A showcase of the German Mandarina Bavaria hop. Pouring a light golden yellow, high levels of limonene and linalool result in an aroma of fresh citrus and mandarin pith. Sweet mandarin citrus, with a dry, bitter finish.

name: Huell Melon Pale Ale
text: A brand new single-hopped Pale Ale, showcasing Huell Melon hops. Light-bodied, refreshing, with aromas of honeydew melon, strawberries and apricot. A proper summer beer, and perfectly thirst-quenching.

name: Pale Ale
text: Unpasteurised, unfiltered. Brewed on a wood stove.

name: Drifter
text: Small Pale Ale brewed with Styrian Wolf, Citra and  Simcoe.

name: Starfu*ker
text: Spar brand beer produced by The  Garden Brewery (The Bird d.o.o. company)

name: Pale Ale - Azacca Single Hop Showcase
text: Super sessionable pale with a bright, refreshing aroma and notes of juicy mango, citrus and subtle pine from the Azacca hops in their T90 and Cryo forms. A slightly bitter kick and dry finish makes for a highly drinkable thirst quencher.

name: Adriatik
text: Adriatik is a Sea Water Pale Ale, fresh, balanced, easily drinkable and rich in sensorial terms. The addition of Piran salt makes it unique, confering a light and interesting sapidity, and sealing an indivisible bond with the sea and the territory of Istria. Adriatik has an intense golden color, given by the Pale Ale malt, with notes of honey and cereal, a medium mouthfeel and a balanced bitterness. The scent released by lemon peels, added during the production process, makes it even more refreshing and suitable with delicate first courses, seafood and cruditès.

name: Imocko Pivo
text: Malt, citrus, fruits, juicy

name: SON OF THE BEACH
text: EXTRA PALE ALE FOR LEMMY49% Motherhopper and 51% Son Of The BeachDDH with Galaxy Quantum, Superdelic, Motueka, Sabro CryoCrank up the volume and raise your glass to the Man!

name: Dry Hopped Callista Pilsner
text: Super refreshing dry hopped pilsner fermented with a traditional Bavarian lager yeast with an ultra light, all-German malt base. Showcasing Callista hops developed at the Hull Research Institute, displaying vibrant aromas of apricot, pears, and strawberries, balanced with a crisp bitterness. A heatwave essential!

name: PLZ
text: Naše prvo core pivo - nefiltrirani češki pilsner.Varen s bohemian sladom, dvostrukom dekokcijom i legendarnim Saaz hmeljem, sve po p.s.-u!Zapamtite: u Češkoj se pije najviše piva po glavi stanovnika, a valjda ljudi znaju što rade!

name: Mali Purger
text: Brewed to celebrate a newborn at Mlinarica, this Bohemian Pils is all about balance and drinkability. Medium-full body with gentle breadiness and smooth malt character, with Saaz hops for a classic, noble, bitter, elegant finish. Soft, rounded, and dangerously easy to drink.Cheers to Mali Purger!

name: Zaboky 12 Ležak
text: Zaboky Ležak 12 is a homage to the Czech brewing tradition, crafted with the purity and precision it deserves. The result is a symphony of crisp malt character, accented by subtle floral and spicy notes from the noble Saaz hops.

name: Czech This Out!
text: BeeReady, and it's the 'Best of Show Beer at SMASH Homebrew Competition 2024. To get the story, this is a few words from our friends from #SMASH.'We are proud to announce that this year's best beer at the SMASH Homebrew competition was brewed by the talented Finn Markku and is headed your way. His 'Pale Czech Lager' won the hearts of the judges and the audience, and was declared the best of all submitted beers. As a prize for Best Of Show, Markku got the opportunity to brew his winning beer at the renowned Pulfer Brewery.'Needless to say, we are very pleased that we participated in this cool project in which we exchanged brewing tips, and had a great time along the way. Special thanks to all the guys from SMASH Homebrew Competition, CroCraft, and of course to the Markku.

name: Lager
text: Posljednje u seriji od pet piva koja pričaju Medvedgrad priču povodom 30. obljetnice svijetli je lager pod imenom Lager. Ovaj bohemian pilsner izraženog je sladnog okusa, izbalansiran s finom gorčinom koja dolazi od čeških hmeljeva.

name: Čakovečko
text: In the north there lies Čakovec, an old town with its mysteries, adventure and dragons. Čakovečko is a pilsner style beer released on 27/03/2019

name: Glider
text: Provjerena češka receptura i klasični pivski stil na Crafter's način! Pitko, lagano pivo sa cvijetnim aromama garantirano osvježava u svakoj prilici.

name: 5th Element Bonner
text: Karakterizira ga ugodna hmeljna gorčina, za nas tradicionalnih slovenskih hmeljeva Aurore i Goldinga, nadopunjena slatkoćom slada s hrvatskih polja. Jednostavno LJUBAV sa češkim otiskom koji objedinjuje najkvalitetnije sirovine tradicionalnog podrijetla koje koristimo kroz našu dugu povijest stvaranja piva.

name: Krigla
text: Krigla je drugo pivo u seriji od pet piva koja pričaju Medvedgrad priču povodom 30. obljetnice. Osvježavajuće, lagano svijetlo pivo, savršenog balansa slatkoće slada i njemačkih hmeljeva uz ugodnu gorčinu.

name: Fantom German Pilsner
text: Novi Fantom - novo pivo. Ovoga puta naš pivar je skuhao klasik - Extra Pale Premium Pilsner - perjanicu njemačkog pivarstva. Plemeniti hmeljevi - Tettnager, Mittelfruh, Spalter - daju mu pitkost, gorčinu te prepoznatljiv karakter. Prost!

name: Wintress
text: Brewed with Perle and Saphir hops, it's modern pilsner.Golden colored, crisp with fruity notes, dry with bitter end, highly crushable.

name: King's Pilsner
text: King's Pilsner (German Pilsner), captivates with its combination of dominant floral and spicy hop aromas, perfectly balanced with subtle fruity notes of red berries. Additionally, it features malt aromas of crackers, bread crust, and sweet dough, creating an irresistible sensation on the palate. In the aftertaste, a pleasant moderate bitterness is felt, while the drinking experience remains crisp, smooth, and refreshing. Moreover, our Pilsner beer boasts a beautiful thick creamy foam that lingers atop the glass, while its white gold color further enhances the aesthetic pleasure.

name: Angry Moose
text: Yep, we finally brewed L A G E R! After 5 years of our ale loyalty, we decided it's time to dive into lager production. 6 months of in depth analysis of Pilsner style, and many trial and errors during that period resulted with this classic German style Pils.

name: Oktobeer Pilsner #2
text: German-style Pils with Slovenian Styrian Kolibri hops. Refreshing & Floral.

name: Bright Arrow
text: Bright Arrow is the story of Prince Domagoj and the Neretva pirates who protected their coasts and the right to the sea by piracy. This German Pilsner is a light lager beer with a light body and low bitterness with light hop aromas.

name: Devetka La9er
text: Naš La9er je lagano pivo hmeljne arome, blage i ugodne gorčine, zlatne boje, bogate i čvrste pjene te, ono najvažnije, nevjerojatno pitko i osvježavajuće. Devetka La9er neće vas ostaviti ravnodušnima. Svaki novi gutljaj pozivati će vas na još, a užitak će biti potpun uz samo 4,5%  alkohola. Naš La9er jednostavno je Enjoyable.

name: GRIF Pilsner
text: GRIF Pilsner je naša posveta klasičnom njemačkom pilsneru. Riječ je o laganom i pitkom pivu čiju naglašenu cvjetnu notu dobivamo korištenjem plemenitog njemačkog aromatičnog hmelja Tettnager.GRIF Pilsner smo dugo ukomljavali te fermentirali na niskim temperaturama s diacetilnog stankom na kraju primarne fermentacije nakon čega je slijedio pretok, odležavanje te punjenje. Rezultat je nefiltriran i nepasteriziran pilsner koji je idealno popiti svježe natočenog na temperaturi od 3 do 8 Celzijevaca. Kako bi Nijemci rekli - prost!

name: Pilsner | Zora
text: This is our take on a traditional German Pilsner. A full malt bill; bready and soft caramel notes which has been generously hopped with a blend of Hallertauer Mittlefruh and Saaz hops and fermented with a classic Bavarian yeast. Clean, crisp and classic.

name: Fulir
text: German style pilsner lager with clean and dry refreshing taste.

name: CugMajstor
text: Plemeniti pilsnerMajstori pivari: Matt Hollingsworth i Božidar KostanjčarHmeljevi: Aurora, Tettnanger, Hallertauer Mittelfrueh

name: Palooza
text: Collab with LZO Brewery from Italy. Hop: Cascade

name: Giro Sul Luppolo
text: You have to cross the finish line in the first place if you want to win! This universal equation sounds simple but you have to infuse your body with enough hoppy electrolytes to achieve it. #PerLaVittoria

name: Italian Pilsner
text: Crisp & clean with a citric squeeze of Italian Oranges & Lemons

name: Split Apple Rock Pilsner #3 - Motueka
text: Split Rock Pilsner V3 takes you to New Zealand's Pikimai hop farm, where Motueka hops grow wild! This version is dry-hopped exclusively with Motueka, delivering a crisp and dry finish.

name: Split Apple Rock Pilsner #2 - Motueka And Riwaka
text: Crafted with traditional double decoction and Motueka and Riwaka hops, it strikes the perfect balance between drinkability and distinctive hop character that only New Zealand can provide.

name: Phial of Light
text: We have continued with beer series inspired by Tolkien's Middle Earth!It's hoppy pilsner brewed with Nelson Sauvin, Nectaron and light of Eärendil's star."... slowly he held aloft the Phial of Galadriel. ... then as its power waxed, and hope grew in Frodo’s mind, it began to burn, and kindled to a silver flame, a minute heart of dazzling light, as though Eärendil had himself come down from the high sunset paths with the last Silmaril upon his brow."

name: Small Batch Series: 71 New Zealand Juicy Pilsner
text: Hoppy and juicy Pils brewed with Nelson Sauvin and New Zealand Cascade.

name: Small Batch Series: 57 Oceania Pilsner
text: A Pilsner brewed with Motueka, Vic Secret, and Rakau hops.

name: Princess of Zeland
text: Malts: Pils,  Munich,  CaraBodyHops: Nectaron, Motueka, Kohatu, SuperdelicYeast: W34/70

name: Split Apple Rock Pilsner #4 - Nelson Sauvin
text: And we are in round 4 of our Split Rock Pilsner series. This time, we are going full Nelson Sauvin from New Zealand's Pikimai hop farm. We dry-hopped this NZ boy to push those wine-like notes while keeping it properly bitter and dry.

name: Split Apple Rock Pilsner #1 - Nelson And Cascade
text: The Split Rock watches over another expression of New Zealand's hops - pairing the Nelson Sauvin with Cascade hops. This Pilsner is showcasing how the same terrain can produce entirely different flavor profiles.

name: Zvir
text: Pale, dry, golden coloured, combines citrus fruits which dominate in aroma (lemon, lime, tangerine, grapefruit) with a background of sweet fruit notes of pineapple and mango.Hop: Riwaka, Motueka

name: Flame of the West
text: "Very bright was that sword when it was made whole again; the light of the sun shone redly in it, and the light of the moon shone cold, and its edge was hard and keen. And Aragorn gave it a new name and called it Andúril, Flame of the West."

name: Heart of the Mountain
text: We have continued with beer series inspired from Middle Earth!Crushable, easy-going hoppy pilsner brewed with Mosaic and New Zealand hops - Nelson Sauvin, Wai-iti and Motueka. Lots of tropical and limelike flavours, stonefruits and spiciness. We love it!

name: King of the Nine
text: "Upon it sat a shape, black-mantled, huge and threatening. A crown of steel he bore, but between rim and robe naught was there to see, save only a deadly gleam of eyes: the Lord of the Nazgûl... now he was come again, bringing ruin, turning hope to despair, and victory to death. A great black mace he wielded. "

name: New Zealand Dry Hopped Pilsner #7
text: Crisp and vibrant lager with mineral notes and Clementine, Melon, and Mango aromas

name: Fantom 48
text: Ovaj pilsner izdvaja se specifičnim hmeljnim profilom s potpisom iz dalekog Novog Zelanda. Lagane sladne baze, fine gorčine i osvježavajućeg završetka.

name: Small Batch Series : 45 Luminosa Pilsner
text: Pilsner brewed with Luminosa hops.

name: Small Batch Series: 70 DDH Juicy Pilsner
text: Number 70 from our Small Batch Series is a DDH Juicy Pils hopped with Mosaic, Citra, and Sabro hops.

name: Small Batch Series: 49 Juicy Pilsner
text: Juicy Pilsner brewed with Citra, Galaxy, and Mosaic hops.

name: Small Batch Series : 46 DDH Hazy Pilsner
text: Pils brewed with Nectaron, Bru-1, and Styrian Kolibri hops.

name: Small Batch Series: 55 Juicy Pilsner
text: Juicy Pilsner brewed with Motueka, Columbus, and HBC 630 hops.

name: Small Batch Series : 48 DDH Pilsner
text: Double dry hopped pilsner brewed with El Dorado, Amarillo, Simcoe and Mosaic hops.

name: Small Batch Series: 37 New Zealand Hazy Kveik Pilsner
text: Pilsner brewed with a Kveik yeast.

name: Small Batch Series: 74 New England Pale Pilsner
text: The latest edition of the Small Batch Series is a New England Pale Pilsner brewed with Mosaic, Citra, and Sabro hops.

name: East Coast German Pilsner
text: East Coast Pilsner, with the West Coast twist!

name: Small Batch Series: 77 L.A. Mountain Pilsner
text: Low gravity Pilsner brewed with Sabro, HBC 630 and Citra hops.

name: Small Batch Series: 81 Amarillo Pilsner
text: Dry hopped Pilsner with Amarillo hops.

name: Englishman In York
text: In the distance, I see the City Walls,A ton of people moving on,Barker Tower is forming on the Ouse,I'm an Englishman in York.

name: Small Batch Series: 56 Citra Pilsner
text: Small Batch 56 is a Pilsner brewed with Citra hops.

name: Triple Hophead
text: They say jump and you say how high? Whit this one, the sky is the limit! Styrian trio of hops - Styrian Kolibri, Styrian Bobek, and Styrian Celeia will make you obey the rules, 'cause you'll just fly higher and higher!

name: Small Batch Series: 76 L.A. Juicy Pilsner
text: Low Gravity Pils brewed with Motueka and Riwaka hops.

name: HOPA
text: Just like the song says, this Hopa Pilsner is as easy-drinking as a Sunday morning. It's light-bodied and crisp with a refreshing 3.8% ABV, perfect for unwinding on a sunny day with a gentle breeze.

name: Kraljevsko Pilsner
text: Nefiltrirano, nepastetizirano pilsner pivo nastalo po pomno izbalansiranoj i dokazanoj craft recepturi. Jedinstveni okus svježine daje mu priroradna izvorska voda rijeke Krke koja se rađa na obroncima najviše hrvatske planine Dinare duboko u damatinskom zaleđu odakle je u 11. stoljeću vladao hrvatski kralj Dmitar Zvonimir u čiju čast ovo pivo i nosi naziv Kraljevsko. Rezervirano za kraljeve.

name: Goodara Navijačko - Pilsner
text: #hrvatska!

name: Zadranka
text: Pilsner beer with a refreshing balance and drinkability with subtle malt notes of white bread and crackers. Spalter and Hallertau Blanc hops provide a refreshing bitterness and an herbal and floral flavor and aroma that finishes crisp and clean. The perfect solution to your year round thirst!

name: Hoppy Morphosis
text: Given the opportunity, after the Czech This Out!¨collaboration, we decided to tweak the winning Markku Leminen's recipe from this year's SMASH Homebrew Competition. Just a little bit.To the fantastic base, we added the Czech modern hops in the phase of dry hopping - Saturn and Kazbek, which blended very nicely with the previously incorporated Saaz. It gives us a very nice addition of floral, spicy, and tropical flavors and aromas. So good. Mr. Kafka would be pleased.

name: Bošnjak Svijetli Lager
text: Pasteurized pale lager.

name: Mango Pilsner
text: Crisp and refreshing with a sweet Mango hit.

name: Gad
text: Gad je naš vrhunski uradak, crispy lager, vrhunsko lager pivo skuhano sa slovenskim hmeljem Styrian Golding daje mu punoću okusa. Gad je pivo zlatno-prozirne boje, jako pitko, na okus daje aromu ječmenog slada u kombinaciji sa blagom zahmeljenošću s Styrian hmeljem, jednom kad probate Gada više nikada nećete piti industrijska piva sumnjive kvalitete.

name: Pils
text: The secret of this wickedly drinkable pilsner beer is a perfect ratio of freshness and bitterness. Flowery hop aromas arise from noble hops and bready-rich malt aroma from local Slavonian malt.

name: Zlatni Medvjed
text: A pilsener with a golden-yellow colour, a refreshing taste and a pleasantly bitter aroma. We brew Zlatni medvjed (Golden bear) throughout the year. Golden Bear is the same style of beer with same ingredients as original beer Zlatni medvjed, only this one was made especially for UK market with English label.

name: Hajduk 1911
text: Official beer for the Croatian football club Hajduk Split

name: 5th Element LELA
text: A unique blend of two beer style Alea and lager beer gives the best of both style and makes it as easy as the element that is symbolized - WATER. Ale beer adds a mild hoppy / ester flavor which has only beer fermented at a higher temperature while lager beer gives the basic body and the freshness of the beer this unique blend.

name: Small Batch #9 Baltic Porter
text: Aromas of dark and dried fruit, caramel and chocolate truffles, with hints of licorice and porto wine. Sweet, with traditional hops and warm alcohol.

name: Piece of Cake
text: BraIlian Montecristo medium roast coffee as an initial aroma, followed right away by the complex marzipan, vanilla, cinnamon from the tonka beans. First taste again brings the coffee to the front, with a direct transition to dark chocolate flavour contributed by the cocoa nibs, however it's the tonka that justifies the name of our beer, making it a proper liquid cake. The clean lager character can be recognised in the finishing smoothness, and the aftertaste is again a lingering combination of rich coffee and tonka complexity.

name: Blackberry Baltic Porter #8
text: Roasty, dark, smooth and fruity with fresh blackberries

name: Majstorica Maruška
text: LIMITIRANO IZDANJE.Prva kolaboracija Maraske Zadar s Brlogom. Gusto, tamno, desertno pivo bogatog tijela s infuziranom višnjom maraskom proizašlom iz proizvodnje slavnog Maraschina. Pivo koje razvija kulturu suradnje na lokalnoj razini i spaja svjetove.Sastav: voda, ječmeni slad, hmelj, kvasac, višnja maraska.

name: Fantom Fehér Nyúl Baltic Porter
text: Čokoladno - karamelasti Fantom Baltic Porter skuhan je u suradnji s mađarskom craft pivovarom Fehér Nyúl Brewery & Taproom.

name: 8 Sons
text: 8 Sons is a collaboration between eight brothers, four Croatians and four Dutch, that have two things in common: an engineer father and a family craft brewery. Moersluetel Craft Brewery brews big, bold and flavourful beers and Medvedgrad Brewery is specialized for tasty lagers. A big and bold Baltic Porter is the result of this unique collaboration, a strong and complex dark lager with coffee and dark chocolate flavors. Let's surf forever on waves of delicious beers!

name: 5th Element BART
text: Ovo pivo simbolizira element ZEMLJA. Spravljeno je u stilu Baltic porter koji karakteriziraju intenzivni sladni okusi s naglašenom notom prženih sladova te povećani sadržaj alkohola. Zbog korištenja 7 vrsta specijalnog slada savršeno prezentira element ZEMLJE koja simbolizira slad.

name: Tomislav
text: Tomislav's black royal beer - the first and best-selling special beer in Croatia.Dates from 1925, when it was first produced in honor of the thousandth anniversary of the coronation of King Tomislav.Tomislav is the right choice for true connoisseurs of specialty beers that enjoy special flavors.It differs from other black beer market as the only products of toasted malt, which gives it a distinctive caramel flavor.

name: Flat White Coffee Porter
text: Cold-brew iced-coffee porter: rich, smooth and creamy with notes of roasted almond and dark chocolate

name: Porter
text: Angeluš - Porter je tamno ale pivo intenzivnih aroma kave, čokolade, vanilije i bobičastog voća.

name: Tàmān Támān
text: Svilenkasto suhovoćni direkt te tamno čokoladni aperkat s blagim kavenim krošeom u baršunastom taman tamnom biskvitnem tijelu...

name: Baltic Porter
text: A silky and robust baltic porter reminiscent of raisin, burnt caramel, roasted coffee and molasses.  Very malty and somewhat sweet, it finishes with a dry and balanced bitter taste. The aroma is molasses and malt. Like a moderately hopped bock, with chocolate and coffee notes. This brew is bottom fermented and well rounded, with its potency hidden in its easy-drinking quality.  Rummy, raisin and liquorice notes similar to an old ale reside in the profile. The character also has hints of chocolate and coffee, and at times, a roasted background.

name: The Whole Cake
text: After a few repetitions od the crowds favorite Piece of Cake, we decided it's enough slicing,  so here's the whole cake: more alcohol, more Tonka, cocoa and coffee, more pleasure!

name: Vanilla & Chocolate Porter
text: A vanilla and chocolate porter aged on French oak and rested on organic cocoa nibs and Madagascar vanilla pods.Like velvet on the tongue - chocolate, coffee and dark caramel - it pours heavy with a very thick, dominating head. The aroma is strong dark chocolate with subtle notes of coffee and vanilla. The lactose and vanillin (from the oak) beautifully round the flavours together. A little thin and bitter, like a porter should be, this leaves a slightly roasted coffee bean sensation. After swallowing this soft bitterness gives way to a long lasting vanilla coating on the palate.

name: Hazel Cake Porter
text: Porter brewed with Cocoa nibs, hazelnut and lactose. Special birthday edition

name: Smoked Slavonian Plum Porter
text: Heaps of juicy, ripe Croatian plums, from our nearby region of Slavonia, combine with specialty smoked malts to create a rich, complex, and robust Porter. This is a brew of profound depth, where sweet fruit meets a lingering, smoky complexity to make the perfect autumn evening accompaniment.

name: The Blueberry Side
text: A fruit beer based on The Dark Side porter - porter with the addition of blueberries. 150g of fresh eko Lisjak blueberrys per 1 liter of the beer. Slightly bitter, lots of coffee and sourness of blueberries from EKO LISJAK farm!

name: GRIF Vanilla Bourbon Oak Porter
text: Porter, spravljen od čak 6 vrsta slada među kojima su dva tamna, pržena slada koji se ističu svojim aromama pržene kave i tamne čokolade. Dodatak zobenih pahuljica daje mu bogato, jako tijelo s čvrstom pjenom, a mahune vanilije odležane u najkvalitetnijem Bourbon whiskyu zajedno s hrastovim čipsom našem Porteru daju specifičnu aromu u kojoj prevladava kombinacija prženog slada sa suptilnim okusima i mirisima vanilije, Bourbon whiskya te hrastovine.

name: Bumbarska Tamna
text: Nefiltrirano, nepasterizirano domaće ale pivo bez konzervansa, umjetnih bojila i bilo kakvih drugih dodataka, s prirodnim jestivim talogom kvasca, refermentirano u boci. Ovo tamno pivo napravljeno je od 2 vrste specifičnih hmeljeva i kombinacije 5 vrsta najboljih europskih sladova koje PORTER i zaslužuje! Poželjno čuvati na hladnom i tamnom mjestu u uspravnom položaju.

name: The Dark Side
text: From the dark side of the moon comes #lepidecki's first porter, The Dark Side, a 5.5 ABV, less bitter, the darkest beer they ever made.An obvious reference two of our biggest inspiration, a sci-fi story and a hell of a music album, the dark side will be hitting shops soon!

name: Porter
text: Dark Chocolate, coffee, dried fruit and caramel. No, you're not reading a recipe for your favourite cake. These are the flavours and aromas blended in harmony within this classic British style ale. Combining variety of six malts and one hop resulted in this pleasantly bitter beer.It's as robust as it gets!

name: Bob Barley
text: Enter a jungle of roasted malts, blowing coffee and chocolate flavours through the air. Light up the darkness and you’ll fly on a cloud of good vibrations…Love the beer you drink, drink the beer you love. –Bob Barley

name: Oak Aged Vanilla & Chocolate Porter
text: Luxurious Chocolate Porter rested on Vanilla and Oak.The Garden Brewery asked 16 of its favourite global breweries to work with us to create exclusive collab beers for Restore Our Earth, a charity project we initiated with Beer52, the world’s biggest beer club. In the Summer of 2022 1.5 millions cans will be distributed globally.The Garden Brewery and Beer52 have committed to donate at least €30,000 to charities with proven high impact deliverables in Marine Conservation, Forest Conservation, Reimagining Carbon, Education & Behavior, Food & Agriculture and building Climate Resistant Communities.

name: Fantom 38
text: Fantom 38 pripada tradicionalnom njemačkom pivskom stilu Rauchbier Märzen. Dimljeno pivo, srednje jako, ugodnog balansa gorčine i sladnosti.

name: Zornjak
text: HÖPPY AMBER

name: Neposlušna
text: Neposlušna je red ale buntovnica bez filtera. Arome hmelja i toplinu karamele spaja u slobodnom duhu zadrugarstva

name: Devetka Red Ale
text: Ovaj stil kuhanja još uvijek nema visoko mjesto na craft listi cijenjenih piva. Uzmite pržene i blage slatke karamelne note pažljivo probranih sladova. Uravnotežite ih aromama biljnog i itrusnog hmelja. Što ćete dobiti? Hoppy Red Ale! Pivo predivne rubin boje. Iako se odlikuje svom puninom gorčine, nevjerojatno dobro pristaje svakoj hrani. No ni sam po sebi nikoga neće ostaviti ravnodušnim.

name: Red Rye
text: The base of an American Red. The malt bill of a rye. Dry hopped like a west coast IPA! Our take on a few classics.  On the nose you get a very strong rye aroma balanced with hints of pine and subtle earthy and floral notes. The flavour is an upfront spicy bitterness from the rye followed by a toffee-like sweetness giving way to a mouth filling bitterness that lingers long after the first sip. Full bodied with medium carbonation.

name: Grof
text: Kao što su negdašnji vladari i vlastelini čvrstom rukom djelovali na puk, tako se i ovaj Amber Ale ističe svojom umjerenom jačinom i konzervativnom notom. Blagom gorčinom i punim okusom te zagasitom crvenkastom, jantarnom bojom, iako nenametljivo, ono ipak plijeni pažnju i nudi više nego ste očekivali, oslikavajući karakter grofa Julija Jankovića (1820. - 1904.), istaknutog političara, velikog župana Požeške županije, umjerenog konzervativca koji je unutar tadašnje vrlo složene političke situacije u Hrvatskom saboru zagovarao hrvatske interese i ravnopravnost naroda.Julije Janković rođen u Pakracu od majke grofice Eleonore Pejačević - Virovitičke i oca Izidora pl. Jankovića, posljednji je grof iz obitelji Janković koja je više od stoljeća, počevši od 1760. godine, u posjedu imala vlastelinstva Pakrac, Daruvar, Sirač i Stražeman. Velik dio svog bogatstva Julije je podijelio u dobrotvorne svrhe, a posebno se isticao u osnivanju i darivanju kulturnih i prosvjetnih ustanova.

name: Flamingo
text: Pivo izrazito jarke crvene boje, gdje bi gorčina stršala kao Flamingo usred jezera, ali mi smo se pobrinuli za fini balans sa hrvatskim sladom. Time ovo pivo sjeda kao Flamingo u zen pozi, balansiran, složen i vrlo pitak.Pivo ima pojačanu hmeljnu gorčinu ali radi tehnologije proizvodnje i veću sladnu slatkoću, pa se te dvije stvari izbalansiraju i gorčina toliko ne dolazi do izražaja.

name: Swing
text: Avantura boje i okusa u čaši. Skladna kombinacija blago karamelastog tijela sljubljenog sa citrusnim i tropskim voćnim notama dobivenim korištenjem probranih vrsta hmelja.

name: Malduk
text: Traditional style Irish Red Ale (Leann dearg) with flavours reminiscent of nature and takes you back to the turbulent ages of pirates of Omis. The balanced blend of 4 different strains of top quality barley and 2 different types of the finest hops, reminds your palette of the refreshing homely taste of caramel, with a grassy-floral characters.

name: Redsand Amber Ale
text: Top-fermented Amber Ale. Unpasteurized, unfiltered, bottle-fermented (bottle conditioned), no additives or preservatives. Brewed with passion and expertise by our Brewmaster.Top-fermented amber ale in Irish Red Ale style. Intriguing amber ale brewed with 4 types of barley malt, a small amount of wheat malt, a mix of Slovenian and American hops and yeast. Drinkable but with a substantial body, slightly bitter at first followed by a sweet aftertaste. The malty taste dominates along with exotic fruit and eventually mild and pleasant liquorice flavours. Medium carbonation with a smooth and creamy mouthfeel. The amber red colour reflects the typical Istrian red soil and for this is called REDSAND Amber ale. Unfiltered and bottle-conditioned it comes with a natural yeast sediment.

name: Šank?!
text: This quaffable Irish red ale was conceived in collaboration with the guys from the famous punk rock band from Zagreb – Šank?! Its malty body with a hint of caramel sweetness is backed by low 4.5% of alcohol and 26 IBUs. Drinking this Irish classic pairs well with hard street rock chords.

name: Drma
text: Drma has a rich malty aroma which is well balanced with European noble hops.It is produced in Croatia by Lokalna Craft Pivovara (Local Craft Brewery) exclusively for the city of Zagreb, hence the name Lokalna (Local).

name: Kosjenka
text: Rye Red Ale - Kosjenka is a light autumn beer of distinctive red colour. A match to her stronger giant brother Regoč, Kosjenka is a small, witty and adventurous fairy from a Croatian folk's tale.

name: Ferata
text: Although it exudes with strength and character, the flavor of this beer are gentle and moderate.

name: Kameleon
text: Non-classic light red ale. Designed as an entry ticket into the ale-world, as light as it gets while offering all the bits and bobs of a proper craft beer.Easy on the nose and the palate, a sweet body and a very balanced hoppy aroma. Bitterness carefully dosed, but can be improved upon by mixing a full pint with a serving 0.03 of Cynar, Amaro Isolabella and Pelinkovac - bitter spirits that give the beer a whole new characted - albeit still keeping it strictly beer-ish - hence the name - Kameleon.Bottoms up!

name: Mangulica
text: A classic approach to malty, balanced german black beer. Mangulica is black pig from Slavonija, Croatia.

name: Babau
text: Dark lager

name: Crna Kraljica
text: A dark lager with additional hops and a characteristic taste and aroma from dark, roasted malt grains. Crna kraljica (Black queen) is available throughout the year.

name: Spirit
text: Tamno pivo punog kompleksnog tijela koji odmah nakon laganih okusa prženog i karamelnog slada otkriva salvu voćnih okusa koje smo postigli induciranjem suhih šljiva, marelica, grožđica, cimetom i provoklasnom vanilijom s Madagaskara. preporučamo serviranje na 15C, kako bi sve arome došle do izražaja.

name: Imperial Radler
text: Zesty and super refreshing. Blended with homemade Croatian lemonade.

name: Osječko Radler Crni
text: Black beer with Lemon juice

name: Ožujsko Grejp
text: Beer lovers with a taste pleasantly surprised to be on the shelves saw a new trump card for refreshments with which the Zagreb Brewery confirm their status acquired fighter thirst no. 1 in 2012th year.It is Ožusko Grejp (grapefruit), new hope that will all beer lovers to taste, and those who are on their way to becoming, to give additional reason to enjoy the refreshing, especially in the coming spring and summer.

name: Ožujsko Limun
text: The original Croation with lemon added.

name: Karlovacko Laganini
text: Radler with Lime, Myrtle and Coriander

name: Radler Ledero - Mandarina
text: Mjesavina svijetlog lager piva i osvjezavajuceg bezalkoholnog pica od vise vrsta vocnog soka, limun, mandarina i acerola.

name: Istarsko Muškat
text: Muscat flavoured

name: Imperial Florida Weisse Mango, Lime & Raspberry
text: Our very own globetrotter Mario put into motion another Mexican collab, this time with the boys from Fausto! A big and bold Florida Weisse with a ton of fruit in it for a super juicy punch.

name: Sour
text: A clean, refreshing sour ale hopped with Nelson Sauvin from New Zealand and Summer from Australia. Dry hopped during fermentation to make the most of our unique house yeast. Aroma is strong white grape with a background of ripe passion fruit and melon pulp. Flavour is unique and distinct; sour white grape. A very clean beer it has a dry finish with the medium-tart mouth puckering sourness.A Croatian first; this is perfect for summer drinking, cider-drinkers or people who just ‘don’t drink beer’.

name: Florida Weisse: Kiwi, Papaya & Lemon
text: Punchy & Juicy Sour with sweet tropical Papaya & Kiwi balanced with tart Lemons. Made with our Mexican friends Cervesa Morenos

name: Chef's Beer
text: This truly special beer is a hybrid between Old Ale and Flanders Brown. We further enriched the complex combination of malts by using maraština raisins and molasses in the brewing process. After primary fermentation with English yeast strains, the beer is transferred to barrique barrels in which it acquires a completely new dimension by secondary fermentation with wild yeasts and long aging.Chef's beer is the winner of a gold medal from the prestigious European Beer Challenge in London and was created as a collaboration between Barut Brewing and Blending, Zmajska pivovara, BIBICH WINE CROATIA and chef Mate Janković

name: Imperial Raspberry, Coffee & Cacao Sour
text: Budapest Beer Week Collab (Hungary) Collab: 7.5%Beer festivals have had it hard over the last 2 years so we wanted to say a BIG thanks to them all (and craft beer bars too) for bringing breweries and drinkers together. We made this with Tibor, Marton and Peter from BPBW who run an amazing festival and who supported us from the start. This is rich, intense, tart and luxuriant with a massive 270 grams of fresh raspberries in every single litre. Balanced complexity is added by resting on Cacao nibs and fresh roasted Coffee.

name: Small Batch Series: 21 Raspberry Sour
text: Tart and fruity, this Sour is filled with a thick mass of Raspberry juice

name: Imperial Apricot, Mandarin & Lemon Sour
text: Tart and fruity with a gentle saltiness. Conditioned on Orange and Lemon rind; and Green Cardamom pods

name: Triple Dragon Fruit, Pink Guava & Strawberry Sour
text: SIXTH BIRTHDAY COLLAB BREWEnormous Kettle Sour fruit bomb

name: Fruit Expo: Passion Fruit, Mango And Lime Sour
text: Zesty and refreshing kettle sour brewed with passion fruit, mango and lime.

name: Fruit Expo: Passion Fruit Sour Kveik
text: This isn't your regular fruited sour. Yes, passion fruit is overwhelming and intense, but it nicely complements the real star of this beer - Kveik yeast which adds a new dimension to this beer.

name: Imperial Cherry, Raspberry & Coffee Sour
text: A complex Sour beast made with our Manchester friends. Sweet Cherry and Raspberry balanced with rich Cacao and earthy cold-brew Coffee

name: Flat-Earthers Stop
text: Passionfruit infused sour

name: Very Berry Bunny
text: It's a leap of fruits! Taste and aroma dominated by raspberry with a hint of black currant in the background. Medium body, pleasant sweetness. No bitterness.

name: Pineapple Sour
text: Pouring a hazy yellow with dominant notes of fresh, juicy pineapple. Refreshing and tart with a lasting sourness. A real summertime champion.

name: SOUR Raspberry, Strawberry, Blueberry, Sweet Cherry
text: FRUITED SOUR 2Loaded with bunch of the best berries.RASPBERRY, STRAWBERRY, BLUEBERRY, SWEET CHERRY.

name: Find Muck
text: A collab beer with our dear friends from Sibeeria Brewery from Prague. Kettle sour with lemon, ginger and carrots. Every sip sends a refreshing buzz through your mind!- This beer has carrots in it!- Why is it purple? - Because it's black!Contains lactose!

name: Mango, Strawberry & Apricot Sour
text: Packed with fruit and balanced by a bright and zingy acidity

name: Fruit Expo: Apricot Sour
text: A perfect summer experience - sour with a pronounced fruity aroma, but the low body, and juicy flavor.

name: Trip To the Sour Side
text: GUAVA, MANGO, PASSION FRUITFirst Sour beer from the series "Trip To The Sour Side"Full body fruited Sour 15%

name: Fruit Expo: Raspberry Sour
text: Another brewski from the Fruit Expo series. This Kettle Sour is upgraded with large quantities of raspberry

name: Fruit Expo: Strawberry & White Guava Sour
text: Perfectly balanced Sour tnx to the mix of Strawberry and Guava. Medium body, subtle sourness, and a long fruity finish with a high probability you'll order another one!

name: Mango, Peach, Coconut, Lychee-Lemon SOUR 1
text: 2025 SOUR 1MANGO, PEACH, COCONUT, LYCHEE - LEMON

name: Fruit Expo: Passion Fruit Sour
text: Latest beer in our fruit expo series is a smooth, and fruity sour brewed with a lot of Passion fruit.

name: Fruit Expo: Pineapple Sour
text: Fruity and very drinkable Sour, but don't get surprised when those pineapple notes hit you, because this Sour is packed with pineapple, and those notes are just getting stronger with every sip!

name: Fruit Expo: Mango And Lime Sour
text: Fruity and pungent Sour with a full body and all-around Mango flavor accompanied by Lime.

name: Sourkić
text: Passion Fruit, Lime and a hint of Ginger

name: Imperial Strawberry, Apricot & Lemon Sour
text: Sumptuous triple-fruited kettle sour with zesty Italian lemons and background notes of Black Pepper

name: Imperial Blueberry, Orange Peel & Cacao Sour
text: Fruity, earthy and complex. With copious amounts of sweet-tart Blueberries, rich Cacao Nibs and tangy Orange peel

name: Small Batch Series: 54 Hoppy Lemonade
text: Hoppy and fruity Sour Ale brewed with lime.

name: Blackcurrant & Peach Sour
text: Biting Blackcurrant acidity softened by sweet and juicy white Peaches. Rounded  off with toasty hazelnuts, this Peach cobbler in a can was made with our good mates from Montpellier.

name: Fruit Expo: 3 Berries Sour
text: If you're looking for a complex, thick and fruity sour, you've found it. Blueberry, Cranberry, and Black Currant are forming this mighty Berry Bomb!

name: Passion Fruit, Peach & Pineapple Sour
text: Fresh, juicy, tropical, tart and sessionable

name: Melagrano Sour NOEL
text: A refreshing and fruity sour made with lemon, pomegranate and cardamom. Made in collaboration with Zagreb's only Micheline star restaurant NOEL.

name: Fruit Expo: Blueberry Sour
text: Fruity and refreshing, sour and powerful. Fruit Expo number 3 brings all the goodness of blueberries.

name: Blueberry & Lavender Sour
text: Collab brew with Amundsen Brewery.Aromatic, tart and citrusy.A kettle sour fermented on Blueberries and conditioned on Lavender.

name: Fruit Expo: Mint & Lime Sour
text: Beat the heat with our latest Fruit Expo adventure: Lime & Mint! This refreshing summer brew is a delightful mix of zesty lime and cool mint, perfect for quenching your thirst on a scorching day.

name: Imperial Peach, Vanilla & Ginger Sour
text: Fruity and complex Kettle Sour with huge amounts of ripe peach, warming Ginger and mellow Vanilla

name: Apricot Sour
text: Sweet, robust, with a balanced tartness. Pouring a creamy orange, the addition of lactose provides the backbone for a smooth, easy drinking sour. Perfect for the burgeoning spring weather.

name: Fruit Expo: White Guava Sour
text: Have you ever experienced a full rush of white Guava? This hazy and white Guava beer is bursting with tropical aroma and is a go-to beer for every fruit-sour fan.

name: Peach Tea, Strawberry And Apricot Sour
text: Dry, delicate, piquant and thirst quenching. Made with Badin, our Norwegian Arctic friends.Hops Magnum Malts Extra Pale Ale, Wheat Malt, Flaked Oats Yeast AY4 Adjuncts Peach Tea, Strawberry, Apricot Alergens Gluten

name: Imperial Sour Lemon, Chinese Black Tea & Guizhou Peppercorn
Fruit Expo: Mango, Pineapple & Lime
text: Embark on a flavor rollercoaster with this Sour from the Fruit Expo series – the beer equivalent of a Hawaiian shirt at a formal party! Pineapple, mango, and lime all decided to join the party.

name: Cherry Sour
text: A kettle sour fermented on large amounts of Croatian Makarska cherries. Tart and complex, medium bodied and deep red in colour with intense cherry flavour.

name: Berry Bunny
text: Sour beer with raspberry and strawberry.

name: Beer Cocktail: Cosmopolitan
text: For our second Cocktail inspired Beer we've chosen the popular Cosmopolitan. A combination of Cranberry juice, Lime, and Orange aroma resulted in a very drinkable beer with subtle sour notes.

name: Rhubarb & Strawberry Sour
text: Double fruited sour ale with a big combination of rhubarb and strawberry.

name: Florida Weisse Mango, Rhubarb & Lemon
text: Triple-fruited Sour. Tart Rhubarb meets sweet Mango, accented with piquant Lemons. Summer is calling...Malts - Extra Pale Ale Malt, Wheat Flakes, Oat FlakesHops - MagnumYeast - JuiceMachineAdjuncts - Mango, Rhubarb, Lemon

name: Imperial Florida Weisse #02 - Pink Guava, Strawberry & Lime
text: Amped up floridaweisse laden with juicy pink guava, strawberry and sweet milk sugar, balanced with piquant limes.

name: Imperial Florida Weisse #07 - Passion Fruit, Pineapple & Lime
text: Tropical, tart and tangy triple-fruited Kettle Sour with Brazilian Lime

name: Imperial Florida Weisse #03 - Raspberry, Coconut & Vanilla
text: Raspberry, Coconut & Vanilla Tart and juicy with a masses of raspberries, coconut flesh and vanilla pods.

name: Florida Weisse Passion Fruit, Pineapple & Mandarin
text: Triple-fruited Sour. Juicy, full-bodied & tangy

name: Imperial Florida Weisse #08 - Rhubarb, Mango & Vanilla
text: Tart & tropical Kettle Sour; with Vanilla Pods and a gentle Ginger warmth

name: Florida Weisse #03 - Pineapple, Mango & Coconut
text: Super-fruited florida weisse in a pinacolada style! Masses of pineapple and mango on a lactose sour base.  Strong aroma of sweet coconut.

name: Imperial Florida Weisse #01 - Passion Fruit, Mango & Mandarin
text: Our Florida Weisse doubled up and overlain with as much passionfruit, mango and mandarin as it can carry.

name: Imperial Florida Weisse #09 - Strawberry, Mango & Lime
text: A fruity sour explosion, packed with ripe Strawberries, Mangos and zesty Lime

name: Beer Cocktail: Mojito Berliner
text: Your place under the sun can't be complete without this brewski. Easy going and low bodied Berliner accompanied by mint and lime. Slightly sour and refreshing.

name: Florida Weisse 2
text: Pink guava - lychee - lime

name: Imperial Florida Weisse #04 - Papaya, Strawberry & Lemon
text: Smooth and tropical with vanilla pods.

name: Fruit Expo: Beetroot And Lime Berliner Weisse
text: Easy-going Berliner but with more complexity achieved by Beetroot juice and Lime.

name: Imperial Florida Weisse #10 - Lychee, Mandarin & Lime
text: Sweet fruits meet sour beer. Ripe Mandarin flesh, Lychees and zingy Lime zest balanced with softening vanilla pods

name: Fruit Expo: Berliner Weisse With Lime
text: Classic Berliner Weisse upgraded with lime. The aroma is fruity and citrusy, and the lime gives that refreshing note responsible for the smooth ride.

name: Valovi - Florida Weisse Pink Guava, Strawberry & Lime
text: Tropical & juicy sour beer...Malts - Lager, Oat Malt, Wheat MaltHops - ColumbusYeast - SandersAdjuncts - Pink Guava, Strawberry, Lime

name: Florida Weisse Prickly Pear, Strawberry & Coconut
text: Fruit-packed summer sour. Ripe, bright and aromatic.

name: Florida Weisse #07 - Raspberry, Lemon & Vanilla
text: Sessionable and zingy Kettle Sour with heaps of Croatian Raspberries and Italian Lemon Zest; balanced by Madagascan Vanilla

name: Imperial Florida Weisse #05 - Watermelon, Cucumber & Strawberry
text: Tart and juicy triple-fruited poolside beer with zingy lime zest and fresh mint

name: Florida Weisse #04 - Peach, Apricot, Papaya
text: Our Florida Weisse base loaded with tropical papaya and layered with sweet apricot peach and vanilla.

name: Cherry & Plum Sour
text: Berliner-Weisse style sour conditioned on Sour Cherry & Plums. Tart and refreshing.

name: Imperial Florida Weisse: Pineapple, Coconut & Vanilla
text: Juicy & Tropical Pineapple Punch. A Big, Tart & Sour beer, balanced with gentle notes of Coconut & Vanilla. Made with our Portuguese friends

name: Florida Weisse #06 - Pineapple, Pink Grapefruit & Vanilla
text: Sweet and zesty with gentle vanilla notes

name: 3 REKETYE SOUR
text: Kettle sour made with huge ammounts of sour cherry. Perfect for summer ;)

name: 5th Element Weissberry
text: For a good and fulfilling life is always in need of harmony.Working WEISSBERRY her we love connect yeast and lactic acid bacteria to the harmony of alcohol and acids balancing this sour beer style Berliner Weisse. Additionally we noted peculiarity of this style by upgrading basic beer concentrated juice of raspberries that it turns into the ultimate refreshing beer cocktail worthy of our 5thELEMENT lines.

name: Florida Weisse #05 - Mango, Strawberry, Peach
text: Florida Weisse with a soft fruit cocktail of mango, strawberry, and peaches.

name: Florida Weisse: Watermelon, Lime & Mint
text: Refreshing and tart with cool mint. Beautiful thirst quencher made with our friends from the French Alps, Outer Range

name: Florida Weisse: Strawberry & Lychee
text: Double fruited Sour with sweet, juicy Strawberries and soft Lychees. Made with our Swiss friends, Hoppy People

name: Gooseberry & Elderflower Sour
text: A fruity, tart and clean beer with a distinct aroma and fresh sour finish.Available in 2.8% and 3.3% versions.

name: Buckthorn Sour
text: A Gose-style kettle sour with Buckthorn Berries and sea salt from Pag Island.

name: Sourise
text: The English traditionally dry hop their beersThe Germans traditionally kettle sour beersThe Belgian traditionally add fruit to their beersSalt traditionally is added to a gose.We put all these traditions in one and made you this traditional salty, fruity, double-dry-hopped kettle sour! Exactly the beer everyone needs on a hot summer day! Cheers!

name: Imperial Mandarin & Lemon Gose
text: A St Clements Gose with aromatic citrus fruit and peel. Balanced with Himalyan salt

name: Passion Sour
text: Gose made with passion fruit, made for Zagreb's only Michelin star restaurant NOEL

name: Spicy Sour: Cherry On Fire
text: This 4.4% ABV sour beer is a flavor explosion - imagine a classic American hard candy, tangy with a touch of heat, then picture it infused with juicy cherries, bright lime, and a warm cinnamon kick.

name: Small Batch Series: 32 Fruited Imperial Sour
text: A Winter Special brewed with Haskap berry.

name: Duality
text: We proudly present you our first beer we specifically brewed with the aim to sour and mature in wine barrels!Duality has a double nature, with grape juice being added to the wort from the early stages of fermentation, which was performed by a wine yeast strain.Cabernet Sauvignon must was added when the beer was transferred in the barrels that previously held red wine and we allowed the microflora present do some souring and maturing for 1 year before bottling this elixir.

name: Imperial Passion Fruit & Coffee Sour
text: Tart and complex with lightly roasted Columbian Coffee beans from our friends at Four Wheel Coffee Roastery.

name: Spicy Sour: Golden Blend
text: Our newest addition to the Spicy Sour series is a beer with a gentle 4.4% ABV, and it's Inspired by the aromatic Golden milk spice blend. We've crafted this beer using a medley of Curcuma, Ginger, Ceylon Cinnamon, Black Pepper, Nutmeg, and Lime.

name: Spicy Sour: East Twist
text: Introducing the Spicy Sour series, an innovation inspired by the vibrant flavors of Asian street food. The first beer from this series is crafted with a  blend of red pepper, zesty ginger, and refreshing lime. Get ready for an adventurous, zesty experience that pays homage to the culinary delights of Asian streets.

name: Spicy Sour: Ginger Uppercut
text: A refreshing 4.4% ABV keeps flavor session-friendly, while a gentle 8 IBU ensures the sourness takes center stage - just the raw, battle between fiery ginger and tangy lemon.

name: Beer Cocktail: Strawberry Mojito
text: With a crisp and clean beer base, the Strawberry Mojito is infused with the sweet and tangy flavors of ripe strawberries, zesty lime, and cooling mint. The result is a perfectly balanced drink that's both light and flavorful with a kick of 5.4% ABV to keep the party going.

name: Beer Cocktail: Raspberry Mojito
text: Raspberry Mojito is a refreshing and drinkable brew that you might even forget it has a 5,4% ABV. Pour it into a glass, take a sip, and you'll be greeted by a rush of sweet raspberry goodness, followed by a zesty kick of mint.

name: Bunny Sour
text: Sour beer with carrot.- carrot juice- lime puree- kettle sour

name: Istrian Malvazija White Wine Sour
text: Crafted from late-summer Malvazija grape must, our White Wine Sour is complex yet light, easy-drinking and mineral-rich. The Istrian Malvazija grape, indigenous to Croatia, combines with aromatic hops and a Kettle Sour base to create a crisp, zesty and mineral-rich profile with aromas of citrus, apple and stone fruit.Crafted from late-summer Malvazija grape must, our White Wine Sour is complex yet light, easy-drinking and mineral-rich. The Istrian Malvazija grape, indigenous to Croatia, combines with aromatic hops and a Kettle Sour base to create a crisp, zesty and mineral-rich profile with aromas of citrus, apple and stone fruit.Part of a set with the Imperial Slavonian Frankovka Red Wine Stout.

name: Sour Pale
text: A summer fresh, lightly soured peach pale ale. A sour base blended with our pale ale, along with the addition of peach, passiofruit and mango, creates a light, hoppy, fruity, easy drinking pale for those long summer nights.

name: Yuzu & Coffee Sour
text: Vibrant Yuzu gives aroma, tartness and refreshing citrus flavours. Roasted Coffee provides an earthy depth. Made with our friends from New York, KCBC

name: Rosehip & Wild Sorrel Sour
text: Tart and floral with spicy almost lemongrass notes. With locally foraged Croatian herbs and plants.

name: Uvala - House Sour
text: Crisp, refreshing and distinct. Tart, mineral and dry with notes of Pineapple & Citrus

name: Gin & Tonic Sour Beer
text: An ode to the timeless G&T, this Kettle Sour is bright, tart and incredibly crisp. Infused with local Croatian Juniper berries and fresh lemons, it delivers a zesty, botanical punch that lingers long after the first sip.

name: Not A Bunny
text: First gose by Zmajska! Sour beer with a note of salt and coriander, complemented with zest of different citrus fruits.

name: Handy Candy: Pineapple
text: Oh yeaaah!A new fruited pastry sour series!It's still a huuuge fruited smoothie sour, but in this series, we're going to put more emphasis on sweetness and the feeling of chewing candy. Sweeeeet-sour combo!Pineapple and mystic candy dosage for a crazy experience!This is why we brew!Contains unfermented fruit. Drink fresh. Don't age.Gently rotate a can few times before you open it for best experience.

name: Handy Candy: Peach & Apricot
text: Oh yeaaah!A new fruited pastry sour series!It's still a huuuge fruited smoothie sour, but in this series, we're going to put more emphasis on sweetness and the feeling of chewing candy. Sweeeeet-sour combo!Peach, apricots and mystic candy dosage for a crazy experience!This is why we brew!Contains unfermented fruit. Drink fresh. Don't age.Gently rotate a can few times before you open it for best experience

name: Beer Cake: Blueberry Pancake
text: Pastry sour brewed with lactose, vanilla, and large quantities of blueberries.

name: Beer Cake: Apricot Biscuit
text: Beer Cake series has only one goal - to experiment with different ingredients which power up basic beer ingredients. Apricot biscuit is a beer brewed with vanilla, lactose, and a lot of apricots!

name: Beer Cake: Blueberry And Ginger Lemon Pie
text: Welcome back to our Beer Cake series!  This pastry sour ale captures the essence of fresh lemon pie with blueberries, ginger, and vanilla. It's a 5% ABV balanced dessert experience.

name: Sour Cake
text: Yes, a sour beer can be a winter beer indeed! Just make sure it's a pastry sour, which we most certainly did.In order to do so, this beer has lactose, plenty of cocoa nibs, some Tonka beans and loads of sour cherries.A proper Christmas sour cake for sure!

name: Smoothiesh: ...Get Hammered!
text: Mr.Pimp the Doplphin asked a question: "What do sharks do for fun?"And the answer brings hammer shark: "Get Hammered!"Another dad's joke with smoothiesh sour labels - #This is why we brew!Ultra mega loaded with raspberries and blueberries give this smoothie sour very sexy purple color! We added biskvit and cinnamon to twist this sour to pastry side what gave aroma of real cake! Very thick with crazy strong foam, taste like sweet cake with berries and cinnamon. Yammy!Did you catch all the tattoos on hammer shark?Contains real unfermented fruit. Drink fresh. Don't age. Store in refrigerator.Gently rotate can few times before you open it for full experince.

name: Samphire Sour
text: A softly salty & citric 4.4% soft, sessionable sour. The soreness is tart and soft but well balanced by the salt component and a mild sweetness from the dark crystal. A healthy addition of lemondrop hops from Germany gives a non offensive, harmonious bitter element to the beer finishing & rounding off with a subtle citrus and earthy bite from the sumac.

name: Bira Od Pira
text: Wheat spellt beer non filtred

name: Pietro & Pietro Truffler
text: Beer with black truffle flavour.

name: San Servolo Gold Truffler
text: Gold Truffler pivo je jako pivo Bujske pivovare sa naglašenom notom i okusom tartufa napravljeno u suradnji sa tvrtkom Natura tartufi, jednim od najvećih distributera tartufa u Hrvatskoj. Cilj ovog piva je spojiti globalni pivarski craft pokret sa lokalnom istarskom gastro scenom.

name: Cannabeer
text: Greenish beer which contains extract from the flower of industrial hemp, a natural green color from chlorophyll and CBD.

name: 5th Element Green Power (Cannabeer)
text: By complementing its line of special beers, with excitement we present a completely new beer and the first such kind on the Croatian market - a beer with the extract of the flower of industrial hemp.The beer of traditional Czech recipe gives the specific flavor of cannabis, and the attractive greenish color, imitating the plant's own color, reminds of all the power of green nature as well as on the hollow itself. One of the strongest plants in nature so gets its current version!Aroma: Light, airy, refreshing with a pleasant lime aroma.Appearance: Dark greenish color with persistent white foam.Taste: A mild herbal, citrus-like flavor that resembles a lime.Redness: Light, slightly carbonated, refreshing.Pairing with food: All types of meat and sauces, all kinds of deserts, hard cheeses.

name: New World Stout
text: A classic Irish beer style enhanced by aromatic American hops. Its aromas of coffee, along with aromas reminiscent of chocolate were created by a combination of six different malts. Blended with them, and taking the beer to a new level, are aromas of pine and citrus fruits brought on Amarillo and Simcoe hops.

name: Coffee & Hazelnut Stout
text: Smooth and roasty with fresh Coffee and toasted Hazelnuts.The Garden Brewery asked 16 of its favourite global breweries to work with us to create exclusive collab beers for Restore Our Earth, a charity project we initiated with Beer52, the world’s biggest beer club. In the Summer of 2022 1.5 millions cans will be distributed globally.The Garden Brewery and Beer52 have committed to donate at least €30,000 to charities with proven high impact deliverables in Marine Conservation, Forest Conservation, Reimagining Carbon, Education & Behavior, Food & Agriculture and building Climate Resistant Communities.

name: Lively Neon
text: Lively Neon napravljen je u kombinaciji našeg Oatmeal stouta i cold brew kave Brazil Monetecristo sa Daterra farme. Klasične arome stouta pojačane su zavodljivim aromama kave i tako čine savršen spoj u čaši koji će pasati uz svaki doručak!

name: Kišna Nedjelja
text: Nakon Punk Rock Lagera Hladno pivo i naveliko hvaljene IPA-e Konobar, Pivovara Medvedgrad je u suradnji s gajničkim punkerima pripremila Punk Rock Stout Kišna nedjelja, što je ujedno i ime novog singla Hladnog piva s nadolazećeg albuma karijere.Kišna nedjelja je tamno pivo naglašenih čokoladnih i karamelnih nota s umjerenih 5,3 % alkohola, blage gorčine (31 IBU)i punog, kremastog tijela. Za one koji žele znati više, reći ćemo da je ovaj stout nalik onima u njihovoj domovini Engleskoj, a korišteni su hmeljevi karakteristični za ovaj stil -Aurora, Savinjski Golding, EastKent Golding.

name: Small Batch Series: 25 Export Stout
text: Number 25 of #SmallBatchSeries is kinda special. It's our first Stout beer, and it's Export Stout. Dry fruits, chocolate, coffee, this one has all.

name: 5th Element Voodoo
text: Beer black as the subsoil, which give their flavor barley rich in tannins French oak.It is characterized by an intense aroma of coffee and dark chocolate that after drinking complement the bitterness of the hops aroma of chicory, molasses and pleasant astringency of tannins.

name: 5th Element Stout 4.2.
text: The complexity of the beer fully reflects the passion that is the basis of the 5th Element line. In the title STOUT 4.2 (For Two) hides the call to share the beer with loved ones. Therefore, we invite you to share our passion with a loved one because this beer is stored that connects real beer lovers.

name: BA Prototype 2024: Imperial Stout Infused With Tobago Estate Cocoa Nibs
text: A Prototype Imperial Stout crafted with award-winning cocoa nibs from Tobago Cocoa Estate - Organic Cocoa Farm. This collaboration marries Croatian brewing with Tobago’s finest cocoa, honored at the 2023 International Chocolate Awards

name: Croatian Imperial Stout
text: This complex 10% Imperial Stout brings two Dalmatian delicacies, Figs and Carob, to the forefront. Exceptionally smooth and rich, it’s built on roasted malts that yield layers of dark chocolate, bold espresso and molasses.A balanced, full-bodied winter warmer.Hops: Magnum Malts: Extra Pale Malt, Munich Malt, Chocolate Malt, Caramunich, Carafa Special 3, Flaked Oats Yeast: AY4 Adjuncts: Lactose, Fig, Carob Alergens: Gluten, Lactose, Fig, Carob

name: Imperial Blueberry & Vanilla Stout
text: Luxurious dessert stout with Madagascan Vanilla, Cacao Nibs and heaps of sweet Blueberries

name: Double Imperial Chocolate & Vanilla Stout
text: Rich, smooth and ridiculously chocolatey. Rested on Madagascan Vanilla

name: Imperial Mexican Stout
text: Dark chocolate, organic cinnamon and smoky chipotle in a complex dessert stout

name: Portal
text: We aged this imperial stout in Ruby and Tawny Port barrels for 12 months. Fortified wine character is quite evident in the final product with the balance of the base beer itself being slightly more on the sweet side, but not cloying.Contains lactose

name: Imperial Walnut And Maple Syrup Stout
text: Rich, roasty, nutty and complex with notes of chocolate, coffee & dark fruits. Noticeable alcohol warmth with a sweet caramel finish

name: Imperial Stout
text: It's creamy, rich with flavors and aromas: coffee, dark chocolate, roastiness, bit of licorice in the background, as well as dark caramel and molasses.What more could you ask to hide the alcohol of an imperial stout?Enjoy!

name: Nostra
text: An old school imperial stout with a creamy, but not cloying mouthfeel. A balance between sweetness and roasty bitterness giving it a proper dark chocolate taste. Very light vanilla notes from some bourbon barrel oak chips

name: Imperial Slavonian Frankovka Red Wine Stout
text: Frankovka grape must from the late Summer wine harvest blends with a rich Stout base to create a deep and complex beer with roasted notes of Chocolate, Coffee and driwd fruits.

name: Imperial Tonka Bean, Hazelnut & Orange Stout
text: Rich, deep & velvety, with notes of Roasted Hazelnuts, Dark Chocolate, warm spices and Orange zest. Made with our Ukrainian friends at Didko.

name: Imperial Vanilla, Orange & Cardamom Panna Cotta Stout
text: Creamy and luxuriant dessert Stout with Madagascan Vanilla Pods and Italian Citrus Peel

name: Cherry & Coconut Imperial Stout
text: Deep, rich and complex imperial stout with sweet coconut flesh and maraschino cherries.The Garden Brewery asked 16 of its favourite global breweries to work with us to create exclusive collab beers for Restore Our Earth, a charity project we initiated with Beer52, the world’s biggest beer club. In the Summer of 2022 1.5 millions cans will be distributed globally.The Garden Brewery and Beer52 have committed to donate at least €30,000 to charities with proven high impact deliverables in Marine Conservation, Forest Conservation, Reimagining Carbon, Education & Behavior, Food & Agriculture and building Climate Resistant Communities.

name: Imperial Chocolate, Banana & Coffee Stout
text: Luxurious, rich and intense with a freshly roasted Coffee aroma, Cacao Nibs and gentle notes of Banana

name: Imperial Coffee, Caramel And Vanilla Stout
Imperial Coffee & Coconut Stout
text: Freshly ground Coffee meets silky Coconut in this big sweet Pastry Stout

name: Imperial Chocolate, Carob & Blackberry Stout
text: On a recent stop to sunny Spain and the home of our friends La Pirata Brewing we decided to brew up another collab. Last time we went for a lighter beer, so this time we went full out with a big, big Imperial Stout with an interesting flavour twist - carob.

name: Double Imperial Pistachio Baklava Stout
text: Big, sweet, complex & luxurious. And just like Baklava; perfect for sharing and celebrations. Made with our Aussie mates at One Drop.Hops Magnum Malts Extra Pale Ale, Dextrin Malt, Carafa Special 3, Chocolate Malt, CaraAroma, Munich, Flaked Oats Yeast AY4 Adjuncts Pistachio, Biscuit Alergens Gluten, Lactose, Pistachio

name: BA Prototype 2024: Imperial Pastry Stout - Schwarzwald Essence
text: Time spent in carefully selected bourbon barrels has added complexity to this 12% ABV Imperial Stout, which draws inspiration from the classic Schwarzwald dessert. Its velvety chocolate richness is followed by the gentle sweetness of vanilla and a lingering cherry finish.

name: Imperial Chocolate & Strawberry Liqueur Stout
text: Fresh Strawberries give a tartness to balance the sweet pastry stout base; notes of Almond. Made with Nerdbrewing from Sweden

name: Imperial Black Forest Gateau Stout
text: Indulgent dessert stout inspired by the classic German cake. Conditioned on Organic Cacao Nibs and Sweet Cherries

name: Jaffa the Hutt
text: RESIST IT, NO JEDI CAN.Orange, roasted malt, vanilla, chocolate..

name: Imperial Banana Bread Stout
text: Thick, dark and dangerously drinkable, our Imperial Banana Bread Stout is brewed with real bananas and deep, dessert-like malts for a rich, comforting finish.

name: Imperial Peanut Butter Jelly & Smores Stout
text: Rich, indulgent and packed with Peanut Butter, toasted Marshmallows, Dark Chocolate, Biscuits and Raspberry & Strawberry Jelly

name: Imperial Speculoos Stout
text: A beer homage to the classic Northern European Biscuit made by two Southern European breweries, us and our Catalan friends. This sweet and complex pastry Stout features ginger, citrus & spices

name: Chupacabra
text: Chupacabra is a beautiful thick and oily imperial pastry stout whose base was resting on tonka beans and coconut.The main story is 140 kilograms of thick sour cherry puree, which we added during the fermentation phase. The idea was to get fine liqueur-like notes of cherry, together with some acid that would balance the sweetness of the base and adjuncts.It's complex, with prominent aroma and flavors of chocolate, vanilla, almond, coconut and cherry... It's a dark pitch beauty.

name: Nitro Noir Coffee
text: Irish dry stout with coffee!Winter edition.

name: Nitro Noir
text: Brewed for St. Patrick's Day 2023. Mild and pleasant bitternes with emphasized roasted notes, primarily coffee and chocolate with caramel in the background. Smooth and creamy.

name: Black Rose (Róisín Dubh)
text: Róisín Dubh is a taste of rebellion in a can – a nod to Ireland's rich history. Crafted with roasted barley, Black Rose boasts a dark, captivating hue, mirroring the song's brooding melody. Sláinte to a bold brew that's anything but a Whiskey in the Jar.

name: Irish Dry Stout
text: Tradicija i klasika nikad ne izlaze iz mode kad je u pitanju Irski stout. Od početka do kraja slijedili smo isključivo tradiciju i samo tri osnovna sastojka, jer ovaj stil ne ostavlja prostor za eksperimente - suhoća, blaga kiselost prženog ječma i meka pitkost su odlike koje ga opisuju.

name: Creme De La Moo: Chocolate Moouse
text: We are starting our new Creme De La Moo series with the Chocolate Moouse Milk Stout. A lot of cocoa nibs are paired with dark malts and creamy lactose body to achieve that Moo(sey) texture.

name: Creme De La Moo: Cookies And Cream
text: Everyone likes Oreo cookies, and this Stout has Oreo vibes all the way! With crushed so much those cookie crumbs and vanilla cream notes, that you will want to dip Oreos immediately into this Milk....er...Stout!

name: Chronotype With Cocoa Nibs
text: The second collab with Tobago Cocoa Estate resulted with a milk stout infused with award winning cocoa nibs from their organic cocoa farm. These cocoa nibs were honored at the 2025 International Chocolate Awards World Finals! Cocoa nibs roasted by Friis-Holm.

name: Sweet And Spoooky
text: Sweet and Spoooky is come back from Spoooky series of our Stouts. Contain lactose and Vanilla beans from Madacascar. No other pastry treatment in this beer.

name: Kumsko Vanilla Stout
text: Strong stout beer aged on original vanilla pods from Mauritius. Distinctive aromas of dark chocolate and delicate aromas of bourbon vanilla

name: Postman Series no1 - Coconut stout
text: The Postman Always Rings Twice.Milk Stout with Roasted Coconut  and added Golding hops for balance. Try it, wont regret it!

name: Bad Drummer
text: Raw cocoa with some medium roasted coffee in the aroma, accompanied by sweeter caramely notes. The taste follows the aroma with some dark chocolate, and roasted bread flavors, all sweetened by the addition of lactose which defines this milk stout.
