The lactose also contributes to a fuller mouthfeel and silky texture, and enhances the caramel maltiness in the finish. The aftertaste that follows is that of pleasant roasty bitterness.

name: Coconut & Tonka Bean Milk Stout
text: Complex dark malts, cacao, and vanilla intermingle with sweet coconut and spicy tonka in this vegan sundae stout

name: Milk Stout
text: A big beer in a little can. 7 types of the best malts and a lot of lactose make this a heavy hitter in a small package. Thick, heavy, sweet, and creamy stout packed with massive notes of coffee crema, chocolate, roast. Finished super silky smooth with each sip.

name: Chocolate and Pecan Milk Stout
text: Full bodied, strong and rich. Light coffee, tobacco and dried fruit on the nose. Sweet with a creamy mouthfeel, nutty pecan notes blend with rich dark chocolate from the organic Cacao Nibs.

name: Stout | Nero
text: Breakfast Stout - made with oats, lactose and an experimental hop from Slovenia.

name: Terra Magica
text: Top-fermented Stout with oat flakes and milk sugar. Unpasteurized, unfiltered, bottle-fermented (bottle conditioned).

name: Peanut Butter & Chocolate Cheesecake Stout
text: Rich and velvety dessert stout with a creamy peanut butter, cheesecake sweetness and a malted roasty depth.

name: HabaNeon Stout
text: Made with fresh Habanero peppers. Collaboration with volimljuto.com

name: Špurija
text: Najmlađa sestra iz linije ženskih buntovnica. Taj sanjarski pogled prema noćnom nebu nazvali smo po riječi špurijus, što je u žargonu predosjećaj. Top notes chocolate and coffee. Full body, malty caramel flavour that feels like liquid silk in the mouth.

name: The Might of Rome
text: The Might of Rome is the story of Narona, which was a Roman city in the area of today's village Vid in the Neretva Valley, where today is the Archaeological Museum of Narona, the first in situ museum in Croatia. The Might of Rome is an oatmeal stout, a medium-bodied and medium-bitter black beer with the addition of oats and aromas of coffee, chocolate and caramel.

name: Chimney
text: Kremasti okus i blagi miris pržene kave, uz voćne note i niski stupanj alkohola čine ovo pivo dobiveno iz tamnijih sladova i plemenitog hmelja ugodnim za piće u bilo koje doba dana.

name: Neon Stout
text: As a proud dark representative of Craft Brewery Varionica, Neon Stout beer will win you over with the exceptional fullness of flavor obtained by combining several special malts and cereals. You will not remain indifferent to the full taste accentuated by notes of black coffee and chocolate.

name: Nitro Stout
text: Our stoutOn Nitrogen

name: MRKA Chili Choco Stout
text: Chocolate stout with dried cayenne chili peppers,vanilla, nutmeg and cinnamon in taste. Winter delicacy.

name: Boranka
text: We dedicated our stout to noble campaign - Boranka (Paint it back). Every summer, wildfires destroy thousands of square kilometers of green forests, turning them into black, burned areas. Boranka is one of the largest volunteer projects with an aim to ‘paint’ those black, burned areas into new green forests.Scouts and other volunteers joined this campaign and helped! You can join too, become donator or volunteer! Also, drinking our stout you participate in our donation to Boranka!Cheers and let's plant those trees back!

name: Chocolate Stout- Cuban Edition
text: Second edition of our Chocolate Stout brewed using cocoa beans from Cuba. Five malt types enriched with flaked oats and coca beans gives full body with subtle cocoa flavor.

name: Simon's Motor Oil Stout
text: Thick, creamy, oily. This Stout has some Lactose to boost mouth feel, along with some roast, coffee and chocolate malt! This brew was a collab with Real Ale Craft Beer, celebrity beer reviewer Simon! :)

name: Agram Stout
text: A thick, creamy stout, with the irresistible taste of roasted malt, a rich aroma and a pleasant sweetness with a lightly bitter aftertaste. We brew Agram Stout towards the end of winter.

name: Croatian Oyster Stout
text: A unique, rich & complex stout that celebrates the treasures of the sea and land. Fresh Oysters from our friend’s Adriatic farm give a lovely, delicate mineral character and a subtle salt brine taste to beautifully complement the dark, roasty flavours of the speciality malts.

name: Bounty Stout
text: Bounty Stout ima nemalih 6,0% Abv, ugodnih 40 IBU-a, a dominantne arome kokosa, kakaa, tamne čokolade i tamne karamele svrstavaju ga u Pastry Stout tip piva, slojevit, bogat i pomalo dekadentan pivski stil zbog dodatka slastičarskih sastojaka.

name: Chocolate & Peanut Butter Stout
text: Dark, creamy & decadent with notes of peanut butter, caramel and chocolate.

name: Critters of the Dark
text: Brewer's concoction series, barrel aged imperial stout, cocoa, coffe and vanilla notes.... no need to call the critters patrol.

name: Dark Dozen
text: Drinks smooth, hits hard.

name: Gavran
text: Gavran je jako, gusto, crno pivo u čijem okusu dominiraju kava i crna čokolada.

name: Bearly Strong
text: Pivo je stila American Strong Ale koje smo skuhali s prijateljem Matijem iz estonske pivovare Lehe Pruulikoda uoči prošlogodišnjeg Zmajeva. To je bio samo početak jer ogroman dio posla učinile su bačve burbona u kojima je pivo odležalo osam mjeseci. Dobili smo moćno (9,99 % ABV), zaokruženo i aromatično pivo, s toplim mirisima karamele, burbona, vanilije i kokosa.

name: Summer Wheat Ale
text: A dry-hopped wheat beer blended with our house sour: dry and sessionable with soft notes of grapefruit and lychee and a subtle tartness.

name: Hoppy Wheat
text: This beer forgot its German roots on first miles over Atlantic and right after arrival it adopted the values of the new continent: the naturalness and exceptional ease. That is how this dry, light and naturally hazy beer with creamy texture, wheat body and soul of hops was born.Easy to drink but hard to forget!

name: 5th Element Whey Beer
text: Each bottle contains 5 - 7 g Whey protein (whey protein), comes as an unfiltered beer, which gives it an excellent source of natural vitamin B from brewer's yeast, with a lower alcohol content of 4.5% is ideal as a refreshment for all sport enthusiasts and athletes who like to enjoy in beer.

name: Barone
text: Barone je Dunkelweizen (tamno pšenično) pivo sa punim tijelom i blagom aromom. Sadrži 50 % pšenice i 5,35 % udio alkohola. Njegova tamna boja i punina okusa savršeno odgovaraju u ovim hladnim zimskim mjesecima.

name: Santa Klausovich
text: After Capo di Hefe, Don Banano and Bill O'Coffeen, Oyabun, here comes Santa Klausovich!A balkan styled, three stripes addidas outfit, Mr. Klausovich is real gangsta' from the street!Wheat beer brewed with bananas, and than conditioned on vanilla and cinnamon, this is a liquid dessert. Yummmmmmmy!This is why we brew!

name: Brundelweiss
text: Our version of weissbier! When you brew hefeweizen, do as the Germans do! Wheat and Pilsner malt, german hop Tettnanger. Our 2nd collaboration is named Brundelweiss, full of banana and clove aroma and flavor. Prost!

name: Scareweiss
text: A new modern version of traditional german weissbier or heferweizen is here!Traditional yeast and german hops are used and twisted with modern malts to create this beauty.You can taste banana-like aroma with clove-like flavor, with silky aftertaste and subtle bitterness.Very drinkable, silky with golden pale color, yummy!This is why we brew!

name: San Servolo Hefeweizen
text: Hefeweizen pivo – mutno nefiltrirano i nepasterizirano pšenično pivo dobiveno od pšeničnog slada. Sadrži visoki udjel kvasaca u sebi i zato je jako hranjivo, ali ujedno i osvježavajuće zbog veće reskosti i same aromatičnosti piva koju dobivamo specijalnim kvascima, a u prvom redu krase ga arome banane i klinčića.

name: Üger
text: Hopenweizen klasicni njemacki hefe dodatno zahmeljen magnum hmeljevima osvjezavace gorcine carboniziran iskljucivo kvascima bez dodavanja CO2 #prvohrvatskounisexpivo banana  za nju  gorcina za njega

name: Goodara Grill - Pšenično
text: Dobar osjećaj u tekućem obliku! Robna marka koja to nije ;) #Ribafish

name: Nikola Zrinski
text: Nikola Zrinski, named after Nikola Zrinski Čakovečki, was a Croatian and Hungarian military leader, statesman and poet. He was a member of the House of Zrinski (or Zrínyi), a Croatian-Hungarian noble family. The beer is weissbier / wheatbeer, our first attempt at it and we're proud of it!

name: Marmun
text: Osvježavajuće i pitko pivo punog tijela voćnih aroma, prevladava okus banane i klinćića.Majmun, jedan od zamjenika pilota Zeppelina, u biti lud lik jer skuplja pšenični slad u vožnji dok visi na hmeljnoj "lijani" sa Zeppelina. Iako je slomljen autopilot Zeppelina on ostavlja Zeppelin bez nadzora da bi u letu nakupio dovoljno pšenice za sljedeću turu piva, jednostavno ne može izdržati kada lete iznad pšeničnih polja. Za to vrijeme se svi skamene od straha jer nemaju nadzor nad Zeppelinom, dok njega to baš ne dira.

name: Dva Klasa
text: Dark clouded wheatbeer with a purple red colour and a specific scent and taste which comes from wheat malt. We brew Dva klasa (Two spikes) throughout the year.

name: Panonska Wheat
text: Wheat je pšenično pivo stabilne pjene i blago zamućene zlatne boje nježnog kremastog okusa uz dašak agruma.

name: Capo Di Hefe
text: Say hello to our little friend...This isn't ordinary wheat beer. This is imperial pastry hefeweizen. There aren't many beers like this in the world, but we brew it 'cause it was fun!Imagine hefeweizen brewed with banana, coconut and Madagascar vanilla. Weizen yeast already gave banana-like aroma and flavour but we wanted even more of that. So we put fair amount of bananas into fermentation to enchance those banana flavours. And then we conditioned it on  Madagascar vanilla pods and coconut which produced really amazing taste. Lots of wheat and oats and touch of lactose for creamy body and there you go - crazy wheat beer!Silky and smooth, it really feels like a beach cake punch.This is why we brew!Capisci?

name: Don Bonanno
text: Another Pastry Imperial Hefeweizen from 'La Famiglia' series!This time we played with tonka beans and cacao nibs, along with banana pure. You will find banana taste with chocolate and marzipanish aroma in every sip. Full and thick, sweetish, sounds like a real dessert.Every  Capo needs consigliere... An artwork for a fiesty capuchin monkey and 'mafia' theme was inspired by italian-american boss crime Joseph Bonanno, also known as Joe Bananas. This is why we brew!Capisci?

name: Oyabun
text: After Capo di Hefe, Don Banano and Bill O'Coffeen, here comes Oyabun, big boss of Yakuza, well knowed japanese mafia..With tradioninal japanese styled tattoos, this japanese macaque is a perfect match for a beerlabel.Wheat beer brewed with bananas, and than conditioned on vanilla and chocolate, this is a liquid dessert. And it's veeeerry drinkable for such flavourfull beer.This is why we brew!

name: Bill O'Coffen
text: f you have ever seen the movie 'Gangs of New York' then you definitely know who 'Bill The Butcher' is.Well, it was he who inspired our continuation of the gangster imperial pastry hefeweizen series aka 'La Famiglia'This time we added bananas, coffee beans, and biscuits to our base. We thanks our friends from craft coffee roaster and coffee shop Kavantura who roasted special brazilian coffee just for this occasion. We wanted more espresso and nutty flavors so they lightly roasted coffee beans and made us happy?The result is a very nicely balanced aroma of iced coffee and an interesting taste of tiramisu. Super rich and fun!Our design studio again nailed this gangster beer style label! Artwork!

name: John Lemon
text: Belgium-y taste with a heavy wheat prescence.

name: Wit
text: Refreshing, fragrant and highly drinkable beer. Brewed with raw wheat and barley malt, spiced with hops, bitter orange peel and coriander. Ultimate partner in a variety of Mediterranean dishes.

name: Nikola Zrinski / Miklos Zrinyi
text: A collaboration with Reketye Brewery, new take on Zrinski weizen is this beer.A warlord, grandfather of Nikola Zrinski, the hero of Sziget is a hero both in Croatia and Hungary.

name: John Lemon
text: Belgian Wheat Beer with a zest of Croatia."Imagine an eccentric wheat beer that wakes up your senses and takes you on a journey across a citrusy and floral universe, then leaves you with a bitter finish that refreshes like no other. A beer that takes you away and sets you free."-John LemonContains lemons and orange peels from the island of Vis,

name: Ljeto u Zagrebu / The Summer in Zagreb
text: Belgian wheat beer made ​​from barley and wheat malt and oats supplemented with bitter orange peel and coriander.

name: Witbier
text: Classic Belgian Witbier with a luscious wheat base and prominent notes of Coriander & Orange Peel. Made with our Canadian friends Malty National

name: Karlovačko Primavera
text: Svijetlo nefiltrirano psenicno lager pivo obogaceno mirisnim notama korijandera i psenicnog slada.

name: Brettcave 02: Elderflower
text: Sour Ale aged in Oak Barrel with Elderflower

name: Duality 08: Pear
text: The Duality series continues in 2023! Mixed fermentation, wine barrel aged in Croatian oak barrels is the standard.This one had pears from the extra juicy sort Santa Maria added.

name: Blend My Day
text: A blend of many different beers, all sours of course, and all went through the oak barrels. This beer took some longer ageing but reached a lovely profile very much reminding of a Flanders red. The light balsamic aceto acidity is present along with lactic sourness, but some malty support is also there, actually giving it an illusion of some berries being added in the end.

name: BrettCave 04 : Muscat
text: Initialy a gose style beer was later transferred to  oak barrels. The rich aroma of elderflower and tangerines from the muscat pomace is easily recognizable, joined by some wild funk and a promise for some acidity on the nose already. Sparkling natural wine like taste with moderate acidity just complements the aroma.

name: BrettCave 01 : the Dude
text: Started as a Belgian Wit Beer, but was transferred to  oak wine barrel to work up the funk. Mulberry addition (Croatian for mulberry is Dud, hence the name) gave this beer its intense red-purple color. Sourness is both from the fruit and the mixed fermentation. The tiny green stems of the berries contributed with a distinct peppery note as well.

name: Borsodi
text: The flagship of the brewery is a traditional golden coloured light beer.
